```python
# ai_caddie/course_data/security_domains.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Mapping, Sequence

from ai_caddie.contracts.canonical_json import canonical_json_bytes
from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from ai_caddie.course_data.rights import RightsMatrix, RightsOperation


_VERIFIED_GRANT_MARKER = object()


class VerifiedSnapshotGrant:
    __slots__ = ("account_id", "kind", "grant_id", "storage_key_domain", "shared_catalog_id", "shared_grant_family", "rights_policy_version", "generation", "allowed_profiles", "protected_header_hash")

    def __init__(self, marker: object, payload: dict[str, object], protected_header_hash: str) -> None:
        if marker is not _VERIFIED_GRANT_MARKER:
            raise TypeError("VerifiedSnapshotGrant is created only by the signed-control verifier")
        self.account_id = str(payload["accountId"])
        self.kind = str(payload["kind"])
        self.grant_id = None if payload.get("grantId") is None else str(payload["grantId"])
        self.storage_key_domain = None if payload.get("storageKeyDomain") is None else str(payload["storageKeyDomain"])
        self.shared_catalog_id = None if payload.get("sharedCatalogId") is None else str(payload["sharedCatalogId"])
        self.shared_grant_family = None if payload.get("sharedGrantFamily") is None else str(payload["sharedGrantFamily"])
        self.rights_policy_version = str(payload["rightsPolicyVersion"])
        self.generation = int(payload["generation"])
        self.allowed_profiles = tuple(str(value) for value in payload["allowedProfiles"])
        self.protected_header_hash = protected_header_hash


def _admit_verified_snapshot_grant(payload: dict[str, object], *, protected_header_hash: str) -> VerifiedSnapshotGrant:
    required = {"kind", "accountId", "rightsPolicyVersion", "generation", "allowedProfiles"}
    if not required <= payload.keys() or not 0 < int(payload["generation"]) <= 9_007_199_254_740_991:
        raise ValueError("verified SnapshotGrant payload is incomplete")
    if payload["kind"] == "private":
        if not payload.get("grantId") or not payload.get("storageKeyDomain"):
            raise ValueError("private SnapshotGrant lacks grant/storage-key domain")
    elif payload["kind"] == "shared":
        if not payload.get("sharedCatalogId") or not payload.get("sharedGrantFamily"):
            raise ValueError("shared SnapshotGrant lacks catalog/family")
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown SnapshotGrant domain kind")
    return VerifiedSnapshotGrant(_VERIFIED_GRANT_MARKER, payload, protected_header_hash)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BuildSecurityDomain:
    id: str
    canonical: dict[str, object]

    @classmethod
    def from_verified_grant(cls, grant: VerifiedSnapshotGrant, rights: RightsMatrix) -> "BuildSecurityDomain":
        if grant.kind == "shared":
            if not grant.shared_catalog_id or not grant.shared_grant_family:
                raise PermissionError("shared domain requires signed catalog and grant family")
            rights.require("garmin", "all", RightsOperation.CROSS_ACCOUNT_SHARE, policy_version=grant.rights_policy_version, context={"catalogId": grant.shared_catalog_id})
            payload = {"kind": "shared", "sharedCatalogId": grant.shared_catalog_id, "sharedGrantFamily": grant.shared_grant_family, "rightsPolicyVersion": grant.rights_policy_version}
        else:
            if not grant.grant_id or not grant.storage_key_domain:
                raise PermissionError("private domain requires grant and storage-key domain")
            payload = {"kind": "private", "accountId": grant.account_id, "grantId": grant.grant_id, "storageKeyDomain": grant.storage_key_domain, "rightsPolicyVersion": grant.rights_policy_version}
        return cls(typed_id("BuildSecurityDomain/v1", payload), payload)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CourseSourceRoster:
    layout_revision_id: str
    entries: tuple[dict[str, object], ...]
    id: str

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, layout_revision_id: str, entries: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]]) -> "CourseSourceRoster":
        rows = tuple(dict(value) for value in entries)
        required = {"ordinal", "role", "providerCourseRefId", "sourceBranch", "headGeneration", "sourceRevisionId"}
        if not rows or [row.get("ordinal") for row in rows] != list(range(len(rows))):
            raise ValueError("source roster ordinals must be contiguous and ordered")
        if any(set(row) != required or row["role"] not in {"layoutBase", "promotionEvidence"} or not all(isinstance(row[name], str) and row[name] for name in ("providerCourseRefId", "sourceBranch", "sourceRevisionId")) or not isinstance(row["headGeneration"], int) or isinstance(row["headGeneration"], bool) or not 0 < row["headGeneration"] <= 9_007_199_254_740_991 for row in rows):
            raise ValueError("source roster entry is malformed")
        keys = [(str(row["providerCourseRefId"]), str(row["sourceBranch"])) for row in rows]
        if len(set(keys)) != len(keys):
            raise ValueError("source roster repeats one provider branch")
        seen_evidence = False
        for row in rows:
            seen_evidence = seen_evidence or row["role"] == "promotionEvidence"
            if seen_evidence and row["role"] == "layoutBase":
                raise ValueError("layout base roster entries must precede promotion evidence")
        payload = {"layoutRevisionId": layout_revision_id, "entries": list(rows)}
        return cls(layout_revision_id, rows, typed_id("CourseSourceRoster/v1", payload))

    def canonical(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {"sourceRosterHash": self.id, "layoutRevisionId": self.layout_revision_id, "entries": list(self.entries)}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SemanticBuildKey:
    id: str

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, domain_id: str, layout_revision_id: str, source_roster: CourseSourceRoster, parser_versions: list[str], builder_versions: list[str], promotion_candidate_associations: Sequence[Mapping[str, object]] = ()) -> "SemanticBuildKey":
        if source_roster.layout_revision_id != layout_revision_id:
            raise ValueError("source roster layout revision differs from semantic build")
        promotion_rows = [dict(value) for value in promotion_candidate_associations]
        promotion_keys = [canonical_json_bytes(value) for value in promotion_rows]
        if len(set(promotion_keys)) != len(promotion_keys):
            raise ValueError("promotion candidate association inputs contain duplicates")
        ordered_promotions = [value for _key, value in sorted(zip(promotion_keys, promotion_rows, strict=True), key=lambda row: row[0])]
        payload = {"buildSecurityDomainId": domain_id, "layoutRevisionId": layout_revision_id, "sourceRoster": source_roster.canonical(), "parserVersions": sorted(set(parser_versions)), "semanticBuilderVersions": sorted(set(builder_versions)), "promotionCandidateAssociations": ordered_promotions}
        return cls(typed_id("SemanticBuildKey/v1", payload))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InstallProfileBuildKey:
    id: str

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, domain_id: str, semantic_build_key_id: str, snapshot_id: str, profile_id: str, renderer_version: str, style_version: str, toolchain_version: str) -> "InstallProfileBuildKey":
        payload = {"buildSecurityDomainId": domain_id, "semanticBuildKeyId": semantic_build_key_id, "snapshotId": snapshot_id, "profileId": profile_id, "rendererVersion": renderer_version, "styleVersion": style_version, "toolchainVersion": toolchain_version}
        return cls(typed_id("InstallProfileBuildKey/v1", payload))
```

```python
# tests/test_course_build_queue.py
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ai_caddie.course_data.build_queue import BuildJobKind, BuildQueue
from ops.course_build_worker import JobExecutionResult, LeaseClaim, run_once
from server_v2.course_models import CourseBuildJobRow
from server_v2.identity_models import Base


class CourseBuildQueueTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.engine = create_engine("sqlite://", future=True)
        Base.metadata.create_all(self.engine)

    def test_single_flight_is_scoped_by_security_domain(self) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as session:
            queue = BuildQueue(session)
            a1 = queue.enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, "domain-a", "key-1", {"layoutRevisionId": "layout-r1"})
            a2 = queue.enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, "domain-a", "key-1", {"layoutRevisionId": "layout-r1"})
            b = queue.enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, "domain-b", "key-1", {"layoutRevisionId": "layout-r1"})
            self.assertEqual(a1.id, a2.id)
            self.assertNotEqual(a1.id, b.id)

    def test_expired_lease_is_recoverable_without_double_completion(self) -> None:
        now = datetime(2026, 7, 18, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        with Session(self.engine) as session:
            queue = BuildQueue(session)
            job = queue.enqueue(BuildJobKind.PROFILE, "domain-a", "profile-key", {"profileId": "watch-v1"})
            first = queue.lease_next("worker-1", now=now, lease_for=timedelta(seconds=30))
            self.assertEqual(first.id, job.id)
            first_token = first.lease_token
            second = queue.lease_next("worker-2", now=now + timedelta(seconds=31), lease_for=timedelta(seconds=30))
            self.assertEqual(second.id, job.id)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "lease owner"):
                queue.complete(job.id, "worker-1", lease_token=str(first_token), result_ref="snapshot-1", now=now + timedelta(seconds=31))

    def test_same_key_different_payload_is_rejected_without_outer_rollback(self) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as session:
            queue = BuildQueue(session)
            queue.enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, "domain-a", "key-1", {"layoutRevisionId": "layout-r1"})
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "payload mismatch"):
                queue.enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, "domain-a", "key-1", {"layoutRevisionId": "layout-r2"})
            self.assertTrue(session.in_transaction())
```

```python
# tests/test_course_acquisition_orchestrator.py
from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from ai_caddie.course_data.acquisition import AcquisitionBoundary, AcquisitionOrchestrator


class RecordingGuard:
    def __init__(self, revoked_at: AcquisitionBoundary) -> None:
        self.revoked_at = revoked_at
        self.checked: list[AcquisitionBoundary] = []

    def require_current(self, job_id: str, boundary: AcquisitionBoundary) -> None:
        self.checked.append(boundary)
        if boundary is self.revoked_at:
            raise PermissionError("grant generation revoked")


class RecordingStages:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.ran: list[AcquisitionBoundary] = []

    def run(self, boundary: AcquisitionBoundary, job_id: str) -> str:
        self.ran.append(boundary)
        return f"{boundary.value}-result"


class RecordingBoundaryExecutor:
    def __init__(self, guard: RecordingGuard, stages: RecordingStages) -> None:
        self.guard = guard
        self.stages = stages

    def execute_authorized(self, job_id: str, boundary: AcquisitionBoundary) -> str:
        self.guard.require_current(job_id, boundary)
        return self.stages.run(boundary, job_id)


class CourseAcquisitionOrchestratorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_revoke_before_publish_quarantines_and_never_advances_channel(self) -> None:
        guard = RecordingGuard(AcquisitionBoundary.SNAPSHOT_PUBLISH)
        stages = RecordingStages()
        result = AcquisitionOrchestrator(RecordingBoundaryExecutor(guard, stages)).run("job-1")
        self.assertEqual(result.state, "quarantined")
        self.assertNotIn(AcquisitionBoundary.CHANNEL_ADVANCE, stages.ran)
        self.assertEqual(guard.checked[-1], AcquisitionBoundary.SNAPSHOT_PUBLISH)
```

```python
# ai_caddie/course_data/build_queue.py
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from enum import StrEnum
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import or_, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, aliased

from server_v2.course_models import CourseBuildJobRow


class BuildJobKind(StrEnum):
    SEMANTIC = "semantic"
    PROFILE = "profile"


class BuildQueue:
    def __init__(self, session: Session) -> None:
        self.session = session

    def enqueue(self, kind: BuildJobKind, security_domain_id: str, build_key: str, payload: dict[str, object], *, depends_on_job_id: str | None = None) -> CourseBuildJobRow:
        existing = self.session.scalar(select(CourseBuildJobRow).where(CourseBuildJobRow.security_domain_id == security_domain_id, CourseBuildJobRow.job_kind == kind.value, CourseBuildJobRow.build_key == build_key))
        if existing is not None:
            if existing.payload != payload or existing.depends_on_job_id != depends_on_job_id:
                raise ValueError("course build idempotency payload mismatch")
            return existing
        if depends_on_job_id is not None:
            dependency = self.session.get(CourseBuildJobRow, depends_on_job_id)
            if dependency is None or dependency.security_domain_id != security_domain_id:
                raise ValueError("build dependency is outside security domain")
        row = CourseBuildJobRow(id=uuid.uuid4().hex, security_domain_id=security_domain_id, job_kind=kind.value, build_key=build_key, payload=payload, depends_on_job_id=depends_on_job_id)
        try:
            with self.session.begin_nested():
                self.session.add(row)
                self.session.flush()
        except IntegrityError:
            existing = self.session.scalar(select(CourseBuildJobRow).where(CourseBuildJobRow.security_domain_id == security_domain_id, CourseBuildJobRow.job_kind == kind.value, CourseBuildJobRow.build_key == build_key))
            if existing is None:
                raise
            if existing.payload != payload or existing.depends_on_job_id != depends_on_job_id:
                raise ValueError("course build idempotency payload mismatch")
            return existing
        return row

    def lease_next(self, worker_id: str, *, now: datetime | None = None, lease_for: timedelta = timedelta(minutes=2)) -> CourseBuildJobRow:
        instant = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        dependency = aliased(CourseBuildJobRow)
        row = self.session.scalar(select(CourseBuildJobRow).outerjoin(dependency, CourseBuildJobRow.depends_on_job_id == dependency.id).where(CourseBuildJobRow.state.in_(["queued", "running"]), or_(CourseBuildJobRow.lease_until.is_(None), CourseBuildJobRow.lease_until < instant), or_(CourseBuildJobRow.depends_on_job_id.is_(None), dependency.state == "succeeded")).order_by(CourseBuildJobRow.created_at, CourseBuildJobRow.id).limit(1).with_for_update(skip_locked=True))
        if row is None:
            raise LookupError("no build job available")
        row.state = "running"
        row.lease_owner = worker_id
        row.lease_token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        row.lease_until = instant + lease_for
        row.attempt_count += 1
        row.updated_at = instant
        self.session.flush()
        return row

    def complete(self, job_id: str, worker_id: str, *, lease_token: str, result_ref: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> CourseBuildJobRow:
        instant = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        row = self.session.get(CourseBuildJobRow, job_id)
        if row is None or row.lease_owner != worker_id or row.lease_token != lease_token or row.state != "running" or row.lease_until is None or row.lease_until < instant:
            raise ValueError("build job lease owner does not match")
        row.state = "succeeded"
        row.result_ref = result_ref
        row.lease_owner = None
        row.lease_token = None
        row.lease_until = None
        row.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        self.session.flush()
        return row

    def quarantine(self, job_id: str, worker_id: str, *, lease_token: str, error_code: str) -> CourseBuildJobRow:
        row = self.session.get(CourseBuildJobRow, job_id)
        if row is None or row.lease_owner != worker_id or row.lease_token != lease_token:
            raise ValueError("build job lease owner does not match")
        row.state = "quarantined"
        row.error_code = error_code
        row.lease_owner = None
        row.lease_token = None
        row.lease_until = None
        self.session.flush()
        return row
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现每个 side-effect boundary 的 current-rights recheck**

```python
# ai_caddie/course_data/acquisition.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from typing import Protocol, Sequence


class AcquisitionBoundary(StrEnum):
    SEARCH = "search"
    RAW_FETCH = "raw_fetch"
    RAW_ARCHIVE = "raw_archive"
    DECRYPT_DERIVE = "decrypt_derive"
    SNAPSHOT_PUBLISH = "snapshot_publish"
    PROFILE_PUBLISH = "profile_publish"
    ASSET_SERVE = "asset_serve"
    INSTALL_COMMIT = "install_commit"
    CHANNEL_ADVANCE = "channel_advance"


class AcquisitionBoundaryExecutor(Protocol):
    def execute_authorized(self, job_id: str, boundary: AcquisitionBoundary) -> str:
        """Recheck current grant/rights generation and commit this one side effect in one DB transaction."""
        raise NotImplementedError


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AcquisitionResult:
    state: str
    completed_boundaries: Sequence[AcquisitionBoundary]
    evidence_refs: Sequence[str]


class AcquisitionOrchestrator:
    BUILD_BOUNDARIES = (
        AcquisitionBoundary.SEARCH,
        AcquisitionBoundary.RAW_FETCH,
        AcquisitionBoundary.RAW_ARCHIVE,
        AcquisitionBoundary.DECRYPT_DERIVE,
        AcquisitionBoundary.SNAPSHOT_PUBLISH,
        AcquisitionBoundary.PROFILE_PUBLISH,
        AcquisitionBoundary.CHANNEL_ADVANCE,
    )

    def __init__(self, executor: AcquisitionBoundaryExecutor) -> None:
        self.executor = executor

    def run(self, job_id: str) -> AcquisitionResult:
        completed: list[AcquisitionBoundary] = []
        evidence: list[str] = []
        try:
            for boundary in self.BUILD_BOUNDARIES:
                evidence.append(self.executor.execute_authorized(job_id, boundary))
                completed.append(boundary)
        except PermissionError:
            return AcquisitionResult("quarantined", tuple(completed), tuple(evidence))
        return AcquisitionResult("succeeded", tuple(completed), tuple(evidence))
```

```python
# ops/course_build_worker.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import importlib
import os
import socket
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager
from typing import Callable

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ai_caddie.course_data.build_queue import BuildQueue
from server_v2.course_models import CourseBuildJobRow
from server_v2.db import session_scope


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class JobExecutionResult:
    state: str
    result_ref: str | None
    error_code: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LeaseClaim:
    job_id: str
    lease_token: str
    security_domain_id: str
    job_kind: str
    payload: dict[str, object]


JobExecutor = Callable[[LeaseClaim], JobExecutionResult]


def run_once(executor: JobExecutor, session_scope_factory: Callable[[], AbstractContextManager[Session]] = session_scope) -> bool:
    worker_id = f"{socket.gethostname()}:{os.getpid()}"
    with session_scope_factory() as session:
        queue = BuildQueue(session)
        try:
            job = queue.lease_next(worker_id)
        except LookupError:
            return False
        claim = LeaseClaim(job.id, str(job.lease_token), job.security_domain_id, job.job_kind, dict(job.payload))
        session.commit()
    result = executor(claim)
    with session_scope_factory() as session:
        queue = BuildQueue(session)
        if result.state == "succeeded":
            if result.result_ref is None:
                raise ValueError("succeeded build requires result_ref")
            queue.complete(claim.job_id, worker_id, lease_token=claim.lease_token, result_ref=result.result_ref)
        else:
            queue.quarantine(claim.job_id, worker_id, lease_token=claim.lease_token, error_code=result.error_code or "course_build_failed")
        session.commit()
        return True


def load_executor(specification: str) -> JobExecutor:
    module_name, attribute_name = specification.split(":", 1)
    executor = getattr(importlib.import_module(module_name), attribute_name)
    if not callable(executor):
        raise TypeError("course build executor must be callable")
    return executor


if __name__ == "__main__":
    specification = os.environ["AI_CADDIE_COURSE_EXECUTOR"]
    configured_executor = load_executor(specification)
    while run_once(configured_executor):
        pass
```

```python
class CourseBuildWorkerTests(CourseBuildQueueTests):
    def test_worker_commits_lease_before_executor_and_completes_with_fencing_token(self) -> None:
        with Session(self.engine) as session:
            BuildQueue(session).enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, "domain-a", "key-a", {"evidenceRefs": ["obs-a"]})
            session.commit()

        def executor(claim: LeaseClaim) -> JobExecutionResult:
            with Session(self.engine) as reader:
                row = reader.get(CourseBuildJobRow, claim.job_id)
                self.assertEqual(row.lease_token, claim.lease_token)
                self.assertEqual(row.state, "running")
            return JobExecutionResult("succeeded", "snapshot-1", None)

        self.assertTrue(run_once(executor))
        with Session(self.engine) as session:
            row = session.scalar(select(CourseBuildJobRow))
            self.assertEqual((row.state, row.result_ref), ("succeeded", "snapshot-1"))
```

`catalogRevisionId = typed_id("CourseProviderCatalogRevision/v1", {scopeOptionId,providerConfigurationId,providerConfigurationRevision,sourceRevisionId,sourceContentHash,rightsPolicyVersion})`. `catalogEntryId = typed_id("CourseProviderCatalogEntry/v1", {catalogRevisionId,providerCourseRefId,displayName,holeCount,centroidLatE7,centroidLonE7,ordinal})`. `requestId = typed_id("CourseCatalogAcquisitionRequest/v1", {acquisitionIntentId,accountId,securityDomainId,deviceId,catalogEntryId,targetEpochMs,requestedProfileId})`. Add all three exact identities and ordered included-field arrays to the canonical registry/generator. Provider numeric IDs are never keys without `provider/catalogNamespace/region`.

`CourseProviderCatalogRevisionRow` is immutable evidence metadata, not a mutable “latest courses” blob. `CourseProviderCatalogHeadRow` is the only current pointer. A sync writes the raw catalog response to encrypted CAS, then `SourceManifest → SourceObservation → SourceRevision`, strict-decodes every entry, rejects duplicate full provider refs、invalid UTF-8、unsafe integers、unknown hole counts、missing/non-paired/non-finite centroids and count drift, inserts the complete revision/entry set, and advances the locked head by one generation in one transaction. A crash or one invalid entry leaves the previous head visible; exact body replay returns the same revision and does not advance generation. Retired revisions remain while referenced by a catalog-acquisition request and are later collected by the same provenance-aware GC rules.

`ops/course_catalog_sync_worker.py` enumerates every **explicitly configured and enabled** provider scope on a schedule and via an operator command. Before each fetch and before head publication it rechecks the versioned rights operation `provider.catalog-metadata-mirror`; denial records a typed outcome and does not fetch/publish. It obtains the frozen SQL configuration revision、mode-checked credential lease and redacting HTTPS transport from the same production dependency graph as acquisition. No account、device、nearby intent or player coordinate is an input. Provider catalog requests are source/config driven only. The provider adapter owns an explicit bounded `enumerate_catalog_metadata()` port; pagination cursors are archived as occurrence evidence, and a partial page set can never become a head.

The mirror intentionally contains only provider identity、display metadata、hole count and centroid provenance. It must not invent a `VenueIdentity`、`CourseLayoutIdentity`、`LayoutRevision`、ordered holes or Tee merely to satisfy a DTO. Those fields become authoritative only after the selected course completes acquisition. This is why provider-only nearby rows use a distinct strict `CourseNearbyItem` shape with nullable layout pair instead of pretending to be a `CourseSearchItem`.

`scopeOptionId = typed_id("CourseProviderScope/v1", {provider,catalogNamespace,region})`. The client supplies a new opaque `discoveryIntentId` plus one explicit server-listed scope option; inside a row lock the server obtains `targetEpochMs` from its trusted UTC clock exactly once and computes `requestId = typed_id("CourseDiscoveryRequest/v1", {discoveryIntentId,accountId,securityDomainId,deviceId,provider,scopeOptionId,catalogNamespace,region,query,targetEpochMs,requestedProfileId})`. Exact retry loads by `(accountId,discoveryIntentId)`, compares every immutable request field including authenticated device, and returns the same row/epoch; changed device/scope/query/profile is `discovery_intent_conflict`. The client never sends `targetEpochMs`, and retry never calls the clock again.

If the selected scope has an active configuration, the same transaction freezes `providerConfigurationId/providerConfigurationRevision/providerConfigurationBindingHash`; the binding hash is the typed identity of the exact canonical configuration payload. If no configuration exists, those three columns remain SQL `NULL`, state is `configuration_unavailable`, and a separate durable evidence request is linked. Sentinel IDs such as `unknown`, zero hashes, fallback CN revisions, or later mutation of this row when a configuration appears are forbidden. The owner starts a new discovery intent to use a newly installed configuration. A resolved provider configuration revision remains frozen for the whole discovery/acquisition job chain.

In the same checkpoint, extend `course_identity_v1.schema.json` and `canonical_object_registry.json` with exact identities `CourseProviderScope/v1` (`provider/catalogNamespace/region`), `CourseDiscoveryRequest/v1` (`discoveryIntentId/accountId/securityDomainId/deviceId/provider/scopeOptionId/catalogNamespace/region/query/targetEpochMs/requestedProfileId`) and `CourseDiscoveryContext/v1` (`requestId/discoveryIntentId/accountId/securityDomainId/deviceId/provider/scopeOptionId/catalogNamespace/region/targetEpochMs/providerConfigurationId/providerConfigurationRevision/issuedAt/expiresAt`). `scopeOptionId/requestId/discoveryContextId` are excluded result fields. The context schema requires the configuration ID/revision pair to be both strings or both null. Run the single Plan 1 generator and its contract tests before implementing the repository; no local SHA helper may stand in for these IDs.

After the request row is locked, Course Service signs the exact context as a `CourseDiscoveryContext` envelope under `course-control-signature/v1\0CourseDiscoveryContext\0`. It is account/security-domain/intent/request bound, freezes catalog、region、server epoch and nullable configuration revision, expires only as a permission to start a new provider request, and is nevertheless retained as audit evidence for an already-created job. Exact status retry returns the same canonical envelope bytes. Unknown configuration receives a valid signed context with both configuration fields null; no client may fabricate or patch the envelope.

Watch/Web/iOS must present the selected region/catalog explicitly; even one-option lists require a durable selection rather than an implicit CN/global default. Zero candidates becomes `failed/course_not_found`; one exact candidate is selected atomically and enqueues acquisition; multiple candidates become `awaiting_selection`. Selection must be a member of that request's exact canonical candidate set and security domain. Unknown configuration writes the evidence request from B3 and returns `configuration_unavailable`; it does not enqueue a transport job and never substitutes another region.

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 SQL provider configuration、secret broker、redacting HTTPS transport 与 production composition**

Keep the ports in `server_v2/course_acquisition_backend.py`, but production must instantiate the concrete classes below; a `Protocol` alone does not satisfy this task:

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VerifiedProviderConfiguration:
    configuration: GarminProviderConfiguration
    revision_hash: str


class ProviderConfigurationRepo(Protocol):
    def list_scope_options(self) -> tuple[CourseDiscoveryScopeOption, ...]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def resolve_scope(self, scope_option_id: str) -> VerifiedProviderConfiguration | None:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def require_revision(self, configuration_id: str, revision_hash: str) -> VerifiedProviderConfiguration:
        raise NotImplementedError


class ProviderCredentialBroker(Protocol):
    def lease(self, credential_policy_id: str, *, job_id: str) -> ProviderCredentialLease:
        raise NotImplementedError


class GarminProviderTransportFactory:
    def for_job(self, job: AcquisitionJobSpec) -> tuple[GarminCourseAdapter, ProviderTransport]:
        verified = self.configurations.require_revision(
            job.provider_configuration_id, job.provider_configuration_revision,
        )
        credential = self.credentials.lease(
            verified.configuration.credential_policy_id, job_id=job.job_id,
        )
        return (
            GarminCourseAdapter(verified.configuration),
            RedactingHTTPSProviderTransport(
                configuration=verified.configuration,
                credential=credential,
                job_id=job.job_id,
            ),
        )
```

`server_v2/provider_configuration_repo.py` implements `SqlProviderConfigurationRepo`. Every read strict-decodes `canonical_payload`, reconstructs `GarminProviderConfiguration`, recomputes `revision_hash = SHA256(CanonicalJSON(canonical_payload))`, and compares row columns, scope identity and active/retired state before returning. `resolve_scope` returns the one active revision or fails on ambiguity; `require_revision` can load a retired revision for an already-frozen job but rejects any payload/hash/column drift. The repository never reads environment variables and never contains a guessed global/CN URL.

`server_v2/course_catalog_mirror.py` implements `SqlCourseProviderCatalogMirror`. `current_entries()` joins only enabled scope → active SQL configuration → locked catalog head → immutable entries, then applies the current rights projection before returning metadata. It verifies every row's typed IDs and configuration/source bindings on read; a corrupt head、ambiguous active configuration or hash drift makes that scope unavailable instead of serving stale/unverified coordinates. Its geospatial query is local SQL/bounded application math only. The class has no provider transport dependency and its public method accepts no account location object—only already-validated E7 scalar coordinates supplied by Course Service for the duration of one call.

`ops/seed_course_provider_config.py` is the only bootstrap writer. It strict-decodes a secret-free `CourseProviderBootstrap/v1` file with exact top-level keys `schema/scopes/configurations`; scope rows contain `provider/catalogNamespace/region/displayName`, while configuration rows contain only `configurationId/scopeOptionId/catalogBaseUrl/assetHosts/credentialPolicyId`. It validates HTTPS origins/hosts, canonical host ordering and scope equality, computes the revision hash, and insert-on-conflict returns the exact existing row or rejects same identity/different payload. No cookie、CSRF、bearer、signed URL or filesystem secret path may appear in this file or SQL. Migration tests seed CN, global and one deliberately unconfigured scope; deployment invokes the CLI before starting the worker.

`server_v2/provider_credentials.py` implements `SecretBackedProviderCredentialBroker` over an injected `ProviderSecretSource`. Production uses `ModeCheckedDirectorySecretSource(AI_CADDIE_PROVIDER_SECRET_DIR)`: the filename is `SHA256(credentialPolicyId).json`, the directory is outside application data/snapshots, and both directory/file ownership plus mode `0700/0600` are enforced. Each file strict-decodes exact keys `schema/cookieHeader/csrfHeader/expiresAt/generation`; values are held only in a zero-log `ProviderCredentialLease`, whose `repr/str` expose policy ID, generation and expiry but never secret bytes. Tests use an in-memory source; production composition rejects it. Refresh may reload one higher generation from the same policy after the first 401/403, never switch policy or region.

`server_v2/provider_https_transport.py` implements `RedactingHTTPSProviderTransport` with an injected `httpx.Client(follow_redirects=False)`. It accepts only HTTPS; the initial host must equal the configured catalog host or an allow-listed asset host; every redirect is followed manually, bounded to five hops, and checked before sending credentials. Connect/read timeout, response-header and body limits are fixed constructor values. Provider evidence records each hop as `{status,scheme,host,path,queryKeyNames,urlSha256}`—enough to prove the complete chain without persisting query values—and application logs use only `jobId/attempt/host/path/status/outcomeCode`. Exceptions and test capture are passed through the shared secret redactor; cookie、CSRF、Authorization values, signed query values and home paths are forbidden substrings.

A 401/403 permits exactly one broker refresh, recorded in `ProviderResponse.credential_refresh_attempted`; a second auth failure is permanent. 429 honors a parsed, bounded `Retry-After`; 502/503/504 use deterministic capped exponential backoff with jitter derived from job ID/attempt, so crash/replay produces the same next-attempt time. TLS or DNS errors are outcome rows, never invented HTTP statuses. `course_dependencies.py` creates one `SqlProviderConfigurationRepo` and secret source, injects the factory into both API and `CourseAcquisitionStageExecutor`, and the worker composition test rejects a registry literal, fake transport, `StaticDomainKeyProvider`, in-memory credential source or absent executor branch.

The same composition root creates one SQL mirror repository for Course Service and one `CourseCatalogSyncExecutor` for `ops/course_catalog_sync_worker.py`. API startup may serve the last verified head while the sync worker is offline, but production readiness exposes each configured scope's head generation/age and fails the release gate when no verified head exists or age exceeds the configured maximum. It never performs an on-demand provider catalog fetch from `/courses/nearby`; refresh is an independently rate-limited scheduled/operator action.

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 discovery/acquisition executors 与 atomic source-head commit**

`ai_caddie/course_data/acquisition_jobs.py` freezes strict payloads `CourseDiscoveryJob/v1` and `CourseAcquisitionJob/v1`. The acquisition payload contains the selected full `ProviderCourseRef`, configuration ID/revision, exact search SourceManifest ID, target epoch, requested profile, current grant generation, and security domain; it never contains a bare numeric course ID.

`ops/course_acquisition_executor.py` exposes one production callable used by `CourseBuildExecutor`:

```python
class CourseAcquisitionStageExecutor:
    def execute(self, claim: LeaseClaim) -> JobExecutionResult:
        if claim.job_kind == BuildJobKind.DISCOVERY.value:
            return self._discover(claim)
        if claim.job_kind == BuildJobKind.ACQUISITION.value:
            return self._acquire(claim)
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported acquisition job kind {claim.job_kind}")
```

`_discover` performs current-rights recheck, resolves the frozen provider configuration, fetches search, writes response bytes into encrypted Raw CAS, writes `SourceManifest + SourceObservation + SourceRevision` for the exact search occurrence, then projects canonical `ProviderCourseRef` candidates. It commits the request state/candidate set and raw evidence in one DB transaction after CAS durability. An exact retry reuses the same raw ref/revision and does not append a duplicate occurrence.

`_acquire` executes search-reference verification, release, date, then every expected asset occurrence. For every network attempt—including 304, 401 refresh, 404/410 absence, 429, 5xx, redirect, timeout, truncated body and success—it writes a `SourceManifest` outcome before deciding retry/permanent state. Successful bodies go to Raw CAS before manifest commit. ZIP/body decoding and semantic projection never replace raw bytes. The stage builds a candidate `SourceRoster` whose members bind provider configuration revision, full provider ref, release ID/version, local hole, occurrence ordinal and exact SourceRevision ID.

For a `CourseCatalogAcquisitionRequestRow`, `_acquire` replaces search-reference verification with exact catalog-entry verification: it locks the request, reloads the retained immutable catalog revision/entry, recomputes all three typed IDs, requires the frozen provider configuration and catalog SourceRevision, then continues through release/date/assets. It never reruns a name search and never uses the latest catalog head as a substitute. The same completion transaction fills the request's real layout pair and enqueues semantic/profile jobs; profile readiness updates this request as well as any named discovery request.

Only after all mandatory release/date/hole occurrences are coherent does one DB transaction:

1. lock layout identity/revision and every affected `SourceHead`;
2. verify the expected old generations and current grant/rights;
3. insert missing immutable revisions and advance all heads;
4. persist the exact canonical roster/hash and acquisition completion row;
5. enqueue one `SEMANTIC` job with `depends_on_job_id=acquisition_job_id`;
6. move discovery request to `semantic_building`.

Missing mandatory members, cross-region refs, release/date identity drift, duplicate local holes, noncontiguous 9/18 roster, or mixed provider configuration revisions never advance any head. Optional explicitly absent families remain typed absence evidence. `CourseBuildExecutor.__call__` must route all four job kinds; semantic completion enqueues the requested profile, and profile/channel completion updates the same discovery request to `ready`.

```python
                        cross_source_residual_m=None,
                        base_geometry_hash=None,
                        green_surface_hash=None,
                        green_registration_residual_m=None,
                        green_cross_source_residual_m=None,
                        green_registration_sample_count=None,
                    ),
                    QualityPolicy.v1(),
                )
                self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["core.identity"].quality_state, "blocked")
                self.assertIn(case["expectedReason"], report.capabilities["core.identity"].reason_codes)

    def test_scorecard_failure_keeps_identity_for_gross_only_round(self) -> None:
        report = evaluate_hole(
            CapabilityInput.valid_identity(hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=9, handicap=1),
            QualityPolicy.v1(),
        )
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["core.identity"].quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["scorecard"].quality_state, "blocked")
        self.assertEqual(report.minimum_round_mode, "gross_only")

    def test_composite_layout_allows_one_current_revision_per_provider(self) -> None:
        bindings = tuple({
            "absoluteHole": absolute,
            "providerLocalHole": absolute if absolute <= 5 else absolute - 5,
            "internalHole": absolute if absolute <= 5 else absolute - 5,
            "providerCourseRefId": "gid-a" if absolute <= 5 else "gid-b",
            "internalGid": "gid-a" if absolute <= 5 else "gid-b",
            "sourceRevisionId": "release-a" if absolute <= 5 else "release-b",
        } for absolute in range(1, 10))
        candidate = replace(
            CapabilityInput.valid_identity(hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=4, handicap=3),
            bindings=bindings,
        )
        report = evaluate_hole(candidate, QualityPolicy.v1())
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["core.identity"].quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertNotIn(
            "quality_mixed_release",
            report.capabilities["core.identity"].reason_codes,
        )

    def test_map_and_plays_like_promote_independently(self) -> None:
        candidate = CapabilityInput.valid_identity(
            hole_ref="layout-r1:h1",
            par=4,
            handicap=3,
            tee_anchor=(22.1, 113.4, 15.0),
            green_anchor=(22.101, 113.402, 21.0),
            geometry_hash="geometry-a",
            elevation_hash=None,
        )
        report = evaluate_hole(candidate, QualityPolicy.v1())
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["distance"].quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["map"].quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["playsLike"].quality_state, "blocked")

    def test_hazard_body_remains_required_and_playable_regions_is_role_level_optional(self) -> None:
        base = CapabilityInput.valid_identity(
            hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=4, handicap=3,
            tee_anchor=(22.1, 113.4, 15.0),
            green_anchor=(22.101, 113.402, 21.0),
            geometry_hash="a" * 64, base_geometry_hash="a" * 64,
            hazard_hash="b" * 64,
        )
        hazard_only = evaluate_hole(base, QualityPolicy.v1()).capabilities[
            "hazardGuidance"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(hazard_only.quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertEqual(hazard_only.required_asset_refs, ("b" * 64,))
        self.assertEqual(hazard_only.optional_asset_refs, ())
        enriched = evaluate_hole(
            replace(
                base,
                playable_regions_hash="c" * 64,
                playable_regions_registration_residual_m=1.2,
            ),
            QualityPolicy.v1(),
        ).capabilities["hazardGuidance"]
        self.assertEqual(enriched.required_asset_refs, ("b" * 64,))
        self.assertEqual(enriched.optional_asset_refs, ("c" * 64,))
        rejected = evaluate_hole(
            replace(
                base,
                playable_regions_hash="c" * 64,
                playable_regions_registration_residual_m=3.01,
            ),
            QualityPolicy.v1(),
        ).capabilities["hazardGuidance"]
        self.assertEqual(rejected.quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertEqual(rejected.optional_asset_refs, ())

    def test_green_surface_requires_exact_base_geometry_binding_and_registration(self) -> None:
        candidate = CapabilityInput.valid_identity(
            hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=4, handicap=3,
            tee_anchor=(22.1, 113.4, 15.0), green_anchor=(22.101, 113.402, 21.0),
            geometry_hash="geometry-a", base_geometry_hash="geometry-b",
            green_surface_hash="green-a", green_registration_residual_m=1.5,
            green_cross_source_residual_m=2.0, green_registration_sample_count=24,
        )
        report = evaluate_hole(candidate, QualityPolicy.v1())
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["greenSurface"].quality_state, "blocked")
        accepted = evaluate_hole(
            CapabilityInput.valid_identity(
                hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=4, handicap=3,
                tee_anchor=(22.1, 113.4, 15.0), green_anchor=(22.101, 113.402, 21.0),
                geometry_hash="geometry-a", base_geometry_hash="geometry-a",
                green_surface_hash="green-a", green_registration_residual_m=1.5,
                green_cross_source_residual_m=2.0, green_registration_sample_count=24,
            ), QualityPolicy.v1(),
        )
        self.assertEqual(accepted.capabilities["greenSurface"].quality_state, "accepted")

    def test_green_surface_blocks_on_each_measured_registration_threshold(self) -> None:
        valid = CapabilityInput.valid_identity(
            hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=4, handicap=3,
            tee_anchor=(22.1, 113.4, 15.0), green_anchor=(22.101, 113.402, 21.0),
            geometry_hash="geometry-a", base_geometry_hash="geometry-a",
            green_surface_hash="green-a", green_registration_residual_m=1.5,
            green_cross_source_residual_m=2.0, green_registration_sample_count=24,
        )
        for changed, expected_reason in (
            (replace(valid, green_registration_residual_m=3.01), "quality_green_registration_residual_exceeded"),
            (replace(valid, green_cross_source_residual_m=8.01), "quality_green_cross_source_residual_exceeded"),
            (replace(valid, green_registration_sample_count=11), "quality_green_registration_sample_insufficient"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(changed=changed, expected_reason=expected_reason):
                report = evaluate_hole(changed, QualityPolicy.v1())
                capability = report.capabilities["greenSurface"]
                self.assertEqual(capability.quality_state, "blocked")
                self.assertEqual(capability.required_asset_refs, ())
                self.assertEqual(capability.reason_codes, (expected_reason,))

    def test_snapshot_capability_id_covers_name_state_reasons_and_asset_roles(self) -> None:
        accepted_input = CapabilityInput.valid_identity(
            hole_ref="layout-r1:h1", par=4, handicap=3,
            tee_anchor=(22.1, 113.4, 15.0), green_anchor=(22.101, 113.402, 21.0),
            geometry_hash="a" * 64,
        )
        blocked_input = replace(accepted_input, cross_source_residual_m=99.0)
        accepted = evaluate_hole(accepted_input, QualityPolicy.v1()).capabilities["map"]
        blocked = evaluate_hole(blocked_input, QualityPolicy.v1()).capabilities["map"]
        self.assertEqual(accepted.quality_state, "accepted")
        self.assertEqual(blocked.quality_state, "blocked")
        self.assertNotEqual(accepted.capability_id, blocked.capability_id)
        identity_payload = accepted.canonical()
        identity_payload.pop("capabilityId")
        self.assertEqual(accepted.capability_id, typed_id("SnapshotCapability/v1", identity_payload))
        self.assertEqual(accepted.required_asset_refs, ("a" * 64,))
        self.assertEqual(accepted.optional_asset_refs, ())
        report = evaluate_hole(accepted_input, QualityPolicy.v1())
        self.assertNotEqual(report.capabilities["core.identity"].capability_id, report.capabilities["scorecard"].capability_id)
        self.assertEqual(report.capabilities["core.identity"].reason_codes, ())

    def test_registry_freezes_exact_snapshot_capability_identity_fields(self) -> None:
        registry = json.loads(Path("contracts/canonical/canonical_object_registry.json").read_text())
        entry = registry["objects"]["SnapshotCapability"]
        self.assertEqual(entry["domainTag"], "SnapshotCapability/v1")
        self.assertEqual(entry["excludedFields"], ["capabilityId"])
        self.assertEqual(
            entry["includedFields"],
            ["capability", "subjectRef", "dataState", "qualityState", "reasonCodes", "evidenceRefs", "qualityVersion", "sourceLayerIds", "requiredAssetRefs", "optionalAssetRefs"],
        )
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 SnapshotCapability 与 versioned quality report**

```python
# ai_caddie/course_data/quality.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from math import asin, cos, isfinite, radians, sin, sqrt
from typing import Sequence

from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SnapshotCapability:
    capability_id: str
    capability: str
    subject_ref: str
    data_state: str
    quality_state: str
    reason_codes: Sequence[str]
    evidence_refs: Sequence[str]
    quality_version: str
    source_layer_ids: Sequence[str]
    required_asset_refs: Sequence[str]
    optional_asset_refs: Sequence[str]

    @classmethod
    def create(
        cls,
        *,
        capability: str,
        subject_ref: str,
        data_state: str,
        quality_state: str,
        reason_codes: Sequence[str],
        evidence_refs: Sequence[str],
        quality_version: str,
        source_layer_ids: Sequence[str],
        required_asset_refs: Sequence[str],
        optional_asset_refs: Sequence[str],
    ) -> "SnapshotCapability":
        def canonical_set(values: Sequence[str], label: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
            normalized = tuple(sorted(values))
            if len(set(normalized)) != len(normalized):
                raise ValueError(f"{label} contains duplicates")
            return normalized
        reasons = canonical_set(reason_codes, "reasonCodes")
        evidence = canonical_set(evidence_refs, "evidenceRefs")
        layers = canonical_set(source_layer_ids, "sourceLayerIds")
        required = canonical_set(required_asset_refs, "requiredAssetRefs")
        optional = canonical_set(optional_asset_refs, "optionalAssetRefs")
        if set(required) & set(optional):
            raise ValueError("required and optional capability assets overlap")
        payload = {
            "capability": capability,
            "subjectRef": subject_ref,
            "dataState": data_state,
            "qualityState": quality_state,
            "reasonCodes": list(reasons),
            "evidenceRefs": list(evidence),
            "qualityVersion": quality_version,
            "sourceLayerIds": list(layers),
            "requiredAssetRefs": list(required),
            "optionalAssetRefs": list(optional),
        }
        return cls(typed_id("SnapshotCapability/v1", payload), capability, subject_ref, data_state, quality_state, reasons, evidence, quality_version, layers, required, optional)

    def canonical(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "capabilityId": self.capability_id,
            "capability": self.capability,
            "subjectRef": self.subject_ref,
            "dataState": self.data_state,
            "qualityState": self.quality_state,
            "reasonCodes": list(self.reason_codes),
            "evidenceRefs": list(self.evidence_refs),
            "qualityVersion": self.quality_version,
            "sourceLayerIds": list(self.source_layer_ids),
            "requiredAssetRefs": list(self.required_asset_refs),
            "optionalAssetRefs": list(self.optional_asset_refs),
        }


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class QualityPolicy:
    version: str
    accepted_axes: frozenset[str]
    accepted_units: frozenset[str]
    maximum_anchor_distance_m: float
    maximum_residual_m: float
    maximum_green_registration_residual_m: float
    maximum_green_cross_source_residual_m: float
    minimum_green_registration_sample_count: int
    maximum_playable_region_registration_residual_m: float

    @classmethod
    def v1(cls) -> "QualityPolicy":
        return cls(
            "course-quality/v1",
            frozenset({"east-north-up", "wgs84-lat-lon-alt"}),
            frozenset({"meters"}),
            750.0,
            12.0,
            3.0,
            8.0,
            12,
            3.0,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CapabilityInput:
    hole_ref: str
    expected_hole_count: int
    bindings: Sequence[dict[str, object]]
    par: int | None
    handicap: int | None
    tee_anchor: tuple[float, float, float] | None
    green_anchor: tuple[float, float, float] | None
    geometry_hash: str | None
    hazard_hash: str | None
    playable_regions_hash: str | None
    elevation_hash: str | None
    plays_like_model_hash: str | None
    axis_attestation: str
    unit_attestation: str
    evidence_refs: Sequence[str]
    projection_roundtrip_error_m: float | None
    cross_source_residual_m: float | None
    base_geometry_hash: str | None
    green_surface_hash: str | None
    green_registration_residual_m: float | None
    green_cross_source_residual_m: float | None
    green_registration_sample_count: int | None
    plays_like_residual_m: float | None = None
    playable_regions_registration_residual_m: float | None = None

    @classmethod
    def valid_identity(
        cls,
        *,
        hole_ref: str,
        par: int | None,
        handicap: int | None,
        tee_anchor: tuple[float, float, float] | None = None,
        green_anchor: tuple[float, float, float] | None = None,
        geometry_hash: str | None = None,
        hazard_hash: str | None = None,
        playable_regions_hash: str | None = None,
        elevation_hash: str | None = None,
        plays_like_model_hash: str | None = None,
        base_geometry_hash: str | None = None,
        green_surface_hash: str | None = None,
        green_registration_residual_m: float | None = None,
        green_cross_source_residual_m: float | None = None,
        green_registration_sample_count: int | None = None,
    ) -> "CapabilityInput":
        bindings = tuple({"absoluteHole": hole, "providerLocalHole": hole, "internalHole": hole, "providerCourseRefId": "gid-a", "internalGid": "gid-a", "sourceRevisionId": "release-a"} for hole in range(1, 10))
        return cls(
            hole_ref, 9, bindings, par, handicap, tee_anchor, green_anchor,
            geometry_hash, hazard_hash, playable_regions_hash,
            elevation_hash, plays_like_model_hash,
            "east-north-up", "meters",
            ("raw-a", "derived-a"), 0.25 if geometry_hash else None,
            2.0 if geometry_hash else None, base_geometry_hash or geometry_hash,
            green_surface_hash, green_registration_residual_m,
            green_cross_source_residual_m, green_registration_sample_count,
            2.0 if elevation_hash else None,
            1.0 if playable_regions_hash else None,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class HoleQualityReport:
    hole_ref: str
    capabilities: dict[str, SnapshotCapability]
    minimum_round_mode: str
    id: str


def _capability(
    name: str,
    subject: str,
    accepted: bool,
    reasons: list[str],
    evidence: Sequence[str],
    policy: QualityPolicy,
    *,
    required_assets: Sequence[str] = (),
    optional_assets: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> SnapshotCapability:
    effective_required = required_assets if accepted else ()
    effective_optional = optional_assets if accepted else ()
    return SnapshotCapability.create(
        capability=name,
        subject_ref=subject,
        data_state="present" if accepted else "absent",
        quality_state="accepted" if accepted else "blocked",
        reason_codes=tuple(reasons),
        evidence_refs=tuple(evidence),
        quality_version=policy.version,
        source_layer_ids=tuple(sorted(set(effective_required) | set(effective_optional))),
        required_asset_refs=effective_required,
        optional_asset_refs=effective_optional,
    )


def _horizontal_distance_m(left: tuple[float, float, float], right: tuple[float, float, float]) -> float:
    lat1, lon1, _ = left
    lat2, lon2, _ = right
    dlat = radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlon = radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + cos(radians(lat1)) * cos(radians(lat2)) * sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    return 6_371_008.8 * 2 * asin(min(1.0, sqrt(a)))


def evaluate_hole(candidate: CapabilityInput, policy: QualityPolicy) -> HoleQualityReport:
    reasons: list[str] = []
    absolute = [int(binding["absoluteHole"]) for binding in candidate.bindings]
    if len(absolute) != len(set(absolute)):
        reasons.append("quality_duplicate_hole")
    if any(binding["providerLocalHole"] != binding["internalHole"] for binding in candidate.bindings):
        reasons.append("quality_hole_swap")
    revisions_by_provider: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for binding in candidate.bindings:
        revisions_by_provider.setdefault(
            str(binding["providerCourseRefId"]), set(),
        ).add(str(binding["sourceRevisionId"]))
    if any(len(revisions) != 1 for revisions in revisions_by_provider.values()):
        reasons.append("quality_mixed_release")
    if any(binding["providerCourseRefId"] != binding["internalGid"] for binding in candidate.bindings):
        reasons.append("quality_cross_gid")
    if candidate.axis_attestation not in policy.accepted_axes:
        reasons.append("quality_axis_unattested")
    if candidate.unit_attestation not in policy.accepted_units:
        reasons.append("quality_unit_unattested")
    if candidate.expected_hole_count not in {9, 18} or sorted(absolute) != list(range(1, candidate.expected_hole_count + 1)):
        reasons.append("quality_roster_incomplete")
    core_ok = not reasons and len(candidate.bindings) == candidate.expected_hole_count
    scorecard_ok = core_ok and candidate.par is not None and 3 <= candidate.par <= 6 and candidate.handicap is not None and 1 <= candidate.handicap <= candidate.expected_hole_count
    anchors = candidate.tee_anchor is not None and candidate.green_anchor is not None and all(isfinite(value) for point in (candidate.tee_anchor, candidate.green_anchor) for value in point)
    anchor_distance_ok = bool(anchors and _horizontal_distance_m(candidate.tee_anchor, candidate.green_anchor) <= policy.maximum_anchor_distance_m)
    residual_ok = candidate.cross_source_residual_m is not None and isfinite(candidate.cross_source_residual_m) and 0 <= candidate.cross_source_residual_m <= policy.maximum_residual_m
    roundtrip_ok = candidate.projection_roundtrip_error_m is not None and isfinite(candidate.projection_roundtrip_error_m) and 0 <= candidate.projection_roundtrip_error_m <= 1.0
    distance_ok = core_ok and anchor_distance_ok
    map_ok = distance_ok and candidate.geometry_hash is not None and roundtrip_ok and residual_ok
    hazard_ok = map_ok and candidate.hazard_hash is not None
    playable_regions_residual_ok = (
        candidate.playable_regions_registration_residual_m is not None
        and isfinite(candidate.playable_regions_registration_residual_m)
        and 0 <= candidate.playable_regions_registration_residual_m
        <= policy.maximum_playable_region_registration_residual_m
    )
    playable_regions_ok = (
        hazard_ok
        and candidate.playable_regions_hash is not None
        and candidate.base_geometry_hash == candidate.geometry_hash
        and playable_regions_residual_ok
    )
    plays_like_residual_ok = candidate.plays_like_residual_m is not None and isfinite(candidate.plays_like_residual_m) and 0 <= candidate.plays_like_residual_m <= policy.maximum_residual_m
    plays_like_ok = (
        map_ok
        and candidate.elevation_hash is not None
        and candidate.plays_like_model_hash is not None
        and plays_like_residual_ok
    )
    green_registration_ok = (
        candidate.green_registration_residual_m is not None
        and isfinite(candidate.green_registration_residual_m)
        and 0 <= candidate.green_registration_residual_m
        <= policy.maximum_green_registration_residual_m
    )
    green_cross_source_ok = (
        candidate.green_cross_source_residual_m is not None
        and isfinite(candidate.green_cross_source_residual_m)
        and 0 <= candidate.green_cross_source_residual_m
        <= policy.maximum_green_cross_source_residual_m
    )
    green_sample_ok = (
        candidate.green_registration_sample_count is not None
        and isinstance(candidate.green_registration_sample_count, int)
        and not isinstance(candidate.green_registration_sample_count, bool)
        and candidate.green_registration_sample_count
        >= policy.minimum_green_registration_sample_count
    )
    green_ok = (
        map_ok
        and candidate.green_surface_hash is not None
        and candidate.base_geometry_hash == candidate.geometry_hash
        and green_registration_ok
        and green_cross_source_ok
        and green_sample_ok
    )
    green_reasons: list[str] = []
    if not map_ok or candidate.green_surface_hash is None or candidate.base_geometry_hash != candidate.geometry_hash:
        green_reasons.append("quality_green_surface_unverified")
    elif not green_registration_ok:
        green_reasons.append("quality_green_registration_residual_exceeded")
    elif not green_cross_source_ok:
        green_reasons.append("quality_green_cross_source_residual_exceeded")
    elif not green_sample_ok:
        green_reasons.append("quality_green_registration_sample_insufficient")
    capabilities = {
        "core.identity": _capability("core.identity", candidate.hole_ref, core_ok, [] if core_ok else (reasons or ["quality_identity_incomplete"]), candidate.evidence_refs, policy),
        "scorecard": _capability("scorecard", candidate.hole_ref, scorecard_ok, [] if scorecard_ok else ["quality_scorecard_invalid"], candidate.evidence_refs, policy),
        "distance": _capability("distance", candidate.hole_ref, distance_ok, [] if distance_ok else ["quality_anchor_unverified"], candidate.evidence_refs, policy),
        "map": _capability("map", candidate.hole_ref, map_ok, [] if map_ok else ["quality_geometry_unverified"], candidate.evidence_refs, policy, required_assets=(() if candidate.geometry_hash is None else (candidate.geometry_hash,))),
        "hazardGuidance": _capability(
            "hazardGuidance",
            candidate.hole_ref,
            hazard_ok,
            [] if hazard_ok else ["quality_hazard_unverified"],
            candidate.evidence_refs,
            policy,
            required_assets=(() if candidate.hazard_hash is None else (candidate.hazard_hash,)),
            optional_assets=(
                ()
                if not playable_regions_ok
                else (candidate.playable_regions_hash,)
            ),
        ),
        "playsLike": _capability("playsLike", candidate.hole_ref, plays_like_ok, [] if plays_like_ok else ["quality_elevation_unverified"], candidate.evidence_refs, policy, required_assets=(() if candidate.elevation_hash is None or candidate.plays_like_model_hash is None else (candidate.elevation_hash, candidate.plays_like_model_hash))),
        "greenSurface": _capability("greenSurface", candidate.hole_ref, green_ok, green_reasons, candidate.evidence_refs, policy, required_assets=(() if candidate.green_surface_hash is None else (candidate.green_surface_hash,))),
    }
    report_payload = {"holeRef": candidate.hole_ref, "capabilities": {key: value.canonical() for key, value in sorted(capabilities.items())}, "minimumRoundMode": "relative_to_par" if scorecard_ok else "gross_only"}
    return HoleQualityReport(candidate.hole_ref, capabilities, str(report_payload["minimumRoundMode"]), typed_id("HoleQualityReport/v1", report_payload))
```

同一步创建下面的 exact schema，并把两个对象 additive-union 进 registry；不得把 `capabilityId` 自身放回 identity payload，也不得用 `includedFields: ["*"]` 隐藏身份边界。

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://aicaddie.local/contracts/course_quality_v1.schema.json",
  "$defs": {
    "snapshotCapability": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": ["capabilityId", "capability", "subjectRef", "dataState", "qualityState", "reasonCodes", "evidenceRefs", "qualityVersion", "sourceLayerIds", "requiredAssetRefs", "optionalAssetRefs"],
      "properties": {
        "capabilityId": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},
        "capability": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "subjectRef": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "dataState": {"enum": ["present", "absent", "intentionally_opaque"]},
        "qualityState": {"enum": ["accepted", "degraded", "blocked"]},
        "reasonCodes": {"type": "array", "uniqueItems": true, "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
        "evidenceRefs": {"type": "array", "uniqueItems": true, "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
        "qualityVersion": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "sourceLayerIds": {"type": "array", "uniqueItems": true, "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
        "requiredAssetRefs": {"type": "array", "uniqueItems": true, "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
        "optionalAssetRefs": {"type": "array", "uniqueItems": true, "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}
      }
    },
    "holeQualityReport": {
```

```python
# tests/course_promotion_fixture.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
from pathlib import Path

from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import CASRef, EncryptedCAS
from ai_caddie.research.deep_mine.promotion import (
    PromotionCandidate,
    TrustedPromotionCandidateRecord,
    TrustedPromotionCandidateStore,
    build_promotion_candidate,
    persist_promotion_candidate,
)
from tests.test_deep_mine_promotion import (
    OWNER_ACCOUNT_ID,
    SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID,
    evidence_fixture,
    put_fixture_parents,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PersistedPromotionFixture:
    candidate: PromotionCandidate
    candidate_ref: CASRef
    parent_refs: tuple[CASRef, ...]
    trusted_record: TrustedPromotionCandidateRecord
    trusted_store: TrustedPromotionCandidateStore

    def close(self) -> None:
        self.trusted_store.close()


def persisted_promotion(
    root: Path,
    cas: EncryptedCAS,
    capability: str,
    *,
    product_role: str | None = None,
    source_roster_hash: str = "d" * 64,
    quality_policy_version: str | None = None,
    course_layout_identity: str = "layout-identity-1",
    layout_revision_id: str = "layout-revision-1",
    hole_global_id: str = "31936-7",
) -> PersistedPromotionFixture:
    if capability not in {"playsLike", "hazardGuidance", "greenSurface"}:
        raise ValueError(capability)
    resolved_role = product_role or {
        "playsLike": "playsLike.model",
        "hazardGuidance": "hazardGuidanceBody",
        "greenSurface": "greenSurfaceGeometry",
    }[capability]
    _raw_ref, proof, fingerprint, unknowns, node, original_binding, evidence = (
        evidence_fixture(capability=capability, product_role=resolved_role)
    )
    binding = replace(
        original_binding,
        source_roster_hash=source_roster_hash,
        course_layout_identity=course_layout_identity,
        layout_revision_id=layout_revision_id,
        hole_global_id=hole_global_id,
    )
    candidate = build_promotion_candidate(
        capability=capability,
        product_role=resolved_role,
        subject_ref=f"hole:{binding.layout_revision_id}:{binding.hole_global_id}",
        projector_id="green-projector",
        quality_policy_version=quality_policy_version or f"{capability}-quality-v1",
        binding=binding,
        closure_proofs=(proof,),
        fingerprints=(fingerprint,),
        unknowns=unknowns,
        nodes={node.node_id: node},
        capability_evidence=evidence,
    )
    parents = put_fixture_parents(cas, binding, capability)
    store = TrustedPromotionCandidateStore.open(root / "trusted", SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID)
    artifact = persist_promotion_candidate(
        candidate,
        cas=cas,
        trusted_candidate_store=store,
        closure_proofs=(proof,),
        fingerprints=(fingerprint,),
        unknowns=unknowns,
        nodes={node.node_id: node},
        owner_account_id=OWNER_ACCOUNT_ID,
        storage_domain_id=SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID,
        parent_refs=parents,
        decoder_version="promotion-fixture-v1",
        build_hash="promotion-fixture-build-v1",
    )
    record = store.get(candidate.candidate_id)
    if artifact.ref != record.artifact.ref:
        store.close()
        raise AssertionError("trusted fixture artifact differs from persisted artifact")
    return PersistedPromotionFixture(candidate, artifact.ref, parents, record, store)
```

```python
# tests/test_course_promotion_admission.py
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import EncryptedCAS, StaticDomainKeyProvider
from ai_caddie.course_data.promotion_admission import (
    PromotionAdmissionError,
    admit_deep_mine_candidate,
)
from ai_caddie.research.deep_mine.promotion import (

    ValidatedPromotionCandidate,
    validate_untrusted_promotion_candidate as plan3_validate,

    OWNER_ACCOUNT_ID,
    SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID,
    PersistedPromotionFixture,
    persisted_promotion,
)


class CoursePromotionAdmissionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.cas = EncryptedCAS(
            self.root / "cas",
            StaticDomainKeyProvider({SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID: b"a" * 32}),
        )
        self.fixture_number = 0

    def fixture(
        self,
        capability: str,
        *,
        quality_policy_version: str | None = None,
    ) -> PersistedPromotionFixture:
        self.fixture_number += 1
        value = persisted_promotion(
            self.root / f"fixture-{self.fixture_number}",
            self.cas,
            capability,
            quality_policy_version=quality_policy_version,
        )
        self.addCleanup(value.close)
        return value

    def admit(
        self,
        value: PersistedPromotionFixture,
        *,
        trusted_store: TrustedPromotionCandidateStore | None = None,
        expected_source_revision_ids: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
        expected_source_roster_hash: str | None = None,
    ):
        binding = value.candidate.binding
        return admit_deep_mine_candidate(
            self.cas,
            trusted_store or value.trusted_store,
            SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID,
            value.candidate_ref,
            candidate_parent_refs=value.parent_refs,
            expected_owner_account_id=OWNER_ACCOUNT_ID,
            expected_course_layout_identity=binding.course_layout_identity,
            expected_layout_revision_id=binding.layout_revision_id,
            expected_hole_global_id=binding.hole_global_id,
            expected_source_revision_ids=(
                binding.source_revision_ids
                if expected_source_revision_ids is None
                else expected_source_revision_ids
            ),
            expected_source_roster_hash=(
                binding.source_roster_hash
                if expected_source_roster_hash is None
                else expected_source_roster_hash
            ),
        )

    def test_all_capabilities_cross_the_real_trusted_plan3_boundary(self) -> None:
        for capability in ("playsLike", "hazardGuidance", "greenSurface"):
            with self.subTest(capability=capability):
                fixture = self.fixture(capability)
                admitted = self.admit(fixture)
                self.assertEqual(admitted.candidate, fixture.candidate)
                self.assertEqual(admitted.parent_refs, fixture.trusted_record.artifact.parent_refs)
                self.assertEqual(
                    admitted.trusted_record_sha256,
                    fixture.trusted_record.record_sha256,
                )
                self.assertEqual(admitted.provenance_ref, fixture.trusted_record.provenance_ref)

    def test_adapter_calls_the_single_public_plan3_validator_once(self) -> None:
        fixture = self.fixture("playsLike")
        with patch(
            "ai_caddie.course_data.promotion_admission.validate_untrusted_promotion_candidate",
            wraps=plan3_validate,
        ) as boundary:
            admitted = self.admit(fixture)
        boundary.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(admitted.candidate_id, fixture.candidate.candidate_id)

    def test_empty_or_other_domain_trusted_store_fails_closed(self) -> None:
        fixture = self.fixture("greenSurface")
        empty = TrustedPromotionCandidateStore.open(self.root / "empty", SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID)
        self.addCleanup(empty.close)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PromotionAdmissionError, "trusted Track C store"):
            self.admit(fixture, trusted_store=empty)

    def test_source_roster_and_complete_source_revision_context_are_required(self) -> None:
        fixture = self.fixture("hazardGuidance")
        with self.assertRaises(PromotionAdmissionError):
            self.admit(
                fixture,
                expected_source_revision_ids=("source-revision-base",),
            )
        with self.assertRaises(PromotionAdmissionError):
            self.admit(fixture, expected_source_roster_hash="0" * 64)

    def test_supplied_candidate_ref_must_equal_the_trusted_artifact_ref(self) -> None:
        fixture = self.fixture("playsLike")
        other = self.fixture("greenSurface")
        forged_result = ValidatedPromotionCandidate(
            fixture.candidate,
            fixture.parent_refs,
            other.trusted_record,
        )
        with patch(
            "ai_caddie.course_data.promotion_admission.validate_untrusted_promotion_candidate",
            return_value=forged_result,
        ), self.assertRaisesRegex(PromotionAdmissionError, "trusted artifact"):
            self.admit(fixture)

    def test_plan2_policy_allowlist_is_applied_after_plan3_validation(self) -> None:
        fixture = self.fixture(
            "playsLike",
            quality_policy_version="playsLike-quality-v99",
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PromotionAdmissionError, "quality policy"):
            self.admit(fixture)

    def test_outer_candidate_cas_identity_is_checked_before_plan3(self) -> None:
        fixture = self.fixture("playsLike")
        wrong_ref = replace(fixture.candidate_ref, byte_domain="raw-entity")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(PromotionAdmissionError, "candidate CAS identity"):
            admit_deep_mine_candidate(
                self.cas,
                fixture.trusted_store,
                SECURITY_DOMAIN_ID,
                wrong_ref,
                candidate_parent_refs=fixture.parent_refs,
                expected_owner_account_id=OWNER_ACCOUNT_ID,
                expected_course_layout_identity=fixture.candidate.binding.course_layout_identity,
                expected_layout_revision_id=fixture.candidate.binding.layout_revision_id,

                expected_source_revision_ids=fixture.candidate.binding.source_revision_ids,
                expected_source_roster_hash=fixture.candidate.binding.source_roster_hash,
            )
```
