```python
# append to server_v2/course_repo.py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Sequence

from sqlalchemy import and_, or_

from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import CASDeletionReceipt, CASRef
from ai_caddie.course_data.channels import PurgeDirective
from server_v2.course_models import (
    CourseDeviceInstallRow,
    CourseGCGenerationRow,
    CourseGCObjectRow,
    CoursePurgeDirectiveRow,
    CoursePurgeTransitionRow,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PurgeStateView:
    directive: CoursePurgeDirectiveRow
    install: CourseDeviceInstallRow
    state: str


class CoursePurgeRepo:
    def __init__(self, session: Session) -> None:
        self.session = session

    def _locked(self, directive_id: str) -> tuple[CoursePurgeDirectiveRow, CourseDeviceInstallRow]:
        directive = self.session.scalar(select(CoursePurgeDirectiveRow).where(CoursePurgeDirectiveRow.id == directive_id).with_for_update())
        if directive is None:
            raise KeyError(directive_id)
        install = self.session.scalar(select(CourseDeviceInstallRow).where(CourseDeviceInstallRow.id == directive.install_id).with_for_update())
        if install is None:
            raise RuntimeError("purge install disappeared")
        return directive, install

    def _append_transition(self, directive: CoursePurgeDirectiveRow, state: str, evidence_ref: str | None = None) -> None:
        directive.transition_generation += 1
        self.session.add(CoursePurgeTransitionRow(
            directive_id=directive.id,
            transition_generation=directive.transition_generation,
            state=state,
            evidence_ref=evidence_ref,
            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        ))

    def begin(self, directive: PurgeDirective, *, install_id: str, expected_install_generation: int, signed_envelope: str) -> PurgeStateView:
        existing = self.session.get(CoursePurgeDirectiveRow, directive.id)
        if existing is not None:
            if existing.install_id != install_id or existing.generation != directive.generation or existing.target_refs != list(directive.scope_refs) or existing.signed_envelope != signed_envelope:
                raise ValueError("purge idempotency content mismatch")
            return self.resume(directive.id)
        install = self.session.scalar(select(CourseDeviceInstallRow).where(CourseDeviceInstallRow.id == install_id).with_for_update())
        if install is None or install.account_id != directive.account_id or install.generation != expected_install_generation:
            raise ValueError("purge install generation/owner compare-and-swap failed")
        if install.rights in {"revoked", "purge_pending"}:
            raise ValueError("purge install is already blocked")
        row = CoursePurgeDirectiveRow(
            id=directive.id,
            account_id=directive.account_id,
            security_domain_id=directive.security_domain_id,
            install_id=install_id,
            generation=directive.generation,
            transition_generation=0,
            state="rights_blocked",
            target_refs=sorted(set(directive.scope_refs)),
            erased_refs=[],
            server_status="pending",
            device_status="device_pending",
            signed_envelope=signed_envelope,
        )
        install.rights = "purge_pending"
        install.generation += 1
        self.session.add(row)
        self.session.flush()
        self._append_transition(row, "rights_blocked")
        self.session.flush()
        return PurgeStateView(row, install, row.state)

    def resume(self, directive_id: str) -> PurgeStateView:
        directive, install = self._locked(directive_id)
        return PurgeStateView(directive, install, directive.state)

    def record_server_erasure(self, directive_id: str, receipt: CASDeletionReceipt) -> PurgeStateView:
        if not isinstance(receipt, CASDeletionReceipt):
            raise TypeError("server erasure requires CASDeletionReceipt")
        directive, install = self._locked(directive_id)
        object_ref = f"{receipt.ref.storage_domain_id}:{receipt.ref.byte_domain}:{receipt.ref.sha256}:{receipt.ref.size}"
        if receipt.ref.storage_domain_id != directive.security_domain_id or object_ref not in directive.target_refs:
            raise PermissionError("CAS deletion receipt is outside purge scope")
        erased = set(directive.erased_refs)
        if object_ref not in erased:
            erased.add(object_ref)
            directive.erased_refs = sorted(erased)
            self._append_transition(directive, "object_erased", receipt.receipt_id)
        if erased == set(directive.target_refs):
            directive.server_status = "server_erased"
            directive.state = "server_erased"
            install.materialization = "absent"
            install.rights = "revoked"
            install.generation += 1
            self._append_transition(directive, "server_erased")
        self.session.flush()
        return PurgeStateView(directive, install, directive.state)

    def record_device_ack(self, directive_id: str, *, authenticated_account_id: str, authenticated_device_id: str, ack_id: str) -> PurgeStateView:
        directive, install = self._locked(directive_id)
        if install.account_id != authenticated_account_id or install.device_id != authenticated_device_id:
            raise PermissionError("purge ACK device/account mismatch")
        if directive.device_status != "device_acknowledged":
            directive.device_status = "device_acknowledged"
            self._append_transition(directive, "device_acknowledged", ack_id)
        if directive.server_status == "server_erased":
            directive.state = "complete"
            self._append_transition(directive, "complete")
        self.session.flush()
        return PurgeStateView(directive, install, directive.state)


class CourseGCRepo:
    def __init__(self, session: Session) -> None:
        self.session = session

    def register_object(self, ref: CASRef, *, created_generation: int) -> CourseGCObjectRow:
        object_ref = f"{ref.storage_domain_id}:{ref.byte_domain}:{ref.sha256}:{ref.size}"
        row = self.session.get(CourseGCObjectRow, object_ref)
        if row is not None:
            if (row.storage_domain_id, row.byte_domain, row.sha256, row.size, row.created_generation) != (ref.storage_domain_id, ref.byte_domain, ref.sha256, ref.size, created_generation):
                raise ValueError("GC object identity mismatch")
            return row
        row = CourseGCObjectRow(object_ref=object_ref, storage_domain_id=ref.storage_domain_id, byte_domain=ref.byte_domain, sha256=ref.sha256, size=ref.size, created_generation=created_generation, delete_state="live")
        self.session.add(row)
        self.session.flush()
        return row

    def start_mark(self, generation: int, *, roots: set[str], subtract_refs: set[str]) -> CourseGCGenerationRow:
        row = self.session.scalar(select(CourseGCGenerationRow).where(CourseGCGenerationRow.generation == generation).with_for_update())
        normalized_roots = sorted(roots - subtract_refs)
        normalized_subtract = sorted(subtract_refs)
        if row is not None:
            if row.marked_refs != normalized_roots or row.subtract_refs != normalized_subtract:
                raise ValueError("GC generation content mismatch")
            return row
        previous = self.session.scalar(select(CourseGCGenerationRow).order_by(CourseGCGenerationRow.generation.desc()).limit(1).with_for_update())
        if previous is not None and (generation != previous.generation + 1 or previous.state != "complete"):
            raise ValueError("GC generations must be contiguous and previous generation complete")
        if previous is None and generation != 1:
            raise ValueError("first GC generation must be 1")
        row = CourseGCGenerationRow(generation=generation, marked_refs=normalized_roots, subtract_refs=normalized_subtract, state="marking")
        self.session.add(row)
        self.session.flush()
        self.session.execute(
            CourseGCObjectRow.__table__.update().where(CourseGCObjectRow.object_ref.in_(normalized_roots)).values(marked_generation=generation)
        )
        row.state = "marked"
        self.session.flush()
        return row

    def claim_next(self, generation: int) -> CourseGCObjectRow | None:
        gc = self.session.scalar(select(CourseGCGenerationRow).where(CourseGCGenerationRow.generation == generation).with_for_update())
        if gc is None or gc.state not in {"marked", "sweeping"}:
            raise ValueError("GC generation is not sweepable")
        gc.state = "sweeping"
        candidate = self.session.scalar(select(CourseGCObjectRow).where(
            CourseGCObjectRow.created_generation <= generation,
            CourseGCObjectRow.marked_generation != generation,
            or_(CourseGCObjectRow.delete_state == "live", and_(CourseGCObjectRow.delete_state == "deleting", CourseGCObjectRow.delete_generation == generation)),
        ).order_by(CourseGCObjectRow.object_ref).limit(1).with_for_update(skip_locked=True))
        if candidate is None:
            gc.state = "complete"
            self.session.flush()
            return None
        candidate.delete_state = "deleting"
        candidate.delete_generation = generation
        self.session.flush()
        return candidate

    def record_deleted(self, generation: int, receipt: CASDeletionReceipt) -> None:
        object_ref = f"{receipt.ref.storage_domain_id}:{receipt.ref.byte_domain}:{receipt.ref.sha256}:{receipt.ref.size}"
        row = self.session.scalar(select(CourseGCObjectRow).where(CourseGCObjectRow.object_ref == object_ref).with_for_update())
        if row is None or row.delete_generation != generation or row.delete_state != "deleting":
            raise ValueError("GC deletion receipt has no matching claim")
        row.delete_state = "deleted"
        self.session.flush()
```

```python
# ai_caddie/course_data/gc.py
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import AbstractContextManager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Callable

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import CASRef, EncryptedCAS
from server_v2.course_repo import CourseGCRepo


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GCInventory:
    channel_refs: set[str]
    grant_refs: set[str]
    installed_records: list[dict[str, object]]
    pin_refs: set[str]
    audit_refs: set[str]
    staging_refs: set[str]
    build_lease_refs: set[str]
    purge_subtract_refs: set[str]


def calculate_roots(inventory: GCInventory) -> set[str]:
    roots = set().union(inventory.channel_refs, inventory.grant_refs, inventory.pin_refs, inventory.audit_refs, inventory.staging_refs, inventory.build_lease_refs)
    for record in inventory.installed_records:
        if record["materialization"] == "installed":
            roots.update(map(str, record["requiredAssetRefs"]))
    return roots - inventory.purge_subtract_refs


class DurableGCExecutor:
    def __init__(self, session_scope: Callable[[], AbstractContextManager[Session]], cas: EncryptedCAS) -> None:
        self.session_scope = session_scope
        self.cas = cas

    def run(self, generation: int) -> int:
        deleted = 0
        while True:
            with self.session_scope() as session:
                candidate = CourseGCRepo(session).claim_next(generation)
                if candidate is None:
                    return deleted
                ref = CASRef(candidate.storage_domain_id, candidate.byte_domain, candidate.sha256, candidate.size)
            receipt = self.cas.delete_ref(ref.storage_domain_id, ref)
            with self.session_scope() as session:
                CourseGCRepo(session).record_deleted(generation, receipt)
            deleted += 1
```

```python
# ai_caddie/course_data/config.py
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Mapping

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey, Ed25519PublicKey

from ai_caddie.course_data.install_manifest import AcceptedControlGenerations, verify_and_apply_signing_key_rotation
from ai_caddie.course_data.rights import RightsDecision, RightsMatrix, RightsOperation, RightsRule
from ai_caddie.course_data.signing import Ed25519TrustStore, SignedWireEnvelope, SigningIdentity, unb64u


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CourseRuntimeConfig:
    database_url: str
    cas_root: Path
    trusted_promotion_root: Path
    rights_rules: tuple[RightsRule, ...]
    signing_identity: SigningIdentity
    signing_rotation_envelopes: tuple[dict[str, str], ...]
    public_base_url: str
    trusted_time_max_offline_seconds: int
    trusted_time_max_forward_skew_seconds: int

    @classmethod
    def from_environment(cls, environment: Mapping[str, str]) -> "CourseRuntimeConfig":
        required = ["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL", "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_CAS_ROOT", "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_TRUSTED_PROMOTION_ROOT", "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_RIGHTS_JSON", "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_KEY_ID", "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_SEED_B64", "AI_CADDIE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL"]
        missing = [name for name in required if not environment.get(name)]
        if missing:
            raise RuntimeError(f"missing course runtime configuration: {','.join(missing)}")
        raw_rules = json.loads(environment["AI_CADDIE_COURSE_RIGHTS_JSON"])
        if not isinstance(raw_rules, list):
            raise RuntimeError("AI_CADDIE_COURSE_RIGHTS_JSON must be a list")
        rules = tuple(RightsRule(
            provider=str(row["provider"]), asset_class=str(row["assetClass"]), operation=RightsOperation(str(row["operation"])),
            decision=RightsDecision(str(row["decision"])), scope={str(k): str(v) for k, v in row.get("scope", {}).items()},
            evidence_ref=str(row["evidenceRef"]), policy_version=str(row["policyVersion"]),
        ) for row in raw_rules)
        RightsMatrix(list(rules))
        seed = base64.b64decode(environment["AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_SEED_B64"], validate=True)
        if len(seed) != 32:
            raise RuntimeError("course signing seed must contain 32 bytes")
        offline = int(environment.get("AI_CADDIE_TRUSTED_TIME_MAX_OFFLINE_SECONDS", "86400"))
        skew = int(environment.get("AI_CADDIE_TRUSTED_TIME_MAX_FORWARD_SKEW_SECONDS", "300"))
        if not 0 <= offline <= 9_007_199_254_740_991 or not 0 <= skew <= 9_007_199_254_740_991:
            raise RuntimeError("trusted-time bounds exceed canonical safe integer")
        raw_rotations = json.loads(environment.get("AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_ROTATIONS_JSON", "[]"))
        if not isinstance(raw_rotations, list) or any(not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"protectedB64u", "payloadId", "payloadB64u", "signatureB64u"} or any(not isinstance(value, str) for value in row.values()) for row in raw_rotations):
            raise RuntimeError("AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_ROTATIONS_JSON must contain exact signed envelopes")
        identity = SigningIdentity(environment["AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_KEY_ID"], Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(seed))
        if raw_rotations:
            raw_roots = json.loads(environment.get("AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_ROOTS_JSON", "null"))
            if not isinstance(raw_roots, list) or not raw_roots or any(not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != {"keyId", "publicKeyB64u"} or not all(isinstance(value, str) and value for value in row.values()) for row in raw_roots):
                raise RuntimeError("rotation chain requires exact AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_ROOTS_JSON")
            root_keys: dict[str, Ed25519PublicKey] = {}
            for row in raw_roots:
                try:
                    public_bytes = unb64u(row["publicKeyB64u"])
                    if len(public_bytes) != 32 or row["keyId"] in root_keys:
                        raise ValueError("duplicate or invalid root key")
                    root_keys[row["keyId"]] = Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(public_bytes)
                except ValueError as exc:
                    raise RuntimeError("course signing root key is invalid") from exc
            trust = Ed25519TrustStore.from_public_keys(
                root_keys,
                allowed={(key_id, "SigningKeyRotation", 1, "Ed25519") for key_id in root_keys},
                root_key_ids=set(root_keys),
            )
            generations = AcceptedControlGenerations()
            try:
                for row in raw_rotations:
                    verify_and_apply_signing_key_rotation(SignedWireEnvelope.from_control_wire(row), trust, audience="course-clients", generations=generations)
            except (PermissionError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise RuntimeError("course signing rotation chain is incomplete, unordered, or invalid") from exc
            active_public = identity.private_key.public_key().public_bytes_raw()
            trusted_active = trust.keys.get(identity.key_id)
            required_bindings = {"CourseDiscoveryContext", "SnapshotGrant", "CourseReleaseChannel", "CourseStaticAuthorityBundle", "CourseInstallReservation", "SafetyPolicy", "PurgeDirective", "TrustedTimeToken", "CourseInstallManifest"}
            if trusted_active is None or trusted_active.public_bytes_raw() != active_public or any((identity.key_id, type_name, 1, "Ed25519") not in trust.allowed for type_name in required_bindings):
                raise RuntimeError("configured active course signing key is not the final fully-bound rotated leaf")
        return cls(
            database_url=environment["AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL"],
            cas_root=Path(environment["AI_CADDIE_COURSE_CAS_ROOT"]),
            trusted_promotion_root=Path(environment["AI_CADDIE_COURSE_TRUSTED_PROMOTION_ROOT"]),
            rights_rules=rules,
            signing_identity=identity,
            signing_rotation_envelopes=tuple(dict(row) for row in raw_rotations),
            public_base_url=environment["AI_CADDIE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/"),
            trusted_time_max_offline_seconds=offline,
            trusted_time_max_forward_skew_seconds=skew,
        )
```

```python
# tests/test_course_runtime_config.py
from __future__ import annotations

import base64
from copy import deepcopy
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest

from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey

from ai_caddie.course_data.config import CourseRuntimeConfig
from ai_caddie.course_data.install_manifest import sign_control
from ai_caddie.course_data.signing import SigningIdentity, b64u


class CourseRuntimeConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.fixture = json.loads(Path("contracts/canonical/fixtures/course_signed_controls_golden.json").read_text())

    def environment(self, chain: list[dict[str, str]], *, active_seed: str, active_key_id: str) -> dict[str, str]:
        root = Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(bytes.fromhex(self.fixture["rootPrivateKeySeedHex"]))
        return {
            "AI_CADDIE_DATABASE_URL": "sqlite://",
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_CAS_ROOT": tempfile.gettempdir(),
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_TRUSTED_PROMOTION_ROOT": str(Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "trusted-promotions"),
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_RIGHTS_JSON": "[]",
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_KEY_ID": active_key_id,
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_SEED_B64": base64.b64encode(bytes.fromhex(active_seed)).decode("ascii"),
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_ROOTS_JSON": json.dumps([{"keyId": "course-root-2026", "publicKeyB64u": b64u(root.public_key().public_bytes_raw())}], separators=(",", ":")),
            "AI_CADDIE_COURSE_SIGNING_ROTATIONS_JSON": json.dumps(chain, separators=(",", ":")),
            "AI_CADDIE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL": "https://course.example.test",
        }

    def test_complete_ordered_chain_must_end_at_the_active_fully_bound_leaf(self) -> None:
        chain = [row["envelope"] for row in self.fixture["rotationChain"]]
        config = CourseRuntimeConfig.from_environment(self.environment(chain, active_seed=self.fixture["newLeaf2PrivateKeySeedHex"], active_key_id="course-leaf-2028"))
        self.assertEqual(config.signing_identity.key_id, "course-leaf-2028")
        self.assertEqual(config.signing_rotation_envelopes, tuple(chain))

    def test_missing_reversed_duplicate_or_wrong_active_chain_fails_closed(self) -> None:
        chain = [row["envelope"] for row in self.fixture["rotationChain"]]
        cases = [chain[1:], list(reversed(chain)), [chain[0], chain[0]], chain]
        active = [
            (self.fixture["newLeaf2PrivateKeySeedHex"], "course-leaf-2028"),
            (self.fixture["newLeaf2PrivateKeySeedHex"], "course-leaf-2028"),
            (self.fixture["newLeafPrivateKeySeedHex"], "course-leaf-2027"),
            (self.fixture["newLeafPrivateKeySeedHex"], "course-leaf-2027"),
        ]
        for rows, (seed, key_id) in zip(cases, active, strict=True):
            with self.subTest(rows=len(rows), key_id=key_id), self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                CourseRuntimeConfig.from_environment(self.environment(rows, active_seed=seed, active_key_id=key_id))

    def test_rotation_without_manifest_binding_is_rejected_even_when_signature_is_valid(self) -> None:
        payload = deepcopy(self.fixture["rotationChain"][0]["payload"])
        payload["allowedBindings"] = [row for row in payload["allowedBindings"] if row["type"] != "CourseInstallManifest"]
        root = SigningIdentity("course-root-2026", Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(bytes.fromhex(self.fixture["rootPrivateKeySeedHex"])))
        envelope = sign_control("SigningKeyRotation", payload, root).control_canonical()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "fully-bound"):
            CourseRuntimeConfig.from_environment(self.environment([envelope], active_seed=self.fixture["newLeafPrivateKeySeedHex"], active_key_id="course-leaf-2027"))
```

```python
# server_v2/course_service_backend.py
from __future__ import annotations

from contextlib import AbstractContextManager
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import json
from typing import Callable, Mapping

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from ai_caddie.contracts.canonical_json import canonical_json_bytes
from ai_caddie.contracts.typed_ids import typed_id
from ai_caddie.course_data.build_queue import BuildJobKind, BuildQueue
from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import CASRef, EncryptedCAS
from ai_caddie.course_data.channels import TrustedTimeToken
from ai_caddie.course_data.install_manifest import sign_control
from ai_caddie.course_data.rights import RightsMatrix, RightsOperation
from ai_caddie.course_data.security_domains import CourseSourceRoster, SemanticBuildKey
from ai_caddie.course_data.signing import SigningIdentity
from server_v2.account_context import AccountContext
from server_v2.course_api_models import CourseBuildRequest, CourseInstallAckRequest
from server_v2.course_models import (
    CourseBuildJobRow,
    CourseChannelHeadRow,
    CourseChannelRow,
    CourseDeviceInstallRow,
    CourseInstallManifestRow,
    CourseLayoutRevisionRow,
    CourseLayoutRow,
    CourseOpaqueAssetRow,
    CoursePromotionCandidateAssociationRow,
    CourseSnapshotGrantRow,
    CourseSourceHeadRow,
    CourseSourceRevisionRow,
    CourseTeeSelectionRow,
    CourseTrustedTimeHeadRow,
    CourseVenueRow,
)
from server_v2.course_service import AssetMetadata, AuthorizedAssetLease
from server_v2.course_repo import (
    CoursePromotionAssociationRepo,
    TrustedPromotionStoreFactory,
)


def _utc(value: str) -> datetime:
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))


class SqlCourseBackend:
    def __init__(self, session_scope: Callable[[], AbstractContextManager[Session]], cas: EncryptedCAS, rights: RightsMatrix, signing_identity: SigningIdentity, trusted_promotion_stores: TrustedPromotionStoreFactory, *, rotation_envelopes: tuple[dict[str, str], ...], max_offline_seconds: int, max_forward_skew_seconds: int) -> None:
        self.session_scope = session_scope
        self.cas = cas
        self.rights = rights
        self.signing_identity = signing_identity
        self.trusted_promotion_stores = trusted_promotion_stores
        self.rotation_envelopes = tuple(dict(value) for value in rotation_envelopes)
        self.max_offline_seconds = max_offline_seconds
        self.max_forward_skew_seconds = max_forward_skew_seconds

    def _grant(self, session: Session, account: AccountContext, *, lock: bool = False) -> CourseSnapshotGrantRow:
        statement = select(CourseSnapshotGrantRow).where(CourseSnapshotGrantRow.account_id == account.account_id).order_by(CourseSnapshotGrantRow.generation.desc()).limit(1)
        if lock:
            statement = statement.with_for_update()
        row = session.scalar(statement)
        if row is None or _utc(str(row.payload["expiresAt"])) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
            raise PermissionError("no active SnapshotGrant")
        return row

    @staticmethod
    def _latest_revision(session: Session, layout_id: str) -> CourseLayoutRevisionRow | None:
        return session.scalar(select(CourseLayoutRevisionRow).where(CourseLayoutRevisionRow.layout_identity_id == layout_id).order_by(CourseLayoutRevisionRow.created_at.desc(), CourseLayoutRevisionRow.id.desc()).limit(1))

    @staticmethod
    def _channel(session: Session, domain_id: str, layout_id: str) -> CourseChannelRow | None:
        head = session.get(CourseChannelHeadRow, {"security_domain_id": domain_id, "layout_identity_id": layout_id})
        return None if head is None or head.channel_row_id is None else session.get(CourseChannelRow, head.channel_row_id)

    @staticmethod
    def _jobs(session: Session, domain_id: str, layout_id: str, profile_id: str) -> tuple[CourseBuildJobRow | None, CourseBuildJobRow | None]:
        rows = session.scalars(select(CourseBuildJobRow).where(CourseBuildJobRow.security_domain_id == domain_id).order_by(CourseBuildJobRow.created_at.desc())).all()
        semantic = next((row for row in rows if row.job_kind == "semantic" and row.payload.get("courseLayoutIdentityId") == layout_id), None)
        profile = next((row for row in rows if row.job_kind == "profile" and row.payload.get("courseLayoutIdentityId") == layout_id and row.payload.get("profileId") == profile_id), None)
        return semantic, profile

    @staticmethod
    def _layout_base_entries(
        session: Session,
        *,
        account_id: str,
        security_domain_id: str,
        revision: CourseLayoutRevisionRow,
        lock: bool,
    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        provider_refs: list[str] = []
        for binding in revision.ordered_bindings:
            provider_ref = str(binding["providerCourseRefId"])
            if provider_ref not in provider_refs:
                provider_refs.append(provider_ref)
        if not provider_refs:
            raise ValueError("layout revision has no provider bindings")
        entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
        for provider_ref in provider_refs:
            statement = select(CourseSourceHeadRow).where(
                CourseSourceHeadRow.account_id == account_id,
                CourseSourceHeadRow.security_domain_id == security_domain_id,
                CourseSourceHeadRow.provider_course_ref_id == provider_ref,
                CourseSourceHeadRow.source_branch == "current",
            )
            if lock:
                statement = statement.with_for_update()
            head = session.scalar(statement)
            if (
                head is None
                or head.accepted_revision_id is None
                or head.availability_overlay != "available"
                or head.generation < 1
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "layout provider has no available accepted current SourceHead"
                )
            entries.append({
                "ordinal": len(entries),
                "role": "layoutBase",
                "providerCourseRefId": provider_ref,
                "sourceBranch": "current",
                "headGeneration": head.generation,
                "sourceRevisionId": head.accepted_revision_id,
            })
        return entries

    def _current_roster_and_associations(
        self,
        session: Session,
        *,
        account_id: str,
        security_domain_id: str,
        layout: CourseLayoutRow,
        revision: CourseLayoutRevisionRow,
        lock: bool,
    ) -> tuple[CourseSourceRoster, list[dict[str, object]]]:
        association_repo = CoursePromotionAssociationRepo(
            session,
            self.cas,
            self.trusted_promotion_stores,
        )
        base_entries = self._layout_base_entries(
            session,
            account_id=account_id,
            security_domain_id=security_domain_id,
            revision=revision,
            lock=lock,
        )
        base_roster = CourseSourceRoster.create(revision.id, base_entries)
        active = association_repo.active_for_layout(
            account_id=account_id,
            security_domain_id=security_domain_id,
            course_layout_identity=layout.id,
            layout_revision_id=revision.id,
        )
        if not active:
            return base_roster, []

        cohorts = {
            (
                row.source_roster_hash,
                canonical_json_bytes(row.source_roster),
                tuple(row.source_revision_ids),
            )
            for row in active
        }
        if len(cohorts) != 1:
            return base_roster, []
        first = active[0]
        promotion_roster = CourseSourceRoster.create(
            revision.id,
            first.source_roster,
        )
        expected_source_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(
            str(entry["sourceRevisionId"])
            for entry in promotion_roster.entries
        ))
        if (
            promotion_roster.id != first.source_roster_hash
            or expected_source_ids != first.source_revision_ids
            or list(promotion_roster.entries[:len(base_entries)])
            != base_entries
            or len(promotion_roster.entries) < len(base_entries)
        ):
            return base_roster, []
        for association in active:
            if (
                association.source_roster_hash != promotion_roster.id
                or association.source_revision_ids != expected_source_ids
                or association.source_roster != list(promotion_roster.entries)
            ):
                return base_roster, []
            if lock:
                association_repo.require_current_roster(
                    account_id=account_id,
                    security_domain_id=security_domain_id,
                    layout_revision_id=revision.id,
                    entries=association.source_roster,
                    lock=True,
                )
        claims = [association_repo.canonical(row) for row in active]
        return promotion_roster, sorted(
            claims,
            key=lambda row: (
                str(row["holeGlobalId"]),
                str(row["capability"]),
                int(row["associationId"]),
            ),
        )

    def search(
        self,
        account: AccountContext,
        query: str,
        profile_id: str,
    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        with self.session_scope() as session:
            grant = self._grant(session, account)
            layouts = session.execute(
                select(CourseLayoutRow, CourseVenueRow)
                .join(
                    CourseVenueRow,
                    CourseVenueRow.id == CourseLayoutRow.venue_identity_id,
                )
                .where(
                    func.lower(CourseVenueRow.display_name).contains(
                        query.lower()
                    )
                )
                .order_by(CourseVenueRow.display_name, CourseLayoutRow.id)
            ).all()
            results: list[dict[str, object]] = []
            for layout, venue in layouts:
                revision = self._latest_revision(session, layout.id)
                base_entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
                if revision is not None:
                    try:
                        base_entries = self._layout_base_entries(
                            session,
                            account_id=account.account_id,
                            security_domain_id=grant.security_domain_id,
                            revision=revision,
                            lock=False,
                        )
                    except ValueError:
                        base_entries = []
                provider_ref = (
                    ""
                    if not base_entries
                    else str(base_entries[0]["providerCourseRefId"])
                )
                channel = self._channel(
                    session,
                    grant.security_domain_id,
                    layout.id,
                )
                semantic_job, profile_job = self._jobs(
                    session,
                    grant.security_domain_id,
                    layout.id,
                    profile_id,
                )
                snapshot_state = (
                    "ready"
                    if channel is not None
                    else "building"
                    if semantic_job is not None
                    and semantic_job.state in {"queued", "running"}
                    else "absent"
                )
                manifest_id = (
                    None
                    if channel is None
                    else channel.install_manifest_ids.get(profile_id)
                )
                profile_state = (
                    "ready"
                    if manifest_id
                    else "building"
                    if profile_job is not None
                    and profile_job.state in {"queued", "running"}
                    else "buildable"
                    if revision is not None and base_entries
                    else "absent"
                )
                top = (
                    "ready"
                    if snapshot_state == profile_state == "ready"
                    else "buildable"
                    if profile_state in {"buildable", "building"}
                    else "metadata_only"
                )
                minimum_client = "1.0.0"
                if manifest_id:
                    manifest = session.get(
                        CourseInstallManifestRow,
                        manifest_id,
                    )
                    if manifest is not None:
                        minimum_client = str(
                            manifest.payload["minimumClient"]
                        )
                results.append({
                    "providerCourseRefId": provider_ref,
                    "venueIdentityId": venue.id,
                    "courseLayoutIdentityId": layout.id,
                    "catalogScope": (
                        "shared"
                        if grant.payload["kind"] == "shared"
                        else "account"
                    ),
                    "accountId": account.account_id,
                    "grantState": "allowed",
                    "sourceHeadGeneration": max(
                        (
                            int(entry["headGeneration"])
                            for entry in base_entries
                        ),
                        default=0,
                    ),
                    "snapshotState": snapshot_state,
                    "requestedProfileState": profile_state,
                    "profileId": profile_id,
                    "minimumClient": minimum_client,
                    "snapshotBuildJobId": (
                        None if semantic_job is None else semantic_job.id
                    ),
                    "profileBuildJobId": (
                        None if profile_job is None else profile_job.id
                    ),
                    "topLevelState": top,
                })
            return results
    def enqueue_build(self, account: AccountContext, request: CourseBuildRequest) -> dict[str, object]:
        with self.session_scope() as session:
            grant = self._grant(session, account, lock=True)
            layout = session.get(CourseLayoutRow, request.courseLayoutIdentityId)
            revision = session.get(CourseLayoutRevisionRow, request.layoutRevisionId)
            tee = session.get(CourseTeeSelectionRow, request.teeSelectionId)
            if layout is None or revision is None or revision.layout_identity_id != layout.id or tee is None or tee.layout_revision_id != revision.id:
                raise KeyError("layout revision not found")
            roster, candidate_associations = self._current_roster_and_associations(
                session,
                account_id=account.account_id,
                security_domain_id=grant.security_domain_id,
                layout=layout,
                revision=revision,
                lock=True,
            )
            semantic_payload = {
                "accountId": account.account_id,
                "securityDomainId": grant.security_domain_id,
                "courseLayoutIdentityId": layout.id,
                "layoutRevisionId": revision.id,
                "teeSelectionId": request.teeSelectionId,
                "sourceRoster": roster.canonical(),
                "rightsPolicyVersion": grant.payload["rightsPolicyVersion"],
                "grantGeneration": grant.generation,
                "promotionCandidateAssociations": candidate_associations,
                "requestedProfileIds": ["ios-v1", "watch-v1", "web-v1"],
            }
            semantic_key = SemanticBuildKey.create(
                grant.security_domain_id,
                revision.id,
                roster,
                ["garmin-wire/v1"],
                ["semantic-v1"],
                candidate_associations,
            ).id
            semantic = BuildQueue(session).enqueue(BuildJobKind.SEMANTIC, grant.security_domain_id, semantic_key, semantic_payload)
            _, profile = self._jobs(session, grant.security_domain_id, layout.id, request.profileId)
            channel = self._channel(session, grant.security_domain_id, layout.id)
            return {"snapshotBuildJobId": semantic.id, "profileBuildJobId": None if profile is None else profile.id, "snapshotState": "ready" if channel is not None else "building", "requestedProfileState": "ready" if channel is not None and request.profileId in channel.install_manifest_ids else "building"}

    def build_status(self, account: AccountContext, job_id: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        with self.session_scope() as session:
            grant = self._grant(session, account)
            row = session.get(CourseBuildJobRow, job_id)
            if row is None or row.security_domain_id != grant.security_domain_id:
                raise KeyError(job_id)
            return {"jobId": row.id, "jobKind": row.job_kind, "state": row.state, "resultRef": row.result_ref, "reasonCode": row.error_code}

    def _trusted_time(self, session: Session, grant: CourseSnapshotGrantRow) -> str:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        head = session.scalar(select(CourseTrustedTimeHeadRow).where(CourseTrustedTimeHeadRow.audience == grant.account_id).with_for_update())
        generation = 1 if head is None else head.generation + 1
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
        offline_not_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=self.max_offline_seconds)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
        token = TrustedTimeToken(grant.account_id, stamp, generation, self.max_offline_seconds, offline_not_after, stamp, f"time:{grant.account_id}", str(grant.payload["rightsPolicyVersion"]), self.max_forward_skew_seconds)
        envelope = token.sign(self.signing_identity)
        wire = json.dumps(envelope.control_canonical(), separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)
        if head is None:
            head = CourseTrustedTimeHeadRow(audience=grant.account_id, generation=generation, server_time=now, signed_envelope=wire)
            session.add(head)
        else:
            head.generation, head.server_time, head.signed_envelope = generation, now, wire
        session.flush()
        return wire

    def manifest(self, account: AccountContext, layout_id: str, profile_id: str) -> dict[str, object]:
        with self.session_scope() as session:
            grant = self._grant(session, account, lock=True)
            channel = self._channel(session, grant.security_domain_id, layout_id)
            if channel is None or profile_id not in channel.install_manifest_ids:
                raise KeyError((layout_id, profile_id))
            manifest = session.get(CourseInstallManifestRow, channel.install_manifest_ids[profile_id])
            if manifest is None or manifest.security_domain_id != grant.security_domain_id or manifest.snapshot_id != channel.snapshot_id:
                raise RuntimeError("channel manifest binding is corrupt")
            return {"channelGeneration": channel.generation, "rotationEnvelopes": [dict(value) for value in self.rotation_envelopes], "grantEnvelope": json.loads(grant.signed_envelope), "channelEnvelope": json.loads(channel.signed_envelope), "manifestEnvelope": json.loads(manifest.canonical_envelope), "trustedTimeEnvelope": json.loads(self._trusted_time(session, grant))}

    def open_authorized_asset(self, account: AccountContext, opaque_asset_id: str) -> AuthorizedAssetLease:
        with self.session_scope() as session:
            grant = self._grant(session, account, lock=True)
            mapping = session.scalar(select(CourseOpaqueAssetRow).where(CourseOpaqueAssetRow.opaque_asset_id == opaque_asset_id).with_for_update())
            if mapping is None or mapping.security_domain_id != grant.security_domain_id:
                raise PermissionError("asset not visible")
            self.rights.require("garmin", "all", RightsOperation.DISTRIBUTE, policy_version=str(grant.payload["rightsPolicyVersion"]), context={"accountId": account.account_id})
            ref = CASRef(mapping.security_domain_id, mapping.byte_domain, mapping.asset_hash, mapping.size)
            body = self.cas.read_bytes(mapping.security_domain_id, ref)
            metadata = AssetMetadata(size=len(body), etag=f'"{mapping.asset_hash}"', media_type=mapping.media_type)
        return AuthorizedAssetLease(metadata, lambda start, end: body[start:end + 1], lambda: None)

    def acknowledge_install(self, account: AccountContext, request: CourseInstallAckRequest) -> dict[str, object]:
        with self.session_scope() as session:
            grant = self._grant(session, account, lock=True)
            manifest = session.get(CourseInstallManifestRow, request.installManifestId)
            if manifest is None or manifest.security_domain_id != grant.security_domain_id or manifest.snapshot_id != request.snapshotId or manifest.profile_id != request.profileId:
                raise PermissionError("install ACK binding mismatch")
            payload = {"accountId": account.account_id, "deviceId": account.device_id, "installInstanceId": request.installInstanceId, "installManifestId": request.installManifestId}
            ack_id = typed_id("CourseInstallAck/v1", payload)
            existing = session.get(CourseDeviceInstallRow, ack_id)
            values = (request.snapshotId, request.profileId, request.commitMarkerHash, request.rangeBitmapHash)
            if existing is not None:
                if (existing.snapshot_id, existing.profile_id, existing.commit_marker_hash, existing.range_bitmap_hash) != values:
                    raise ValueError("install ACK idempotency content mismatch")
                return {"ackId": existing.id, "generation": existing.generation, "acceptedAt": existing.accepted_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")}
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            row = CourseDeviceInstallRow(id=ack_id, account_id=account.account_id, device_id=account.device_id, install_instance_id=request.installInstanceId, install_manifest_id=request.installManifestId, snapshot_id=request.snapshotId, profile_id=request.profileId, generation=1, materialization="installed", rights="allowed", commit_marker_hash=request.commitMarkerHash, range_bitmap_hash=request.rangeBitmapHash, accepted_at=now)
            session.add(row)
            session.flush()
            return {"ackId": row.id, "generation": row.generation, "acceptedAt": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")}
```

```python
# server_v2/course_dependencies.py
from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterator
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import lru_cache
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import EncryptedCAS
from ai_caddie.course_data.config import CourseRuntimeConfig
from ai_caddie.course_data.key_provider import EnvironmentHKDFDomainKeyProvider
from ai_caddie.course_data.rights import RightsMatrix
from ai_caddie.research.deep_mine.promotion import TrustedPromotionCandidateStore
from server_v2 import db
from server_v2.course_service_backend import SqlCourseBackend


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class DomainScopedTrustedPromotionStores:
    root: Path

    @contextmanager
    def __call__(
        self,
        security_domain_id: str,
    ) -> Iterator[TrustedPromotionCandidateStore]:
        store = TrustedPromotionCandidateStore.open(
            self.root,
            security_domain_id,
        )
        try:
            yield store
        finally:
            store.close()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CourseDependencies:
    config: CourseRuntimeConfig
    cas: EncryptedCAS
    rights: RightsMatrix
    trusted_promotion_stores: DomainScopedTrustedPromotionStores

    def backend(self) -> SqlCourseBackend:
        return SqlCourseBackend(db.session_scope, self.cas, self.rights, self.config.signing_identity, self.trusted_promotion_stores, rotation_envelopes=self.config.signing_rotation_envelopes, max_offline_seconds=self.config.trusted_time_max_offline_seconds, max_forward_skew_seconds=self.config.trusted_time_max_forward_skew_seconds)

    def build_executor(self):
        from ops.course_build_executor import CourseBuildExecutor
        return CourseBuildExecutor(db.session_scope, self.cas, self.rights, self.config.signing_identity, self.trusted_promotion_stores)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def course_dependencies() -> CourseDependencies:
    config = CourseRuntimeConfig.from_environment(os.environ)
    if db.database_url() != config.database_url:
        raise RuntimeError("Course API/worker database configuration diverged")
    return CourseDependencies(
        config,
        EncryptedCAS(config.cas_root, EnvironmentHKDFDomainKeyProvider()),
        RightsMatrix(list(config.rights_rules)),
        DomainScopedTrustedPromotionStores(config.trusted_promotion_root),
    )


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_course_backend() -> SqlCourseBackend:
    return course_dependencies().backend()


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_course_build_executor():
    return course_dependencies().build_executor()
```

```python
from contextlib import AbstractContextManager
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from ai_caddie.contracts.canonical_json import canonical_json_bytes

from ai_caddie.course_data.build_queue import BuildJobKind, BuildQueue
from ai_caddie.course_data.cas import CASRef, EncryptedCAS

    SnapshotPublisher,
)
from ops.course_build_worker import JobExecutionResult, LeaseClaim
from server_v2.course_models import (
    CourseBuildJobRow,
    CourseChannelHeadRow,
    CourseChannelRow,
    CourseInstallManifestRow,
    CourseOpaqueAssetRow,
    CoursePromotionCandidateAssociationRow,
    CourseSafetyPolicyRow,

    CourseSourceRevisionRow,

from server_v2.course_repo import (
```
