```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/SignedControlVerifierTests.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddieDomain

private actor MemoryGenerationStore: AcceptedControlGenerationStore {
    var values: [String: AcceptedControlGeneration] = [:]
    func accepted(audience: String, type: String, subjectRef: String) -> AcceptedControlGeneration? { values["\(audience)\0\(type)\0\(subjectRef)"] }
    func compareAndSet(audience: String, type: String, subjectRef: String, expected: AcceptedControlGeneration?, replacement: AcceptedControlGeneration) throws {
        let key = "\(audience)\0\(type)\0\(subjectRef)"
        guard values[key] == expected else { throw SignedControlVerificationError.replay }
        values[key] = replacement
    }
}

private struct ControlGolden: Decodable { let controls: [String: ControlGoldenRow]; let rotationChain: [ControlGoldenRow] }
private struct ControlGoldenRow: Decodable { let envelope: SignedControlEnvelope }

final class SignedControlVerifierTests: XCTestCase {
    private func fixture() throws -> ControlGolden {
        let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: FileManager.default.currentDirectoryPath).appendingPathComponent("contracts/canonical/fixtures/course_signed_controls_golden.json")
        return try JSONDecoder().decode(ControlGolden.self, from: Data(contentsOf: url))
    }

    private func trust() throws -> CourseSigningTrustStore {
        let leaf = try Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey(rawRepresentation: Data((1..<33).map(UInt8.init))).publicKey
        let root = try Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey(rawRepresentation: Data((33..<65).map(UInt8.init))).publicKey
        let types = ["CourseDiscoveryContext", "SnapshotGrant", "CourseReleaseChannel", "CourseStaticAuthorityBundle", "CourseInstallReservation", "SafetyPolicy", "PurgeDirective", "TrustedTimeToken", "CourseInstallManifest"]
        let rules = types.map { CourseSigningTrustRule(keyId: "course-test-2026", type: $0, version: 1, algorithm: "Ed25519", publicKey: leaf) } + [CourseSigningTrustRule(keyId: "course-root-2026", type: "SigningKeyRotation", version: 1, algorithm: "Ed25519", publicKey: root, root: true)]
        return CourseSigningTrustStore(rules: rules)
    }

    func testLiteralControlsAllowExactRetryRejectGenerationCollisionAndCrossType() async throws {
        let trust = try trust()
        let generationStore = MemoryGenerationStore()
        let controls = try fixture().controls
        _ = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SafetyPolicy", envelope: controls["SafetyPolicy"]!.envelope, audience: "account-a", trustStore: trust, generations: generationStore)
        _ = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SafetyPolicy", envelope: controls["SafetyPolicy"]!.envelope, audience: "account-a", trustStore: trust, generations: generationStore)
        let collision = MemoryGenerationStore(); let safety = controls["SafetyPolicy"]!.envelope
        try await collision.compareAndSet(audience: "account-a", type: "SafetyPolicy", subjectRef: "channel:layout-1", expected: nil, replacement: AcceptedControlGeneration(generation: 8, payloadId: String(repeating: "0", count: 64)))
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync { _ = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SafetyPolicy", envelope: safety, audience: "account-a", trustStore: trust, generations: collision) }
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync { _ = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("PurgeDirective", envelope: controls["SafetyPolicy"]!.envelope, audience: "account-a", trustStore: trust, generations: MemoryGenerationStore()) }
    }

    func testTwoGenerationRotationChainSurvivesReopenAndIncludesManifestBinding() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let url = root.appending(path: "rotation.json")
        let chain = try fixture().rotationChain
        let firstTrust = try trust(); let firstStore = FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: url)
        try await SignedControlVerifier.rehydrateRotations(trustStore: firstTrust, rotationStore: firstStore)
        for row in chain { try await SignedControlVerifier.verifyAndApplyRotation(row.envelope, trustStore: firstTrust, rotationStore: firstStore) }
        try await SignedControlVerifier.rehydrateRotations(trustStore: firstTrust, rotationStore: firstStore)
        for row in chain { try await SignedControlVerifier.verifyAndApplyRotation(row.envelope, trustStore: firstTrust, rotationStore: firstStore) }
        XCTAssertNoThrow(try firstTrust.key(keyId: "course-leaf-2028", type: "CourseInstallManifest", version: 1, algorithm: "Ed25519"))

        let reopenedTrust = try trust(); let reopenedStore = FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: url)
        try await SignedControlVerifier.rehydrateRotations(trustStore: reopenedTrust, rotationStore: reopenedStore)
        XCTAssertEqual(reopenedTrust.currentRootGeneration(), 2)
        XCTAssertNoThrow(try reopenedTrust.key(keyId: "course-leaf-2028", type: "TrustedTimeToken", version: 1, algorithm: "Ed25519"))
    }

    func testPersistBeforeInstallCrashRecoversAndOutOfOrderOrCollisionFailsClosed() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let url = root.appending(path: "rotation.json"); let chain = try fixture().rotationChain
        let trust = try trust()
        try await SignedControlVerifier.verifyAndApplyRotation(chain[0].envelope, trustStore: trust, rotationStore: FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: url))
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync {
            try await SignedControlVerifier.verifyAndApplyRotation(chain[1].envelope, trustStore: trust, rotationStore: FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: url, fault: .afterPersistBeforeInstall))
        }
        let recoveredTrust = try self.trust()
        try await SignedControlVerifier.rehydrateRotations(trustStore: recoveredTrust, rotationStore: FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: url))
        XCTAssertEqual(recoveredTrust.currentRootGeneration(), 2)

        let outOfOrderRoot = root.appending(path: "out-of-order.json")
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync {
            try await SignedControlVerifier.verifyAndApplyRotation(chain[1].envelope, trustStore: try self.trust(), rotationStore: FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: outOfOrderRoot))
        }
        let payloadData = Data(canonicalBase64URL: chain[0].envelope.payloadB64u)!
        let payload = try JSONDecoder().decode(SigningKeyRotationPayload.self, from: payloadData)
        let collision = SignedControlEnvelope(protectedB64u: chain[0].envelope.protectedB64u, payloadId: String(repeating: "0", count: 64), payloadB64u: chain[0].envelope.payloadB64u, signatureB64u: chain[0].envelope.signatureB64u)
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync {
            _ = try await FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: url).accept(envelope: collision, payload: payload)
        }
    }

    func testAcceptedGenerationPersistsAndAllowsOnlyExactEnvelopeAfterReopen() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let leaf = try Curve25519.Signing.PrivateKey(rawRepresentation: Data((1..<33).map(UInt8.init))).publicKey
        let trust = CourseSigningTrustStore(rules: [CourseSigningTrustRule(keyId: "course-test-2026", type: "SafetyPolicy", version: 1, algorithm: "Ed25519", publicKey: leaf)])
        let envelope = try fixture().controls["SafetyPolicy"]!.envelope
        let url = root.appending(path: "accepted.json")
        _ = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SafetyPolicy", envelope: envelope, audience: "account-a", trustStore: trust, generations: FileAcceptedControlGenerationStore(url: url))
        _ = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SafetyPolicy", envelope: envelope, audience: "account-a", trustStore: trust, generations: FileAcceptedControlGenerationStore(url: url))
        XCTAssertTrue(FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path))
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomainTests/TrustedTimeStoreTests.swift
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddieDomain

private actor MemoryTrustedTimePersistence: TrustedTimePersistence {
    var anchor: TrustedTimeAnchor?
    func load() -> TrustedTimeAnchor? { anchor }
    func save(_ value: TrustedTimeAnchor) { anchor = value }
    func clear() { anchor = nil }
}

final class TrustedTimeStoreTests: XCTestCase {
    private func control() throws -> VerifiedSignedControl {
        let payload: [String: Any] = ["audience":"account-a", "subjectRef":"time:account-a", "generation":1, "issuedAt":"2026-07-18T10:00:00.000Z", "rightsPolicyVersion":"rights-v3", "serverTime":"2026-07-18T10:00:00.000Z", "tokenGeneration":1, "maxOfflineAgeSeconds":3600, "offlineNotAfter":"2026-07-18T11:00:00.000Z", "maxForwardSkewSeconds":300]
        return VerifiedSignedControl(type: "TrustedTimeToken", keyId: "key", base: SignedControlBase(audience: "account-a", subjectRef: "time:account-a", generation: 1, issuedAt: "2026-07-18T10:00:00.000Z", rightsPolicyVersion: "rights-v3"), payloadBytes: try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: payload, options: [.sortedKeys]))
    }

    func testRollbackRebootForwardClampAndReinstall() async throws {
        let persistence = MemoryTrustedTimePersistence(); let store = TrustedTimeStore(persistence: persistence)
        let acceptedWall = ISO8601DateFormatter().date(from: "2026-07-18T10:00:00Z")!
        try await store.accept(control(), wallTime: acceptedWall, uptime: 100, bootSessionId: "boot-a")
        try await store.accept(control(), wallTime: acceptedWall.addingTimeInterval(1), uptime: 101, bootSessionId: "boot-a")
        let monotonic = try await store.effectiveNow(wallTime: acceptedWall.addingTimeInterval(-3600), uptime: 160, bootSessionId: "boot-a")
        XCTAssertEqual(monotonic, acceptedWall.addingTimeInterval(60))
        let rebooted = try await store.effectiveNow(wallTime: acceptedWall.addingTimeInterval(3600), uptime: 5, bootSessionId: "boot-b")
        XCTAssertLessThanOrEqual(rebooted, monotonic.addingTimeInterval(300))
        try await store.clearForReinstallOrLogout()
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync { _ = try await store.effectiveNow(wallTime: acceptedWall, uptime: 10, bootSessionId: "boot-c") }
    }

    func testTrustedAnchorSurvivesProcessReopen() async throws {
        let root = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appending(path: UUID().uuidString); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
        let url = root.appending(path: "trusted-time.json"); let wall = ISO8601DateFormatter().date(from: "2026-07-18T10:00:00Z")!
        try await TrustedTimeStore(persistence: FileTrustedTimePersistence(url: url)).accept(control(), wallTime: wall, uptime: 100, bootSessionId: "boot-a")
        let reopened = TrustedTimeStore(persistence: FileTrustedTimePersistence(url: url))
        let recoveredNow = try await reopened.effectiveNow(wallTime: wall, uptime: 130, bootSessionId: "boot-a")
        XCTAssertEqual(recoveredNow, wall.addingTimeInterval(30))
    }
}
```

```typescript
class MemoryGenerations implements ControlGenerationStore { values=new Map<string,AcceptedControlGeneration>();key(a:string,t:string,s:string){return `${a}\0${t}\0${s}`};async accepted(a:string,t:string,s:string){return this.values.get(this.key(a,t,s))??null};async compareAndSet(a:string,t:string,s:string,e:AcceptedControlGeneration|null,r:AcceptedControlGeneration){const key=this.key(a,t,s);const current=this.values.get(key)??null;if(JSON.stringify(current)!==JSON.stringify(e))throw new Error('CAS');this.values.set(key,r)} }
class MemoryRotations implements RotationTrustStateStore { state:PersistedRotationTrustState={rootGeneration:0,entries:[],rules:[]};async snapshot(){return structuredClone(this.state)};async accept(envelope:Parameters<RotationTrustStateStore['accept']>[0],payload:RotationPayload){if(payload.rootGeneration!==this.state.rootGeneration+1)throw new Error('root generation');const rules=[...this.state.rules.filter(rule=>rule.keyId!==payload.newKeyId),...payload.allowedBindings.map(binding=>({keyId:payload.newKeyId,type:binding.type,version:binding.schemaVersion,algorithm:'Ed25519' as const,publicKeyB64u:payload.publicKeyB64u}))].sort((a,b)=>`${a.keyId}\0${a.type}\0${a.version}`.localeCompare(`${b.keyId}\0${b.type}\0${b.version}`));this.state={rootGeneration:payload.rootGeneration,entries:[...this.state.entries,{controlGeneration:payload.generation,payloadId:envelope.payloadId,rootGeneration:payload.rootGeneration,envelope,newKeyId:payload.newKeyId,publicKeyB64u:payload.publicKeyB64u,allowedBindings:payload.allowedBindings}],rules};return this.snapshot()};async clearForReinstallOrLogout(){this.state={rootGeneration:0,entries:[],rules:[]}} }

describe('signed controls', () => {

    const leaf = strictBase64URL('ebVWLo_mVPlAeLES6KmLp5AfhTrmlb7X4OORC60ElmQ'); const root = strictBase64URL('5_FioQvsVZr-oZXk3OhLaVaNXSywlj60RsBoXisX8vA')
    const types = ['CourseDiscoveryContext','SnapshotGrant','CourseReleaseChannel','CourseStaticAuthorityBundle','CourseInstallReservation','SafetyPolicy','PurgeDirective','TrustedTimeToken','CourseInstallManifest']
    const trust = new MutableTrustStore([...types.map(type => ({ keyId:'course-test-2026', type, version:1, algorithm:'Ed25519' as const, publicKey:leaf })), { keyId:'course-root-2026', type:'SigningKeyRotation', version:1, algorithm:'Ed25519', publicKey:root, root:true }])
```

```swift
final class CourseInstallFileStoreTests: XCTestCase {
```

```swift
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddie
@testable import AICaddieDomain

final class RoundStartCoordinatorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSameIntentSameBindingReusesIncarnationAndChangedBindingConflicts() async throws {
        let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeInstalled()
        defer { harness.cleanup() }
        let first = try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request)
        let retry = try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request)
        XCTAssertEqual(first.roundIncarnationId, retry.roundIncarnationId)
        let roundStartedCount = try await harness.ledger.count(kind: "round_started")
        let pinCount = try await harness.fileStore.pinCount(harness.binding)
        XCTAssertEqual(roundStartedCount, 1)
        XCTAssertEqual(pinCount, 1)
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync {
            try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request.with(snapshotId: String(repeating: "9", count: 64)))
        }
    }

    func testPreparedAbortRollsBackWithoutGhostPinOrRound() async throws {
        let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeInstalled(fault: .afterPrepared)
        defer { harness.cleanup() }
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync { try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request) }
        try await harness.coordinator.abortPrepared(roundIntentId: harness.request.roundIntentId)
        let persistedIntent = try await harness.journal.load(roundIntentId: harness.request.roundIntentId)
        let pinCount = try await harness.fileStore.pinCount(harness.binding)
        let roundStartedCount = try await harness.ledger.count(kind: "round_started")
        XCTAssertNil(persistedIntent)
        XCTAssertEqual(pinCount, 0)
        XCTAssertEqual(roundStartedCount, 0)
    }

    func testKillAfterPinOrEventRecoversOnePinOneExactEvent() async throws {
        for fault in [RoundStartFault.afterInstallPinCommit, .afterRoundEventCommit] {
            let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeInstalled(fault: fault)
            defer { harness.cleanup() }
            await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync { try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request) }
            let reopened = try await harness.reopen(fault: nil)
            let completed = try await reopened.coordinator.recover(roundIntentId: harness.request.roundIntentId)
            let pinCount = try await reopened.fileStore.pinCount(reopened.binding)
            let roundStartedCount = try await reopened.ledger.count(kind: "round_started")
            let canonicalBytes = try await reopened.ledger.canonicalEventBytes(kind: "round_started")
            XCTAssertEqual(completed.state, .complete, "\(fault)")
            XCTAssertEqual(pinCount, 1, "\(fault)")
            XCTAssertEqual(roundStartedCount, 1, "\(fault)")
            XCTAssertEqual(canonicalBytes, completed.canonicalEventBytes)
        }
    }

    func testLostAckResponseRetriesStableIdentityThenSyncsExactEvent() async throws {
        let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeInstalled(authorityMode: .commitThenLoseResponse)
        defer { harness.cleanup() }
        _ = try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request)
        let initialCalls = await harness.authority.calls
        XCTAssertEqual(initialCalls.map(\.operation), ["install-ack"])
        let persisted = try await harness.journal.load(roundIntentId: harness.request.roundIntentId)
        let pending = try XCTUnwrap(persisted)
        let reopened = try await harness.reopen(authorityMode: .exactRetrySucceeds)
        _ = try await reopened.coordinator.recover(roundIntentId: harness.request.roundIntentId)
        let calls = await reopened.authority.calls
        XCTAssertEqual(calls.map(\.operation), ["install-ack", "round-pin", "round-start-sync"])
        XCTAssertTrue(calls.allSatisfy { $0.installInstanceId == pending.installInstanceId })
        XCTAssertEqual(calls[0].verifiedAt, pending.installVerifiedAt)
        XCTAssertEqual(calls[1].verifiedAt, pending.startVerifiedAt)
        XCTAssertEqual(calls.last?.body, pending.canonicalEventBytes)
        let ackBodies = await reopened.authority.ackBodies
        XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(ackBodies.count, 2)
        XCTAssertTrue(ackBodies.dropFirst().allSatisfy { $0 == ackBodies[0] })
    }
}
```

```swift
final class RoundPinReleaseCoordinatorTests: XCTestCase {
    func testLostReleaseResponseRetriesSameBodyAndDecrementsPinExactlyOnce() async throws {
        let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeCompletedRound(releaseMode:.commitThenLoseResponse)
        defer { harness.cleanup() }
        let intent = "release-intent-1"
        let completedStart = try XCTUnwrap(harness.completedStart)
        let first = try await harness.releaseCoordinator.release(start:completedStart,releaseIntentId:intent)
        let firstPinCount = try await harness.fileStore.pinCount(harness.binding)
        XCTAssertEqual(first.state,.prepared)
        XCTAssertEqual(firstPinCount,1)
        let reopened = try await harness.reopenRelease(mode:.exactRetrySucceeds)
        let completed = try await reopened.releaseCoordinator.recover(releaseIntentId:intent)
        let completedPinCount = try await reopened.fileStore.pinCount(reopened.binding)
        XCTAssertEqual(completed.state,.localCommitted)
        XCTAssertEqual(completedPinCount,0)
        let retried = try await reopened.releaseCoordinator.recover(releaseIntentId:intent)
        let retriedPinCount = try await reopened.fileStore.pinCount(reopened.binding)
        XCTAssertEqual(retried,completed)
        XCTAssertEqual(retriedPinCount,0)
        let releaseBodies = await reopened.authority.releaseBodies
        XCTAssertEqual(releaseBodies.count,2)
        XCTAssertEqual(releaseBodies[0],releaseBodies[1])
    }

    func testReleaseRequiresTerminalReplicationEmptyOutboxAndRecoveryWatermark() async throws {
        for denied in [ReleaseEvidenceFault.nonTerminal,.replicationBehind,.pendingOperationalEvent,.preparedResolutionCommit,.checkpointMismatch] {
            let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeCompletedRound(releaseEvidenceFault:denied)
            defer { harness.cleanup() }
            let completedStart = try XCTUnwrap(harness.completedStart)
            await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync { try await harness.releaseCoordinator.release(start:completedStart,releaseIntentId:"release-\(denied)") }
            let pinCount = try await harness.fileStore.pinCount(harness.binding)
            XCTAssertEqual(pinCount,1)
            let releaseBodies = await harness.authority.releaseBodies
            XCTAssertTrue(releaseBodies.isEmpty)
        }
    }

    func testReleaseAttestationAndUninstallRaceConvergesAcrossOneCommutativeRebase() async throws {
        let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeCompletedRound()
        defer { harness.cleanup() }
        let prepared = try await harness.prepareServerReleasedIntent(releaseIntentId:"release-race")
        async let release = Self.capture { try await harness.releaseCoordinator.recover(releaseIntentId:prepared.request.releaseIntentId) }
        async let uninstall = Self.capture { try await harness.fileStore.requestUninstall(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId,expectedGeneration:prepared.expectedInstallRecordGeneration) }
        let releaseResult = await release
        let uninstallResult = await uninstall
        XCTAssertTrue(releaseResult.isSuccess, "release must converge after the exact commutative predecessor")
        XCTAssertTrue(uninstallResult.isSuccess, "uninstall must converge after the exact commutative predecessor")
        let loaded = try await harness.fileStore.installedRecord(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId)
        let record = try XCTUnwrap(loaded)
        XCTAssertEqual(record.recordGeneration,prepared.expectedInstallRecordGeneration + 2)
        XCTAssertEqual(record.pinCount,0)
        XCTAssertEqual(record.intent,.uninstallPending)
        let recovered = try await harness.releaseCoordinator.recover(releaseIntentId:prepared.request.releaseIntentId)
        XCTAssertEqual(recovered.state,.localCommitted)
        XCTAssertEqual(recovered.committedInstallRecordGeneration,record.recordGeneration)
        try await harness.fileStore.completeUninstall(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId,expectedGeneration:record.recordGeneration)
        let removed = try await harness.fileStore.installedRecord(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId)
        XCTAssertNil(removed)
    }

    func testReleaseAndUninstallRebaseInBothSerializedOrders() async throws {
        for releaseFirst in [true,false] {
            let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeCompletedRound()
            defer { harness.cleanup() }
            let prepared = try await harness.prepareServerReleasedIntent(releaseIntentId:"release-order-\(releaseFirst)")
            if releaseFirst {
                let released = try await harness.releaseCoordinator.recover(releaseIntentId:prepared.request.releaseIntentId)
                XCTAssertEqual(released.state,.localCommitted)
                _ = try await harness.fileStore.requestUninstall(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId,expectedGeneration:prepared.expectedInstallRecordGeneration)
            } else {
                _ = try await harness.fileStore.requestUninstall(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId,expectedGeneration:prepared.expectedInstallRecordGeneration)
                let released = try await harness.releaseCoordinator.recover(releaseIntentId:prepared.request.releaseIntentId)
                XCTAssertEqual(released.state,.localCommitted)
            }
            let loaded = try await harness.fileStore.installedRecord(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId)
            let record = try XCTUnwrap(loaded)
            XCTAssertEqual(record.recordGeneration,prepared.expectedInstallRecordGeneration + 2)
            XCTAssertEqual(record.pinCount,0)
            XCTAssertEqual(record.intent,.uninstallPending)
        }
    }

    func testReleasedPinCannotResumeGuidanceFromStaleLocalOrAuthorityValues() async throws {
        let harness = try await RoundStartCoordinatorHarness.makeCompletedRound()
        defer { harness.cleanup() }
        let start = try XCTUnwrap(harness.completedStart)
        _ = try await harness.fileStore.activeRoundPin(domain:harness.domain,manifestId:harness.binding.installManifestId,roundId:start.roundId,roundIncarnationId:start.roundIncarnationId)
        let released = try await harness.releaseCoordinator.release(start:start,releaseIntentId:"release-before-guidance")
        let pinCount = try await harness.fileStore.pinCount(harness.binding)
        XCTAssertEqual(released.state,.localCommitted)
        XCTAssertEqual(pinCount,0)
        await XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync {
            try await harness.authorityStore.loadVerifiedActiveRound(accountId:start.accountId,deviceId:start.deviceId,credentialId:start.credentialId,profileId:start.profileId,snapshotId:start.snapshotId,installManifestId:start.installManifestId,roundId:start.roundId,roundIncarnationId:start.roundIncarnationId,effectiveNow:Date())
        }
    }

    private static func capture<T>(_ operation:@escaping @Sendable () async throws -> T) async -> Result<T,Error>{do{return .success(try await operation())}catch{return .failure(error)}}
}

private extension Result { var isSuccess:Bool { if case .success = self { return true }; return false } }
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CourseInstallFileStore.swift
import CryptoKit
import Darwin
import Foundation

public struct InstallSecurityDomain: Codable, Hashable {
    public let id: String
    public let accountId: String
    public let grantId: String
    public let storageKeyDomain: String
    public let rightsPolicyVersion: String
    public let deviceProfile: String
}

public struct InstallRecord: Codable, Equatable {
    public let installSecurityDomainId: String
    public let authoritySecurityDomainId: String
    public let installedManifestId: String
    public let snapshotId: String
    public let profileId: String
    public let courseLayoutIdentityId: String
    public let layoutRevisionId: String
    public let teeSelectionId: String
    public let liveRoundPackageIds: [String]
    public let staticAuthorityHash: String
    public let installInstanceId: String
    public let installAckId: String
    public let commitMarkerHash: String
    public let rangeBitmapHash: String
    public var installAckGeneration: Int?
    public let installVerifiedAt: String
    public var materialization: Materialization
    public var health: InstallHealth
    public var currency: InstallCurrency
    public var intent: InstallIntent
    public var rights: InstallRights
    public var recordGeneration: Int
    public var pinCount: Int
    public var installedAssetRefs: [String]
    public var missingRequiredAssetRefs: [String]
    public var missingOptionalAssetRefs: [String]
}

public struct InstallTransaction: Sendable {
    public let domain: InstallSecurityDomain
    public let manifestId: String
    public let stagingURL: URL
}

public protocol CourseInstallFileSystem: Sendable {
    func createDirectory(_ url: URL) throws
    func writeAndSync(_ data: Data, to url: URL) throws
    func atomicReplace(_ source: URL, _ destination: URL) throws
    func read(_ url: URL) throws -> Data
    func exists(_ url: URL) -> Bool
}

public enum CourseInstallError: Error {
    case assetIntegrity, requiredAssetsMissing, chunkIdentity
    case staleRecordGeneration, startBlocked, roundIntentConflict
}

public struct POSIXCourseInstallFileSystem: CourseInstallFileSystem {
    public init() {}
    public func createDirectory(_ url: URL) throws { try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url, withIntermediateDirectories: true) }
    public func writeAndSync(_ data: Data, to url: URL) throws {
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        try data.write(to: url, options: .atomic)
        let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: url)
        try handle.synchronize()
        try handle.close()
    }
    public func atomicReplace(_ source: URL, _ destination: URL) throws {
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: destination.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: destination.path) { _ = try FileManager.default.replaceItemAt(destination, withItemAt: source) }
        else { try FileManager.default.moveItem(at: source, to: destination) }
    }
    public func read(_ url: URL) throws -> Data { try Data(contentsOf: url) }
    public func exists(_ url: URL) -> Bool { FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) }
}

public actor CourseInstallFileStore {
    private let root: URL
    private let fileSystem: CourseInstallFileSystem

    public init(root: URL, fileSystem: CourseInstallFileSystem = POSIXCourseInstallFileSystem()) {
        self.root = root
        self.fileSystem = fileSystem
    }

    private func domainRoot(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain) -> URL {
        root.appending(path: domain.id, directoryHint: .isDirectory)
    }

    public func begin(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> InstallTransaction {
        let staging = domainRoot(domain).appending(path: "staging/\(manifestId).partial", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
        try fileSystem.createDirectory(staging)
        return InstallTransaction(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId, stagingURL: staging)
    }

    public func write(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, asset: ManifestAsset, bytes: Data) throws {
        let digest = SHA256.hash(data: bytes).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        guard digest == asset.hash, bytes.count == asset.size else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(bytes, to: transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: asset.hash))
    }

    public func commit(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, record: InstallRecord) throws {
        guard record.missingRequiredAssetRefs.isEmpty else { throw CourseInstallError.requiredAssetsMissing }
        let committed = domainRoot(transaction.domain).appending(path: "installed/\(transaction.manifestId)", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
        let marker = try JSONEncoder().encode(["manifestId": transaction.manifestId, "snapshotId": record.snapshotId])
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(marker, to: transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "commit.json"))
        try fileSystem.atomicReplace(transaction.stagingURL, committed)
        let indexURL = domainRoot(transaction.domain).appending(path: "installed-index/\(transaction.manifestId).json")
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try JSONEncoder().encode(record), to: indexURL)
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CourseInstallReservationJournal.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public struct CourseInstallReservationIntent: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let installIntentId: String
    public let accountId: String
    public let deviceId: String
    public let layoutId: String
    public let profileId: String
    public let installInstanceId: String
    public let immutableHash: String
    public var installAckId: String?
    public var committedDomain: InstallSecurityDomain?
    public var committedManifestId: String?
    public var state: String
}

public actor CourseInstallReservationJournal {
    private let root: URL
    private let encoder = JSONEncoder()
    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()

    public init(root: URL) { self.root = root }

    private func url(_ intentId: String) throws -> URL {
        guard intentId.range(
            of: #"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$"#,
            options: .regularExpression
        ) != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
        return root.appending(path: "\(intentId).json")
    }

    public func loadOrCreate(
        installIntentId: String,
        accountId: String,
        deviceId: String,
        layoutId: String,
        profileId: String,
        makeInstanceId: @Sendable () -> String
    ) throws -> CourseInstallReservationIntent {
        let target = try url(installIntentId)
        let immutable = JSONValue.object([
            "accountId": .string(accountId),
            "deviceId": .string(deviceId),
            "installIntentId": .string(installIntentId),
            "layoutId": .string(layoutId),
            "profileId": .string(profileId),
        ])
        let hash = SHA256.hash(data: try CanonicalJSON.data(immutable)).map {
            String(format: "%02x", $0)
        }.joined()
        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: target.path) {
            let existing = try decoder.decode(
                CourseInstallReservationIntent.self,
                from: Data(contentsOf: target)
            )
            guard existing.immutableHash == hash,
                  existing.accountId == accountId,
                  existing.deviceId == deviceId,
                  existing.layoutId == layoutId,
                  existing.profileId == profileId else {
                throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
            }
            return existing
        }
        let value = CourseInstallReservationIntent(
            installIntentId: installIntentId,
            accountId: accountId,
            deviceId: deviceId,
            layoutId: layoutId,
            profileId: profileId,
            installInstanceId: makeInstanceId(),
            immutableHash: hash,
            installAckId: nil,
            committedDomain: nil,
            committedManifestId: nil,
            state: "prepared"
        )
        try AtomicProtectedFile.write(try encoder.encode(value), to: target)
        return value
    }

    public func markLocallyCommitted(
        _ input: CourseInstallReservationIntent,
        domain: InstallSecurityDomain,
        record: InstallRecord
    ) throws -> CourseInstallReservationIntent {
        guard input.installAckId == record.installAckId,
              input.installInstanceId == record.installInstanceId,
              input.layoutId == record.courseLayoutIdentityId,
              input.profileId == record.profileId,
              record.installSecurityDomainId == domain.id else {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        var value = input
        if let oldDomain = value.committedDomain, oldDomain != domain {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        if let oldManifest = value.committedManifestId,
           oldManifest != record.installedManifestId {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        value.committedDomain = domain
        value.committedManifestId = record.installedManifestId
        value.state = "committed"
        try AtomicProtectedFile.write(try encoder.encode(value), to: url(value.installIntentId))
        return value
    }

    public func bindReservation(
        _ input: CourseInstallReservationIntent,
        installAckId: String
    ) throws -> CourseInstallReservationIntent {
        var value = input
        if let existing = value.installAckId, existing != installAckId {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        value.installAckId = installAckId
        value.state = "reserved"
        try AtomicProtectedFile.write(try encoder.encode(value), to: url(value.installIntentId))
        return value
    }

    public func markComplete(
        _ input: CourseInstallReservationIntent,
        installAckId: String
    ) throws {
        guard input.installAckId == installAckId else {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        var value = input
        guard value.committedDomain != nil,
              value.committedManifestId != nil else {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        value.state = "complete"
        try AtomicProtectedFile.write(try encoder.encode(value), to: url(value.installIntentId))
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/SharedCourseInstaller.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public struct InstallChunk: Codable, Sendable {
    public let snapshotId: String; public let installManifestId: String; public let assetHash: String; public let assetGroup: String
    public let ordinal: Int; public let offset: Int; public let totalLength: Int; public let bytes: Data
    public init(snapshotId:String,installManifestId:String,assetHash:String,assetGroup:String,ordinal:Int,offset:Int,totalLength:Int,bytes:Data) { self.snapshotId=snapshotId; self.installManifestId=installManifestId; self.assetHash=assetHash; self.assetGroup=assetGroup; self.ordinal=ordinal; self.offset=offset; self.totalLength=totalLength; self.bytes=bytes }
}

public struct InstallAcknowledgement: Codable, Sendable {
    public let installAckId: String; public let installManifestId: String; public let snapshotId: String; public let profileId: String; public let installInstanceId: String
    public let staticAuthorityHash: String; public let verifiedAt: String; public let commitMarkerHash: String; public let rangeBitmapHash: String
    public init(installAckId:String,installManifestId:String,snapshotId:String,profileId:String,installInstanceId:String,staticAuthorityHash:String,verifiedAt:String,commitMarkerHash:String,rangeBitmapHash:String) { self.installAckId=installAckId; self.installManifestId=installManifestId; self.snapshotId=snapshotId; self.profileId=profileId; self.installInstanceId=installInstanceId; self.staticAuthorityHash=staticAuthorityHash; self.verifiedAt=verifiedAt; self.commitMarkerHash=commitMarkerHash; self.rangeBitmapHash=rangeBitmapHash }
}

public enum CourseTransportError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case connectivity
    case httpStatus(Int)
    case responseShape
}

public enum SharedCourseInstallerFault: Sendable {
    case afterLocalCommitBeforeAcknowledgement
}

public protocol CourseInstallTransport: Sendable {
    func manifest(layoutId: String, profileId: String, installInstanceId: String) async throws -> CourseInstallBundle
    func asset(_ asset: ManifestAsset, opaqueAssetId: String, groupId: String, installManifestId: String, snapshotId: String, missingRanges: [VerifiedByteRange]) async throws -> AsyncThrowingStream<InstallChunk, Error>
    func acknowledgeInstalled(_ acknowledgement: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation
    func commitRoundPin(_ request: RoundDevicePinRequest) async throws -> RoundPinAuthorityAttestation
    func releaseRoundPin(_ request: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseAttestation
}

public struct InstallClientCapabilities: Sendable {
    public let accountId: String; public let deviceId: String; public let credentialId: String; public let version: String; public let maximumSchema: Int; public let profileId: String; public let maximumChunkBytes: Int
    public init(accountId: String, deviceId: String, credentialId: String, version: String, maximumSchema: Int, profileId: String, maximumChunkBytes: Int) { self.accountId=accountId; self.deviceId=deviceId; self.credentialId=credentialId; self.version=version; self.maximumSchema=maximumSchema; self.profileId=profileId; self.maximumChunkBytes=maximumChunkBytes }
}

public actor SharedCourseInstaller {
    private let transport: CourseInstallTransport
    private let trustStore: CourseSigningTrustStore
    private let rotationStore: FileRotationTrustStateStore
    private let generations: AcceptedControlGenerationStore
    private let trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore
    private let fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore
    private let reservationJournal: CourseInstallReservationJournal
    private let capabilities: InstallClientCapabilities

    private let fault: SharedCourseInstallerFault?

    public init(transport: CourseInstallTransport, trustStore: CourseSigningTrustStore, rotationStore: FileRotationTrustStateStore, generations: AcceptedControlGenerationStore, trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore, fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore, reservationJournal: CourseInstallReservationJournal, capabilities: InstallClientCapabilities, installInstanceId: @escaping @Sendable () -> String = { UUID().uuidString }, fault: SharedCourseInstallerFault? = nil) {
        self.transport = transport; self.trustStore = trustStore; self.rotationStore = rotationStore; self.generations = generations; self.trustedTime = trustedTime; self.fileStore = fileStore; self.reservationJournal = reservationJournal; self.capabilities = capabilities; self.installInstanceId = installInstanceId; self.fault = fault

    private func version(_ value: String) throws -> [Int] { let parts = value.split(separator: ".").map(String.init); guard !parts.isEmpty, parts.allSatisfy({ Int($0) != nil }) else { throw CourseInstallError.incompatibleClient }; return parts.map { Int($0)! } }

    private func finishInstallAuthority(
        record: InstallRecord,
        domain: InstallSecurityDomain
    ) async throws -> InstallRecord {
        if record.installAckGeneration != nil { return record }

            domain: domain,
            manifestId: record.installedManifestId

            let attestation = try await transport.acknowledgeInstalled(acknowledgement)

                  attestation.accountId == capabilities.accountId,
                  attestation.securityDomainId == record.authoritySecurityDomainId,
                  attestation.deviceId == capabilities.deviceId,
                  attestation.credentialId == capabilities.credentialId,
                  attestation.profileId == record.profileId,
                  attestation.installInstanceId == record.installInstanceId,
                  attestation.installManifestId == record.installedManifestId,
                  attestation.snapshotId == record.snapshotId,

                manifestId: record.installedManifestId,

    }

    private func recoverLocallyCommitted(

            controls.manifestEnvelope,

            persistedStatic.rawEnvelope,

            controls.installReservationEnvelope,

            staticAuthority: staticAuthority,
            accountId: capabilities.accountId,
            deviceId: capabilities.deviceId,
            credentialId: capabilities.credentialId,
            profileId: capabilities.profileId,
            layoutIdentityId: intent.layoutId,
            installInstanceId: intent.installInstanceId,
            trustStore: trustStore

              record.profileId == intent.profileId,
              record.installInstanceId == intent.installInstanceId,
              record.installAckId == expectedAckId,
              reservation.payload.installAckId == expectedAckId,

        let recovered = try await finishInstallAuthority(record: record, domain: domain)
        if recovered.installAckGeneration != nil {
            try await reservationJournal.markComplete(
                intent,
                installAckId: recovered.installAckId
            )
        }
        return recovered
    }

                    let stream = try await transport.asset(asset, opaqueAssetId: opaqueId, groupId: group.groupId, installManifestId: verified.installManifestId, snapshotId: verified.payload.snapshotId, missingRanges: missing)

            try await reservationJournal.markComplete(
                reservationIntent,
                installAckId: finished.installAckId
            )
        }
        return finished
    }

    public func repair(layoutId: String, installIntentId: String, wallTime: Date, uptime: TimeInterval, bootSessionId: String) async throws -> InstallRecord { try await install(layoutId: layoutId, installIntentId: installIntentId, wallTime: wallTime, uptime: uptime, bootSessionId: bootSessionId) }
    public func requestUninstall(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, expectedGeneration: Int) async throws -> InstallRecord { try await fileStore.requestUninstall(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId, expectedGeneration: expectedGeneration) }
    public func completeUninstall(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, expectedGeneration: Int) async throws { try await fileStore.completeUninstall(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId, expectedGeneration: expectedGeneration) }

    private func groupIdAssetDependency(_ dependency: String, groups: [ManifestAssetGroup]) -> String { groups.first(where: { $0.assetRefs.contains(dependency) })?.groupId ?? dependency }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/CourseInstaller.swift
import AICaddieDomain
import Foundation

actor CourseInstaller {
    private let shared: SharedCourseInstaller
    init(shared: SharedCourseInstaller) { self.shared = shared }
    func install(layoutId: String, profileId: String, installIntentId: String, domain _: InstallSecurityDomain? = nil) async throws -> InstallRecord {
        guard profileId == "ios-v1" || profileId == "watch-v1" else { throw CourseInstallError.incompatibleClient }
        return try await shared.install(layoutId: layoutId, installIntentId: installIntentId, wallTime: Date(), uptime: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime, bootSessionId: Self.bootSessionId())
    }
    func repair(layoutId: String, installIntentId: String) async throws -> InstallRecord { try await shared.repair(layoutId: layoutId, installIntentId: installIntentId, wallTime: Date(), uptime: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime, bootSessionId: Self.bootSessionId()) }
    private static func bootSessionId() -> String { String(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970 - ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime)) }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/CourseInstallRuntime.swift
import AICaddieDomain
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

struct IOSCourseInstallRuntime {
    let installer: CourseInstaller
    let rotations: FileRotationTrustStateStore
    let generations: FileAcceptedControlGenerationStore
    let trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore

    static func make(accountId: String, deviceId: String, credentialId: String, supportRoot: URL, transport: CourseInstallTransport, trustRules: [CourseSigningTrustRule]) -> IOSCourseInstallRuntime {
        let accountNamespace = SHA256.hash(data: Data(accountId.utf8)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        let rotations = FileRotationTrustStateStore(url: supportRoot.appending(path: "course-signing-rotations/\(accountNamespace).json"))
        let generations = FileAcceptedControlGenerationStore(url: supportRoot.appending(path: "course-control/\(accountNamespace).json"))
        let trustedTime = TrustedTimeStore(persistence: FileTrustedTimePersistence(url: supportRoot.appending(path: "course-trusted-time/\(accountNamespace).json")))
        let fileStore = CourseInstallFileStore(root: supportRoot.appending(path: "course-installs"))
        let reservationJournal = CourseInstallReservationJournal(root: supportRoot.appending(path: "course-install-intents/\(accountNamespace)"))
        let capabilities = InstallClientCapabilities(accountId: accountId, deviceId: deviceId, credentialId: credentialId, version: "1.0.0", maximumSchema: 1, profileId: "ios-v1", maximumChunkBytes: 256 * 1024)
        let shared = SharedCourseInstaller(transport: transport, trustStore: CourseSigningTrustStore(rules: trustRules), rotationStore: rotations, generations: generations, trustedTime: trustedTime, fileStore: fileStore, reservationJournal: reservationJournal, capabilities: capabilities)
        return IOSCourseInstallRuntime(installer: CourseInstaller(shared: shared), rotations: rotations, generations: generations, trustedTime: trustedTime)
    }

    func clearForReinstallOrLogout() async throws {
        try await rotations.clearForReinstallOrLogout()
        try await generations.clearForReinstallOrLogout()
        try await trustedTime.clearForReinstallOrLogout()
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieTests/CourseInstallerTestHarness.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation
import XCTest
@testable import AICaddie
@testable import AICaddieDomain

actor TestGenerationStore: AcceptedControlGenerationStore {
    private var values: [String: AcceptedControlGeneration] = [:]
    func accepted(audience: String, type: String, subjectRef: String) -> AcceptedControlGeneration? { values["\(audience)\0\(type)\0\(subjectRef)"] }
    func compareAndSet(audience: String, type: String, subjectRef: String, expected: AcceptedControlGeneration?, replacement: AcceptedControlGeneration) throws { let key="\(audience)\0\(type)\0\(subjectRef)"; guard values[key] == expected else { throw SignedControlVerificationError.replay }; values[key]=replacement }
}

actor TestTimePersistence: TrustedTimePersistence {
    var anchor: TrustedTimeAnchor?
    func load() -> TrustedTimeAnchor? { anchor }; func save(_ value: TrustedTimeAnchor) { anchor=value }; func clear() { anchor=nil }
}

enum AuthorityMode: Sendable { case normal, commitThenLoseResponse, exactRetrySucceeds }
enum ReleaseAuthorityMode: Sendable { case normal, commitThenLoseResponse, exactRetrySucceeds }

struct AuthorityCall: Equatable, Sendable {
    let operation: String
    let installInstanceId: String
    let verifiedAt: String
    let body: Data
}

struct TestInstallReservation: Equatable, Sendable {
    let installInstanceId: String
    let installAckId: String
}

actor RecordingCourseInstallTransport: CourseInstallTransport, RoundStartAuthorityTransport {
    let bundle: CourseInstallBundle
    let bodies: [String: Data]
    let securityDomainId: String
    let reservationPayload: TestInstallReservation
    private(set) var lastAckedManifestId: String?
    private(set) var manifestRequestCount = 0
    private(set) var assetRequestCount = 0
    private(set) var calls: [AuthorityCall] = []
    private(set) var ackBodies: [Data] = []
    private(set) var releaseBodies: [Data] = []
    private var authorityMode: AuthorityMode = .normal
    private var releaseMode: ReleaseAuthorityMode = .normal
    private var committedAck: (body: Data, response: InstallAuthorityAttestation)?
    private var committedPin: (body: Data, response: RoundPinAuthorityAttestation)?
    private var committedRelease: (body: Data, response: RoundPinReleaseAttestation)?

    init(bundle: CourseInstallBundle, bodies: [String: Data], securityDomainId: String, reservationPayload: TestInstallReservation) {
        self.bundle=bundle; self.bodies=bodies; self.securityDomainId=securityDomainId; self.reservationPayload=reservationPayload
    }

    func configure(authorityMode: AuthorityMode? = nil, releaseMode: ReleaseAuthorityMode? = nil) {
        if let authorityMode { self.authorityMode = authorityMode }
        if let releaseMode { self.releaseMode = releaseMode }
    }

    private func jsonValue<T: Encodable>(_ value: T) throws -> JSONValue {
        try JSONDecoder().decode(JSONValue.self, from: CanonicalJSON.encode(value))
    }

    func manifest(layoutId: String, profileId: String, installInstanceId: String) async throws -> CourseInstallBundle {
        guard layoutId == "layout-1", profileId == "ios-v1",
              installInstanceId == reservationPayload.installInstanceId else {
            throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
        }
        manifestRequestCount += 1
        return bundle
    }
    func asset(_ asset: ManifestAsset, opaqueAssetId: String, groupId: String, installManifestId: String, snapshotId: String, missingRanges: [VerifiedByteRange]) async throws -> AsyncThrowingStream<InstallChunk, Error> {
        assetRequestCount += 1
        let body = bodies[asset.hash]!
        return AsyncThrowingStream { continuation in
            for range in missingRanges.reversed() {
                let bytes = body.subdata(in: range.start..<range.endExclusive)
                continuation.yield(InstallChunk(snapshotId: snapshotId, installManifestId: installManifestId, assetHash: asset.hash, assetGroup: groupId, ordinal: asset.ordinal, offset: range.start, totalLength: asset.size, bytes: bytes))
                continuation.yield(InstallChunk(snapshotId: snapshotId, installManifestId: installManifestId, assetHash: asset.hash, assetGroup: groupId, ordinal: asset.ordinal, offset: range.start, totalLength: asset.size, bytes: bytes))
            }
            continuation.finish()
        }
    }

    func acknowledgeInstalled(_ acknowledgement: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation {
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.encode(acknowledgement)
        ackBodies.append(body)
        lastAckedManifestId = acknowledgement.installManifestId
        let response: InstallAuthorityAttestation
        if let committedAck {
            guard committedAck.body == body else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            response = committedAck.response
        } else {
            response = InstallAuthorityAttestation(installAckId: acknowledgement.installAckId, accountId: "account-a", securityDomainId: securityDomainId, deviceId: "ios-device-1", credentialId: "credential-ios-device-1", profileId: acknowledgement.profileId, installManifestId: acknowledgement.installManifestId, snapshotId: acknowledgement.snapshotId, installInstanceId: acknowledgement.installInstanceId, staticAuthorityHash: acknowledgement.staticAuthorityHash, installGeneration: 1, verifiedAt: acknowledgement.verifiedAt, commitMarkerHash: acknowledgement.commitMarkerHash, rangeBitmapHash: acknowledgement.rangeBitmapHash, state: "verified")
            committedAck = (body, response)
            calls.append(AuthorityCall(operation:"install-ack",installInstanceId:acknowledgement.installInstanceId,verifiedAt:acknowledgement.verifiedAt,body:body))
        }
        if authorityMode == .commitThenLoseResponse { throw CourseTransportError.connectivity }
        return response
    }

    func acknowledgeInstall(_ request: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation {
        try await acknowledgeInstalled(request)
    }

    func commitRoundPin(_ request: RoundDevicePinRequest) async throws -> RoundPinAuthorityAttestation {
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.encode(request)
        if let committedPin {
            guard committedPin.body == body else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return committedPin.response
        }
        let response = RoundPinAuthorityAttestation(pinId:try TypedID.make(domain:"CourseRoundDevicePin/v1",value:jsonValue(request)),roundId:request.roundId,roundIntentId:request.roundIntentId,roundIncarnationId:request.roundIncarnationId,installAckId:request.installAckId,generation:1,controlGeneration:max(request.grantGeneration,request.channelGeneration,request.safetyGeneration,request.purgeGeneration,request.trustedTimeGeneration),staticAuthorityHash:request.staticAuthorityHash,effectiveControlHash:request.effectiveControlHash,semanticBindingHash:request.semanticBindingHash,eventIdentity:request.eventIdentity,eventHash:request.eventHash,canonicalEventBytesSha256:request.canonicalEventBytesSha256,verifiedAt:request.verifiedAt,state:"active")
        committedPin = (body, response)
        calls.append(AuthorityCall(operation:"round-pin",installInstanceId:request.installInstanceId,verifiedAt:request.verifiedAt,body:body))
        return response
    }

    func syncRoundStarted(pinId: String, canonicalEventBytes: Data) async throws -> RoundStartSyncReceipt {
        let event = try JSONDecoder().decode(DomainRoundEvent.self, from: canonicalEventBytes)
        guard try CanonicalJSON.encode(event) == canonicalEventBytes,
              committedPin?.response.pinId == pinId else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        if !calls.contains(where: { $0.operation == "round-start-sync" && $0.body == canonicalEventBytes }) {
            calls.append(AuthorityCall(operation:"round-start-sync",installInstanceId:committedAck!.response.installInstanceId,verifiedAt:committedPin!.response.verifiedAt,body:canonicalEventBytes))
        }
        return RoundStartSyncReceipt(eventIdentity:try event.eventIdentity(),eventHash:try event.eventHash(),status:"accepted")
    }

    func releaseRoundPin(_ request: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseAttestation {
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.encode(request)
        releaseBodies.append(body)
        let response: RoundPinReleaseAttestation
        if let committedRelease {
            guard committedRelease.body == body else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            response = committedRelease.response
        } else {
            let releaseId = try TypedID.make(domain:"CourseRoundPinRelease/v1",value:jsonValue(request))
            let watermark = try TypedID.make(domain:"RoundPinRecoveryWatermark/v1",value:.object([
                "originEpoch":.string(request.originEpoch),
                "producedThroughClientSequence":.integer(request.producedThroughClientSequence),
                "consumerEpoch":.string(request.consumerEpoch),
                "vectorGeneration":.integer(request.vectorGeneration),
                "mergeControlGeneration":.integer(request.mergeControlGeneration),
                "throughPosition":.string(request.throughPosition),
                "ackCheckpointHash":.string(request.ackCheckpointHash),
            ]))
            response = RoundPinReleaseAttestation(schema:"CourseRoundPinReleaseAttestation/v1",releaseId:releaseId,releaseIntentId:request.releaseIntentId,pinId:request.pinId,roundId:request.roundId,roundIncarnationId:request.roundIncarnationId,installAckId:request.installAckId,previousGeneration:request.expectedPinGeneration,generation:request.expectedPinGeneration+1,state:"released",terminalEventIdentity:request.terminalEventIdentity,terminalEventHash:request.terminalEventHash,recoveryWatermarkHash:watermark,localOutboxStateHash:request.localOutboxStateHash,releasedAt:request.verifiedAt)
            committedRelease = (body, response)
        }
        if releaseMode == .commitThenLoseResponse { throw CourseTransportError.connectivity }
        return response
    }
}

    let domain: InstallSecurityDomain
    let installManifestId: String
}

    func pinCount(_ binding: FixtureInstallBinding) async throws -> Int {
        try await pinCount(domain: binding.domain, manifestId: binding.installManifestId)

func XCTAssertThrowsErrorAsync<T>(
    _ operation: @escaping @Sendable () async throws -> T,
    file: StaticString = #filePath,
    line: UInt = #line
) async {
    do {
        _ = try await operation()
        XCTFail("expected async operation to throw", file: file, line: line)
    } catch {}
}

actor RecordingLocalRoundLedger: LocalRoundLedger {
    private struct Stored: Sendable { let eventIdentity: String; let eventHash: String; let bytes: Data }
    private var stored: [String: Stored] = [:]

    func appendExactRoundStarted(_ canonicalEventBytes: Data, eventIdentity: String, eventHash: String) throws {
        let event = try JSONDecoder().decode(DomainRoundEvent.self, from: canonicalEventBytes)
        guard event.kind.rawValue == "round_started",
              try CanonicalJSON.encode(event) == canonicalEventBytes,
              try event.eventIdentity() == eventIdentity,
              try event.eventHash() == eventHash else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        if let current = stored[eventIdentity] {
            guard current.eventHash == eventHash, current.bytes == canonicalEventBytes else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return
        }
        stored[eventIdentity] = Stored(eventIdentity:eventIdentity,eventHash:eventHash,bytes:canonicalEventBytes)
    }

    func containsExact(eventIdentity: String, eventHash: String, canonicalBytes: Data) -> Bool {
        guard let current = stored[eventIdentity] else { return false }
        return current.eventHash == eventHash && current.bytes == canonicalBytes
    }

    func count(kind: String) throws -> Int {
        try stored.values.filter { try JSONDecoder().decode(DomainRoundEvent.self, from: $0.bytes).kind.rawValue == kind }.count
    }

    func canonicalEventBytes(kind: String) throws -> Data {
        let matches = try stored.values.filter { try JSONDecoder().decode(DomainRoundEvent.self, from: $0.bytes).kind.rawValue == kind }
        guard matches.count == 1 else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return matches[0].bytes
    }
}

enum ReleaseEvidenceFault: String, CaseIterable, CustomStringConvertible, Sendable {
    case nonTerminal, replicationBehind, pendingOperationalEvent, preparedResolutionCommit, checkpointMismatch
    var description: String { rawValue }
}

struct FixtureReleaseEvidenceProvider: RoundPinReleaseEvidenceProvider {
    let fault: ReleaseEvidenceFault?

    func verifiedReleaseEvidence(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseEvidence {
        switch fault {
        case .nonTerminal, .replicationBehind, .checkpointMismatch:
            throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked
        default:
            break
        }
        return RoundPinReleaseEvidence(
            terminalEventIdentity:String(repeating:"a",count:64),terminalEventHash:String(repeating:"b",count:64),
            originEpoch:"origin-1",producedThroughClientSequence:1,consumerEpoch:"consumer-1",
            vectorGeneration:1,mergeControlGeneration:0,throughPosition:"1",ackCheckpointHash:String(repeating:"c",count:64),
            pendingEventIdentities:fault == .pendingOperationalEvent ? [String(repeating:"d",count:64)] : [],
            pendingResolutionCommitIds:fault == .preparedResolutionCommit ? [String(repeating:"e",count:64)] : []
        )
    }
}

struct RoundStartCoordinatorHarness {
    let root: URL
    let fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore
    let transport: RecordingCourseInstallTransport
    let authority: RecordingCourseInstallTransport
    let authorityStore: CourseInstallFileAuthorityStore
    let ledger: RecordingLocalRoundLedger
    let journal: RoundStartIntentJournal
    let releaseJournal: RoundPinReleaseJournal
    let releaseEvidence: FixtureReleaseEvidenceProvider
    let trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore
    let coordinator: RoundStartCoordinator
    let releaseCoordinator: RoundPinReleaseCoordinator
    let domain: InstallSecurityDomain
    let binding: FixtureInstallBinding
    let request: RoundStartRequest
    let completedStart: RoundStartIntentRecord?

    static func makeInstalled(
        fault: RoundStartFault? = nil,
        authorityMode: AuthorityMode = .normal,
        releaseMode: ReleaseAuthorityMode = .normal,
        releaseEvidenceFault: ReleaseEvidenceFault? = nil
    ) async throws -> RoundStartCoordinatorHarness {
        let base = try CourseInstallerTestHarness.make()
        await base.transport.configure(authorityMode:authorityMode,releaseMode:releaseMode)
        _ = try await base.installer.install(layoutId:"layout-1",profileId:"ios-v1",installIntentId:"install-intent-1")
        let persistedInstall = try await base.fileStore.installedRecord(domain:base.domain,manifestId:base.manifestId)
        let installed = try XCTUnwrap(persistedInstall)
        let domain = base.domain, manifestId = base.manifestId
        let authorityStore = CourseInstallFileAuthorityStore(fileStore:base.fileStore,trustStore:base.trustStore,generations:base.generations) { accountId, profileId, requestedManifest in
            guard accountId == domain.accountId, profileId == domain.deviceProfile, requestedManifest == manifestId else { return nil }
            return domain
        }
        let journal=RoundStartIntentJournal(root:base.root.appending(path:"round-start-intents"))
        let releaseJournal=RoundPinReleaseJournal(root:base.root.appending(path:"round-pin-release-intents"))
        let ledger=RecordingLocalRoundLedger(),evidence=FixtureReleaseEvidenceProvider(fault:releaseEvidenceFault)
        let request=RoundStartRequest(accountId:"account-a",subjectPlayerId:"player-a",actorId:"player-a",deviceId:"ios-device-1",credentialId:"credential-ios-device-1",profileId:"ios-v1",roundId:"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",roundIntentId:"round-intent-1",eventId:"round-start-event-1",originEpoch:"origin-1",clientSequence:1,installManifestId:manifestId,snapshotId:installed.snapshotId,courseLayoutIdentityId:installed.courseLayoutIdentityId,layoutRevisionId:installed.layoutRevisionId,teeSelectionId:installed.teeSelectionId,liveRoundPackageId:installed.liveRoundPackageIds[0],expectedInstallRecordGeneration:installed.recordGeneration)
        let coordinator=RoundStartCoordinator(journal:journal,fileStore:base.fileStore,staticAuthority:authorityStore,ledger:ledger,transport:base.transport,trustedTime:base.trustedTime,fault:fault,newIncarnation:{"round-incarnation-1"})
        let releaseCoordinator=RoundPinReleaseCoordinator(journal:releaseJournal,fileStore:base.fileStore,transport:base.transport,evidence:evidence,trustedTime:base.trustedTime)
        return RoundStartCoordinatorHarness(root:base.root,fileStore:base.fileStore,transport:base.transport,authority:base.transport,authorityStore:authorityStore,ledger:ledger,journal:journal,releaseJournal:releaseJournal,releaseEvidence:evidence,trustedTime:base.trustedTime,coordinator:coordinator,releaseCoordinator:releaseCoordinator,domain:domain,binding:FixtureInstallBinding(domain:domain,installManifestId:manifestId),request:request,completedStart:nil)
    }

    static func makeCompletedRound(
        releaseMode: ReleaseAuthorityMode = .normal,
        releaseEvidenceFault: ReleaseEvidenceFault? = nil
    ) async throws -> RoundStartCoordinatorHarness {
        let harness = try await makeInstalled(releaseMode:releaseMode,releaseEvidenceFault:releaseEvidenceFault)
        let completed = try await harness.coordinator.start(harness.request)
        guard completed.state == .complete else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return harness.replacing(completedStart:completed)
    }

    func reopen(fault: RoundStartFault? = nil, authorityMode: AuthorityMode? = nil) async throws -> RoundStartCoordinatorHarness {
        await transport.configure(authorityMode:authorityMode)
        let reopened=RoundStartIntentJournal(root:root.appending(path:"round-start-intents"))
        let coordinator=RoundStartCoordinator(journal:reopened,fileStore:fileStore,staticAuthority:authorityStore,ledger:ledger,transport:transport,trustedTime:trustedTime,fault:fault,newIncarnation:{"round-incarnation-1"})
        return replacing(coordinator:coordinator,journal:reopened)
    }

    func reopenRelease(mode: ReleaseAuthorityMode) async throws -> RoundStartCoordinatorHarness {
        await transport.configure(releaseMode:mode)
        let reopened=RoundPinReleaseJournal(root:root.appending(path:"round-pin-release-intents"))
        return replacing(releaseJournal:reopened,releaseCoordinator:RoundPinReleaseCoordinator(journal:reopened,fileStore:fileStore,transport:transport,evidence:releaseEvidence,trustedTime:trustedTime))
    }

    func prepareServerReleasedIntent(releaseIntentId: String) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord {
        let start = try XCTUnwrap(completedStart), pin = try XCTUnwrap(start.roundPinAuthority), expected = try XCTUnwrap(start.committedInstallRecordGeneration)
        let proof = try await releaseEvidence.verifiedReleaseEvidence(roundId:start.roundId,roundIncarnationId:start.roundIncarnationId)
        guard proof.pendingEventIdentities.isEmpty, proof.pendingResolutionCommitIds.isEmpty else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let localOutboxStateHash=try TypedID.make(domain:"LocalRoundOutboxEmpty/v1",value:.object(["roundId":.string(start.roundId),"pendingEventIdentities":.array([]),"pendingResolutionCommitIds":.array([])]))
        let now=try await trustedTime.effectiveNow(wallTime:Date(),uptime:ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime,bootSessionId:String(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970-ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime)))
        let request=CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest(schema:"CourseRoundPinRelease/v1",releaseIntentId:releaseIntentId,pinId:pin.pinId,roundId:start.roundId,roundIntentId:start.roundIntentId,roundIncarnationId:start.roundIncarnationId,installAckId:start.installAckId,expectedPinGeneration:pin.generation,terminalEventIdentity:proof.terminalEventIdentity,terminalEventHash:proof.terminalEventHash,originEpoch:proof.originEpoch,producedThroughClientSequence:proof.producedThroughClientSequence,consumerEpoch:proof.consumerEpoch,vectorGeneration:proof.vectorGeneration,mergeControlGeneration:proof.mergeControlGeneration,throughPosition:proof.throughPosition,ackCheckpointHash:proof.ackCheckpointHash,localOutboxStateHash:localOutboxStateHash,verifiedAt:TrustedTimeStore.timestamp(now))
        var value=try await releaseJournal.prepare(RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord(installDomain:start.installDomain,installManifestId:start.installManifestId,expectedInstallRecordGeneration:expected,request:request,attestation:nil,committedInstallRecordGeneration:nil,state:.prepared))
        value.attestation=try await transport.releaseRoundPin(request);value.state = .authorityCommitted
        try await releaseJournal.advance(value,expected:.prepared)
        return value
    }

    func cleanup() { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }

    private func replacing(
        completedStart: RoundStartIntentRecord? = nil,
        coordinator: RoundStartCoordinator? = nil,
        journal: RoundStartIntentJournal? = nil,
        releaseJournal: RoundPinReleaseJournal? = nil,
        releaseCoordinator: RoundPinReleaseCoordinator? = nil
    ) -> RoundStartCoordinatorHarness {
        RoundStartCoordinatorHarness(root:root,fileStore:fileStore,transport:transport,authority:authority,authorityStore:authorityStore,ledger:ledger,journal:journal ?? self.journal,releaseJournal:releaseJournal ?? self.releaseJournal,releaseEvidence:releaseEvidence,trustedTime:trustedTime,coordinator:coordinator ?? self.coordinator,releaseCoordinator:releaseCoordinator ?? self.releaseCoordinator,domain:domain,binding:binding,request:request,completedStart:completedStart ?? self.completedStart)
    }
}
```

`POSIXCourseInstallFileSystem.atomicReplace` 必须在同 volume staging/installed 之间使用 `FileManager.replaceItemAt` 或 `rename(2)`，每个 asset/marker/index 写后 fsync 文件，rename 后 fsync parent directory。`InstallSecurityDomain.id` 由 Plan 1 TypedID/registry 生成，客户端不能接受 server 任意字符串绕过其签名 grant fields。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/CourseServiceClient.swift
import AICaddieDomain
import Foundation

private struct CourseEventReceiptEnvelope: Codable { let receipts: [EventReceipt] }

final class IOSCourseServiceClient: CourseInstallTransport, RoundStartAuthorityTransport, @unchecked Sendable {
    private let baseURL: URL; private let session: URLSession; private let signer: any DeviceRequestSigner
    init(baseURL: URL, session: URLSession = .shared, signer: any DeviceRequestSigner) { self.baseURL=baseURL; self.session=session; self.signer=signer }
    private func request(target: String, method: String = "GET", body: Data = Data(), headers: [String:String] = [:], audience: DeviceRequestAudience = .courseService) async throws -> URLRequest { let proof=try signer.sign(method:method,target:target,body:body,audience:audience); var value=URLRequest(url:try CanonicalRequestTarget.url(baseURL:baseURL,target:target)); value.httpMethod=method; value.httpBody=body.isEmpty ? nil : body; for (name,content) in proof.values.merging(headers,uniquingKeysWith:{_,rhs in rhs}) { value.setValue(content,forHTTPHeaderField:name) }; return value }
    private func checked(_ request: URLRequest, expected: Set<Int>) async throws -> (Data, HTTPURLResponse) {
        let pair: (Data, URLResponse)
        do {
            pair = try await session.data(for: request)
        } catch let error as URLError where [.notConnectedToInternet,.networkConnectionLost,.cannotConnectToHost,.cannotFindHost,.timedOut,.dnsLookupFailed,.internationalRoamingOff,.callIsActive,.dataNotAllowed].contains(error.code) {
            _ = error
            throw CourseTransportError.connectivity
        }
        guard let http = pair.1 as? HTTPURLResponse else { throw CourseTransportError.responseShape }
        guard expected.contains(http.statusCode) else { throw CourseTransportError.httpStatus(http.statusCode) }
        return (pair.0, http)
    }
    func manifest(layoutId: String, profileId: String, installInstanceId: String) async throws -> CourseInstallBundle { let target=try CanonicalRequestTarget.pathAndSortedQuery(path:"/api/v2/course-service/channels/\(layoutId)/manifest",query:[("installInstanceId",installInstanceId),("profileId",profileId)]); let (data,_)=try await checked(try await request(target:target),expected:[200]); return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(CourseInstallBundle.self,from:data) }
    func asset(_ asset: ManifestAsset, opaqueAssetId: String, groupId: String, installManifestId: String, snapshotId: String, missingRanges: [VerifiedByteRange]) async throws -> AsyncThrowingStream<InstallChunk, Error> {
        AsyncThrowingStream { continuation in Task { do { for range in missingRanges { let target="/api/v2/course-service/assets/private/\(opaqueAssetId)"; let value=try await self.request(target:target,headers:["Range":"bytes=\(range.start)-\(range.endExclusive-1)"]); let (data,response)=try await self.checked(value,expected:[206]); guard response.value(forHTTPHeaderField:"Content-Range")=="bytes \(range.start)-\(range.endExclusive-1)/\(asset.size)", data.count==range.endExclusive-range.start else { throw CourseInstallError.chunkIdentity }; continuation.yield(InstallChunk(snapshotId:snapshotId,installManifestId:installManifestId,assetHash:asset.hash,assetGroup:groupId,ordinal:asset.ordinal,offset:range.start,totalLength:asset.size,bytes:data)) }; continuation.finish() } catch { continuation.finish(throwing:error) } } }
    }
    func acknowledgeInstalled(_ acknowledgement: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation { let body=try CanonicalJSON.encode(acknowledgement); let value=try await request(target:"/api/v2/course-service/installs/ack",method:"POST",body:body,headers:["Content-Type":"application/json"]); return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(InstallAuthorityAttestation.self,from:try await checked(value,expected:[201]).0) }
    func commitRoundPin(_ pin: RoundDevicePinRequest) async throws -> RoundPinAuthorityAttestation { let body=try CanonicalJSON.encode(pin); let value=try await request(target:"/api/v2/course-service/round-pins",method:"POST",body:body,headers:["Content-Type":"application/json"]); return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(RoundPinAuthorityAttestation.self,from:try await checked(value,expected:[201]).0) }
    func releaseRoundPin(_ release: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseAttestation { let body=try CanonicalJSON.encode(release); let target="/api/v2/course-service/round-pins/\(release.pinId)/release"; let value=try await request(target:target,method:"POST",body:body,headers:["Content-Type":"application/json"]); return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(RoundPinReleaseAttestation.self,from:try await checked(value,expected:[200]).0) }
    func acknowledgeInstall(_ request: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation { try await acknowledgeInstalled(request) }
    func syncRoundStarted(pinId _: String, canonicalEventBytes: Data) async throws -> RoundStartSyncReceipt {
        let event = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(DomainRoundEvent.self, from: canonicalEventBytes)
        guard try CanonicalJSON.encode(event) == canonicalEventBytes else { throw CourseTransportError.responseShape }
        let body = try RoundTransportValidator.validateBatch([event])
        let eventValue = try JSONDecoder().decode(JSONValue.self, from: canonicalEventBytes)
        let key = try TypedID.make(domain:"RoundEventBatch/v1",value:.object(["roundId":.string(event.roundId),"events":.array([eventValue])]))
        let target = "/api/v2/round-ledger/\(event.roundId)/events"
        let value = try await request(target:target,method:"POST",body:body,headers:["Content-Type":"application/json","Idempotency-Key":key],audience:.eventIngest)
        let response = try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(CourseEventReceiptEnvelope.self,from:try await checked(value,expected:[200]).0)
        guard response.receipts.count == 1,
              response.receipts[0].eventIdentity == (try event.eventIdentity()),
              response.receipts[0].eventHash == (try event.eventHash()),
              [.accepted,.duplicateHashMatch].contains(response.receipts[0].status) else { throw CourseTransportError.responseShape }
        return RoundStartSyncReceipt(eventIdentity:response.receipts[0].eventIdentity,eventHash:response.receipts[0].eventHash,status:response.receipts[0].status.rawValue)
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 durable round-start intent journal 与 recoverable local saga**

`OfflineStore` 继续只拥有 round ledger/outbox；course asset bytes/path 仍只在 `CourseInstallFileStore`。但 start 不能再靠 `MemoryRoundStarter` 或一次性 `pinCount += 1`：新增 durable `RoundStartIntentJournal`，状态严格为 `prepared -> installPinCommitted -> roundStartedCommitted -> complete`。journal 保存 account/device/profile、`roundId/roundIntentId/roundIncarnationId`、snapshot/manifest、semantic binding hash、stable `installInstanceId`、trusted-time-derived `verifiedAt`、event identity、exact canonical event bytes、install ACK request/attestation 与 sync receipt。相同 intent + 相同 binding 重用 incarnation；相同 intent + 不同 binding permanent conflict。

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/RoundStartIntentJournal.swift
import Foundation

public enum RoundStartIntentState: String, Codable, Sendable {
    case prepared, installPinCommitted, roundStartedCommitted, complete
}
```
