```swift
    public let accountId: String
    public let subjectPlayerId: String
    public let actorId: String
    public let deviceId: String
    public let credentialId: String
    public let profileId: String
    public let roundId: String
    public let roundIntentId: String
    public let roundIncarnationId: String
    public let eventId: String
    public let originEpoch: String
    public let clientSequence: Int
    public let snapshotId: String
    public let installManifestId: String
    public let installAckId: String
    public let staticAuthorityHash: String
    public let courseLayoutIdentityId: String
    public let layoutRevisionId: String
    public let teeSelectionId: String
    public let liveRoundPackageId: String
    public let semanticBindingHash: String
    public let installInstanceId: String
    public let installVerifiedAt: String
    public let startVerifiedAt: String
    public let grantGeneration: Int
    public let channelGeneration: Int
    public let safetyGeneration: Int
    public let purgeGeneration: Int
    public let trustedTimeGeneration: Int
    public let trustedTimePayloadId: String
    public let effectiveControlHash: String
    public let eventIdentity: String
    public let eventHash: String
    public let canonicalEventBytes: Data
    public let expectedInstallRecordGeneration: Int
    public var committedInstallRecordGeneration: Int?
    public var installAuthority: InstallAuthorityAttestation?
    public var roundPinAuthority: RoundPinAuthorityAttestation?
    public var syncReceipt: RoundStartSyncReceipt?
    public var state: RoundStartIntentState

    public var immutableIdentity: [String] {
        [installDomain.id, accountId, subjectPlayerId, actorId, deviceId, credentialId, profileId, roundId, roundIntentId,
         roundIncarnationId, eventId, originEpoch, String(clientSequence), snapshotId, installManifestId, installAckId, staticAuthorityHash,
         courseLayoutIdentityId, layoutRevisionId, teeSelectionId, liveRoundPackageId,
         semanticBindingHash, installInstanceId, installVerifiedAt, startVerifiedAt,
         String(grantGeneration), String(channelGeneration), String(safetyGeneration),
         String(purgeGeneration), String(trustedTimeGeneration), trustedTimePayloadId, effectiveControlHash,
         eventIdentity, eventHash]
    }
}

public actor RoundStartIntentJournal {
    private let root: URL
    private let encoder = JSONEncoder()
    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()
    public init(root: URL) { self.root = root }

    private func url(_ intent: String) throws -> URL {
        guard intent.range(of: #"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$"#, options: .regularExpression) != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return root.appending(path: "\(intent).json")
    }

    public func load(roundIntentId: String) throws -> RoundStartIntentRecord? {
        let path = try url(roundIntentId)
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: path.path) else { return nil }
        return try decoder.decode(RoundStartIntentRecord.self, from: Data(contentsOf: path))
    }

    public func prepare(_ candidate: RoundStartIntentRecord) throws -> RoundStartIntentRecord {
        if let current = try load(roundIntentId: candidate.roundIntentId) {
            guard current.immutableIdentity == candidate.immutableIdentity,
                  current.canonicalEventBytes == candidate.canonicalEventBytes else {
                throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict
            }
            return current
        }
        try persist(candidate)
        return candidate
    }

    public func advance(_ replacement: RoundStartIntentRecord, expected: RoundStartIntentState) throws {
        guard let current = try load(roundIntentId: replacement.roundIntentId),
              current.state == expected,
              current.immutableIdentity == replacement.immutableIdentity else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
        let allowed = (expected, replacement.state)
        guard allowed == (.prepared, .installPinCommitted)
            || allowed == (.installPinCommitted, .roundStartedCommitted)
            || allowed == (.roundStartedCommitted, .roundStartedCommitted)
            || allowed == (.roundStartedCommitted, .complete) else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
        if allowed == (.roundStartedCommitted, .roundStartedCommitted) {
            let installedNow = current.installAuthority == nil && replacement.installAuthority != nil && current.roundPinAuthority == replacement.roundPinAuthority
            let pinnedNow = current.roundPinAuthority == nil && replacement.roundPinAuthority != nil && current.installAuthority == replacement.installAuthority
            guard (installedNow != pinnedNow), replacement.syncReceipt == nil else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
        }
        try persist(replacement)
    }

    public func removePrepared(roundIntentId: String) throws {
        guard let current = try load(roundIntentId: roundIntentId), current.state == .prepared else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url(roundIntentId))
    }

    private func persist(_ value: RoundStartIntentRecord) throws {
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
        let path = try url(value.roundIntentId)
        try encoder.encode(value).write(to: path, options: [.atomic, .completeFileProtection])
        let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: path); try handle.synchronize(); try handle.close()
        let descriptor = open(root.path, O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY); guard descriptor >= 0 else { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        defer { close(descriptor) }; guard fsync(descriptor) == 0 else { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/RoundStartCoordinator.swift
import AICaddieDomain
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public struct LocalVerifiedEffectiveCourseControl: Sendable {
    public let grantGeneration: Int
    public let channelGeneration: Int
    public let safetyGeneration: Int
    public let purgeGeneration: Int
    public let trustedTimeGeneration: Int
    public let trustedTimePayloadId: String
    public let controlGeneration: Int
    public let canStartNewRound: Bool
    public let canContinueActiveRound: Bool
    public let mapEnabled: Bool
    public let guidanceEnabled: Bool
    public let effectiveControlHash: String
    public let projectedAt: Date
}

public struct VerifiedLocalCourseControls: Sendable {
    public let grant: SnapshotGrantPayload
    public let channel: CourseReleaseChannelPayload
    public let safety: SafetyPolicyPayload
    public let purge: PurgeDirectivePayload?
    public let trustedTime: TrustedTimeTokenPayload
    public let grantPayloadId: String
    public let channelPayloadId: String
    public let safetyPayloadId: String
    public let purgePayloadId: String?
    public let trustedTimePayloadId: String
}

public enum LocalCourseControlProjector {
    public static func project(accountId: String, record: InstallRecord, controls: VerifiedLocalCourseControls, at: Date, activeRound: Bool = false) throws -> LocalVerifiedEffectiveCourseControl {
        let formatter = ISO8601DateFormatter(); formatter.formatOptions = [.withInternetDateTime, .withFractionalSeconds]
        guard let expires = formatter.date(from: controls.grant.expiresAt),
              let trustedIssued = formatter.date(from: controls.trustedTime.issuedAt),
              let offlineNotAfter = formatter.date(from: controls.trustedTime.offlineNotAfter) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let trustedDeadline = min(offlineNotAfter, trustedIssued.addingTimeInterval(TimeInterval(controls.trustedTime.maxOfflineAgeSeconds)))
        let purgePending = controls.purge != nil
        let denyNew = controls.safety.effectiveRules.denyNewRound || expires < at || purgePending || at > trustedDeadline
        let hardDisable = purgePending || controls.safety.effectiveRules.disableMap
        let canContinueActiveRound = activeRound && controls.grant.activeRoundContinuation && !purgePending
        let purgeGeneration = controls.purge?.generation ?? 0
        let projectedAt = formatter.string(from: at)
        let projection = JSONValue.object([
            "accountId": .string(accountId),
            "securityDomainId": .string(record.authoritySecurityDomainId),
            "snapshotId": .string(record.snapshotId),
            "installManifestId": .string(record.installedManifestId),
            "grantGeneration": .integer(controls.grant.generation),
            "channelGeneration": .integer(controls.channel.generation),
            "safetyGeneration": .integer(controls.safety.policyVersion),
            "purgeGeneration": .integer(purgeGeneration),
            "trustedTimeGeneration": .integer(controls.trustedTime.tokenGeneration),
            "trustedTimePayloadId": .string(controls.trustedTimePayloadId),
            "canStartNewRound": .bool(!denyNew),
            "canContinueActiveRound": .bool(canContinueActiveRound),
            "mapEnabled": .bool(!hardDisable),
            "guidanceEnabled": .bool(!hardDisable && !controls.safety.effectiveRules.disableGuidance),
            "projectedAt": .string(projectedAt),
        ])
        return LocalVerifiedEffectiveCourseControl(
            grantGeneration: controls.grant.generation,
            channelGeneration: controls.channel.generation,
            safetyGeneration: controls.safety.policyVersion,
            purgeGeneration: purgeGeneration,
            trustedTimeGeneration: controls.trustedTime.tokenGeneration,
            trustedTimePayloadId: controls.trustedTimePayloadId,
            controlGeneration: max(controls.grant.generation, controls.channel.generation, controls.safety.policyVersion, purgeGeneration, controls.trustedTime.tokenGeneration),
            canStartNewRound: !denyNew,
            canContinueActiveRound: canContinueActiveRound,
            mapEnabled: !hardDisable,
            guidanceEnabled: !hardDisable && !controls.safety.effectiveRules.disableGuidance,
            effectiveControlHash: try TypedID.make(domain: "EffectiveCourseControl/v1", value: projection),
            projectedAt: at
        )
    }
}

public struct VerifiedInstalledCourseAuthority: Sendable {
    public let installDomain: InstallSecurityDomain
    public let staticAuthority: VerifiedCourseStaticAuthority
    public let installReservation: VerifiedCourseInstallReservation
    public let installRecord: InstallRecord
    public let installAttestation: InstallAuthorityAttestation?
    public let verifiedControls: VerifiedLocalCourseControls

    public var staticAuthorityHash: String { staticAuthority.staticAuthorityHash }
    public var installAckId: String { installRecord.installAckId }
    public var installInstanceId: String { installRecord.installInstanceId }
    public var installVerifiedAt: String { installRecord.installVerifiedAt }

    public func requireStartAllowed(effectiveNow: Date) throws -> LocalVerifiedEffectiveCourseControl {
        let control = try LocalCourseControlProjector.project(accountId: installDomain.accountId, record: installRecord, controls: verifiedControls, at: effectiveNow)
        guard installRecord.materialization == .installed,
              installRecord.health == .verified,
              installRecord.rights == .allowed,
              installRecord.staticAuthorityHash == staticAuthority.staticAuthorityHash,
              control.canStartNewRound else {
            throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked
        }
        return control
    }

    fileprivate func projectActiveRoundControl(durablePin: DurableActiveRoundPin, effectiveNow: Date) throws -> LocalVerifiedEffectiveCourseControl {
        let localPin = durablePin.localPin
        guard installRecord.pinCount > 0,
              durablePin.installRecord == installRecord,
              localPin.installManifestId == installRecord.installedManifestId,
              localPin.snapshotId == installRecord.snapshotId,
              installRecord.staticAuthorityHash == staticAuthority.staticAuthorityHash else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        if let pinAuthority = durablePin.pinAuthority {
            guard pinAuthority.pinId.range(of:#"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"#,options:.regularExpression) != nil,
                  pinAuthority.generation >= 1,
                  pinAuthority.generation <= 9_007_199_254_740_991,
                  pinAuthority.roundId == localPin.roundId,
                  pinAuthority.roundIntentId == localPin.roundIntentId,
                  pinAuthority.roundIncarnationId == localPin.roundIncarnationId,
                  pinAuthority.installAckId == installRecord.installAckId,
                  pinAuthority.staticAuthorityHash == installRecord.staticAuthorityHash,
                  pinAuthority.semanticBindingHash == localPin.semanticBindingHash,
                  pinAuthority.eventIdentity == localPin.eventIdentity,
                  pinAuthority.eventHash == localPin.eventHash,
                  pinAuthority.canonicalEventBytesSha256 == localPin.canonicalEventBytesSha256,
                  pinAuthority.verifiedAt == localPin.startVerifiedAt,
                  pinAuthority.state == "active" else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        }
        let control = try LocalCourseControlProjector.project(accountId: installDomain.accountId, record: installRecord, controls: verifiedControls, at: effectiveNow, activeRound: true)
        guard control.canContinueActiveRound else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return control
    }
}

public struct VerifiedActiveRoundCourseAuthority: Sendable {
    public let authority: VerifiedInstalledCourseAuthority
    public let localPin: LocalRoundInstallPin
    public let pinAuthority: RoundPinAuthorityAttestation?
    public let effectiveControl: LocalVerifiedEffectiveCourseControl
}

public protocol InstalledCourseStaticAuthorityStore: Sendable {
    func loadVerified(accountId: String, deviceId: String, credentialId: String, profileId: String, snapshotId: String, installManifestId: String) async throws -> VerifiedInstalledCourseAuthority
}

public actor CourseInstallFileAuthorityStore: InstalledCourseStaticAuthorityStore {
    private let fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore
    private let trustStore: CourseSigningTrustStore
    private let generations: ControlGenerationStore
    private let resolveDomain: @Sendable (String, String, String) async throws -> InstallSecurityDomain?

    public init(fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore, trustStore: CourseSigningTrustStore, generations: ControlGenerationStore, resolveDomain: @escaping @Sendable (String, String, String) async throws -> InstallSecurityDomain?) {
        self.fileStore = fileStore; self.trustStore = trustStore; self.generations = generations; self.resolveDomain = resolveDomain
    }

    public func loadVerified(accountId: String, deviceId: String, credentialId: String, profileId: String, snapshotId: String, installManifestId: String) async throws -> VerifiedInstalledCourseAuthority {
        guard let domain = try await resolveDomain(accountId, profileId, installManifestId),
              domain.accountId == accountId, domain.deviceProfile == profileId,
              let record = try await fileStore.installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: installManifestId),
              record.snapshotId == snapshotId else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let persisted = try await fileStore.installedAuthority(domain: domain, manifestId: installManifestId)
        let controls = try await fileStore.installedControls(domain: domain, manifestId: installManifestId)
        let manifest = try CourseManifestVerifier.verify(controls.manifestEnvelope, trustStore: trustStore)
        let reverifiedStatic = try CourseStaticAuthorityVerifier.verify(
            persisted.rawEnvelope,
            manifest: manifest,
            securityDomainId: record.authoritySecurityDomainId,
            layoutIdentityId: record.courseLayoutIdentityId,
            verifiedAt: record.installVerifiedAt,
            trustStore: trustStore
        )
        guard reverifiedStatic == persisted,
              reverifiedStatic.staticAuthorityHash == record.staticAuthorityHash else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let reservation = try CourseInstallReservationVerifier.verify(
            controls.installReservationEnvelope,
            manifest: manifest,
            staticAuthority: reverifiedStatic,
            accountId: accountId,
            deviceId: deviceId,
            credentialId: credentialId,
            profileId: profileId,
            layoutIdentityId: record.courseLayoutIdentityId,
            installInstanceId: record.installInstanceId,
            trustStore: trustStore
        )
        guard reservation.payload.installAckId == record.installAckId else {
            throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked
        }
        let grantControl = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SnapshotGrant", envelope: controls.grantEnvelope, audience: accountId, trustStore: trustStore, generations: generations, acceptGeneration: false)
        let channelControl = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("CourseReleaseChannel", envelope: controls.channelEnvelope, audience: accountId, trustStore: trustStore, generations: generations, acceptGeneration: false)
        let safetyControl = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("SafetyPolicy", envelope: controls.safetyEnvelope, audience: accountId, trustStore: trustStore, generations: generations, acceptGeneration: false)
        let timeControl = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("TrustedTimeToken", envelope: controls.trustedTimeEnvelope, audience: accountId, trustStore: trustStore, generations: generations, acceptGeneration: false)
        let grant = try grantControl.decode(SnapshotGrantPayload.self)
        let channel = try channelControl.decode(CourseReleaseChannelPayload.self)
        let safety = try safetyControl.decode(SafetyPolicyPayload.self)
        let time = try timeControl.decode(TrustedTimeTokenPayload.self)
        var purge: PurgeDirectivePayload?
        if let envelope = controls.purgeEnvelope {
            let verified = try await SignedControlVerifier.verify("PurgeDirective", envelope: envelope, audience: accountId, trustStore: trustStore, generations: generations, acceptGeneration: false)
            purge = try verified.decode(PurgeDirectivePayload.self)
            guard purge?.accountId == accountId, purge?.securityDomainId == record.authoritySecurityDomainId else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        }
        guard grant.accountId == accountId, grant.allowedProfiles.contains(profileId),
              channel.securityDomainId == record.authoritySecurityDomainId,
              channel.snapshotId == snapshotId,
              channel.installManifestIds[profileId] == installManifestId,
              safety.policyId == channel.safetyPolicyId,
              safety.channelGeneration == channel.generation,
              time.tokenGeneration == time.generation else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let verifiedControls = VerifiedLocalCourseControls(grant: grant, channel: channel, safety: safety, purge: purge, trustedTime: time, grantPayloadId: controls.grantEnvelope.payloadId, channelPayloadId: controls.channelEnvelope.payloadId, safetyPayloadId: controls.safetyEnvelope.payloadId, purgePayloadId: controls.purgeEnvelope?.payloadId, trustedTimePayloadId: controls.trustedTimeEnvelope.payloadId)
        let attestation = try await fileStore.installedAttestation(domain: domain, manifestId: installManifestId)
        if let attestation {
            guard attestation.accountId == accountId,
                  attestation.securityDomainId == record.authoritySecurityDomainId,
                  attestation.deviceId == deviceId,
                  attestation.credentialId == credentialId,
                  attestation.profileId == profileId, attestation.snapshotId == snapshotId,
                  attestation.installManifestId == installManifestId,
                  attestation.installAckId == record.installAckId,
                  attestation.installInstanceId == record.installInstanceId,
                  attestation.staticAuthorityHash == record.staticAuthorityHash,
                  attestation.verifiedAt == record.installVerifiedAt,
                  attestation.commitMarkerHash == record.commitMarkerHash,
                  attestation.rangeBitmapHash == record.rangeBitmapHash,
                  attestation.installGeneration >= 1,
                  attestation.installGeneration <= 9_007_199_254_740_991,
                  record.installAckGeneration == attestation.installGeneration,
                  attestation.state == "verified" else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        }
        return VerifiedInstalledCourseAuthority(installDomain: domain, staticAuthority: reverifiedStatic, installReservation: reservation, installRecord: record, installAttestation: attestation, verifiedControls: verifiedControls)
    }

    public func loadVerifiedActiveRound(accountId: String, deviceId: String, credentialId: String, profileId: String, snapshotId: String, installManifestId: String, roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String, effectiveNow: Date) async throws -> VerifiedActiveRoundCourseAuthority {
        let authority = try await loadVerified(accountId: accountId, deviceId: deviceId, credentialId:credentialId, profileId: profileId, snapshotId: snapshotId, installManifestId: installManifestId)
        let durablePin = try await fileStore.activeRoundPin(domain: authority.installDomain, manifestId: installManifestId, roundId: roundId, roundIncarnationId: roundIncarnationId)
        guard durablePin.installRecord.recordGeneration == authority.installRecord.recordGeneration,
              durablePin.installRecord.pinCount > 0 else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let control = try authority.projectActiveRoundControl(durablePin: durablePin, effectiveNow: effectiveNow)
        return VerifiedActiveRoundCourseAuthority(authority: authority, localPin: durablePin.localPin, pinAuthority: durablePin.pinAuthority, effectiveControl: control)
    }
}

protocol RoundStartAuthorityTransport: Sendable {
    func acknowledgeInstall(_ request: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation
    func commitRoundPin(_ request: RoundDevicePinRequest) async throws -> RoundPinAuthorityAttestation
    func releaseRoundPin(_ request: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseAttestation
    func syncRoundStarted(pinId: String, canonicalEventBytes: Data) async throws -> RoundStartSyncReceipt
}

protocol LocalRoundLedger: Sendable {
    func appendExactRoundStarted(_ canonicalEventBytes: Data, eventIdentity: String, eventHash: String) async throws
    func containsExact(eventIdentity: String, eventHash: String, canonicalBytes: Data) async throws -> Bool
}

enum RoundStartFault: Sendable { case afterPrepared, afterInstallPinCommit, afterRoundEventCommit }

struct RoundStartRequest: Sendable {
    let accountId: String; let subjectPlayerId: String; let actorId: String
    let deviceId: String; let credentialId: String; let profileId: String
    let roundId: String; let roundIntentId: String; let eventId: String
    let originEpoch: String; let clientSequence: Int
    let installManifestId: String; let snapshotId: String
    let courseLayoutIdentityId: String; let layoutRevisionId: String
    let teeSelectionId: String; let liveRoundPackageId: String
    let expectedInstallRecordGeneration: Int

    func with(snapshotId: String) -> RoundStartRequest {
        RoundStartRequest(accountId:accountId,subjectPlayerId:subjectPlayerId,actorId:actorId,deviceId:deviceId,credentialId:credentialId,profileId:profileId,roundId:roundId,roundIntentId:roundIntentId,eventId:eventId,originEpoch:originEpoch,clientSequence:clientSequence,installManifestId:installManifestId,snapshotId:snapshotId,courseLayoutIdentityId:courseLayoutIdentityId,layoutRevisionId:layoutRevisionId,teeSelectionId:teeSelectionId,liveRoundPackageId:liveRoundPackageId,expectedInstallRecordGeneration:expectedInstallRecordGeneration)
    }
}

private struct CanonicalRoundStartedEvent {
    let identity: String
    let hash: String
    let bytes: Data

    static func make(request: RoundStartRequest, roundIncarnationId: String, semanticBindingHash: String, installAckId: String, installInstanceId: String, verifiedAt: String) throws -> CanonicalRoundStartedEvent {
        let event = DomainRoundEvent(
            eventId:request.eventId,originDeviceId:request.deviceId,originEpoch:request.originEpoch,clientSequence:request.clientSequence,
            ownerAccountId:request.accountId,subjectPlayerId:request.subjectPlayerId,actorId:request.actorId,roundId:request.roundId,
            streamSubject:.roundIncarnation(roundIncarnationId),roundIntentId:request.roundIntentId,snapshotId:request.snapshotId,
            roundSemanticBindingHash:semanticBindingHash,kind:RoundEventKind(rawValue:"round_started"),entityRef:"round:\(request.roundId)",
            payload:["deviceRoundInstallBinding":.object([
                "deviceId":.string(request.deviceId),"installAckId":.string(installAckId),"installInstanceId":.string(installInstanceId),
                "installManifestId":.string(request.installManifestId),"snapshotId":.string(request.snapshotId),"profileId":.string(request.profileId),
                "courseLayoutIdentityId":.string(request.courseLayoutIdentityId),"layoutRevisionId":.string(request.layoutRevisionId),
                "teeSelectionId":.string(request.teeSelectionId),"liveRoundPackageId":.string(request.liveRoundPackageId),"verifiedAt":.string(verifiedAt),
            ])],causationId:nil,baseEntityRevision:nil,occurredAt:verifiedAt
        )
        let bytes = try CanonicalJSON.encode(event)
        try RoundTransportValidator.validateEvent(event)
        return CanonicalRoundStartedEvent(identity:try event.eventIdentity(),hash:try event.eventHash(),bytes:bytes)
    }
}

actor RoundStartCoordinator {
    private let journal: RoundStartIntentJournal
    private let fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore
    private let staticAuthority: InstalledCourseStaticAuthorityStore
    private let ledger: LocalRoundLedger
    private let transport: RoundStartAuthorityTransport
    private let trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore
    private let fault: RoundStartFault?
    private let newIncarnation: @Sendable () -> String

    init(journal: RoundStartIntentJournal, fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore, staticAuthority: InstalledCourseStaticAuthorityStore, ledger: LocalRoundLedger, transport: RoundStartAuthorityTransport, trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore, fault: RoundStartFault? = nil, newIncarnation: @escaping @Sendable () -> String = { UUID().uuidString.lowercased() }) {
        self.journal=journal; self.fileStore=fileStore; self.staticAuthority=staticAuthority; self.ledger=ledger; self.transport=transport; self.trustedTime=trustedTime; self.fault=fault; self.newIncarnation=newIncarnation
    }

    func start(_ request: RoundStartRequest) async throws -> RoundStartIntentRecord {
        if let existing = try await journal.load(roundIntentId: request.roundIntentId) {
            guard existing.accountId == request.accountId,
                  existing.subjectPlayerId == request.subjectPlayerId,
                  existing.actorId == request.actorId,
                  existing.deviceId == request.deviceId,
                  existing.credentialId == request.credentialId,
                  existing.profileId == request.profileId,
                  existing.roundId == request.roundId,
                  existing.eventId == request.eventId,
                  existing.originEpoch == request.originEpoch,
                  existing.clientSequence == request.clientSequence,
                  existing.snapshotId == request.snapshotId,
                  existing.installManifestId == request.installManifestId,
                  existing.courseLayoutIdentityId == request.courseLayoutIdentityId,
                  existing.layoutRevisionId == request.layoutRevisionId,
                  existing.teeSelectionId == request.teeSelectionId,
                  existing.liveRoundPackageId == request.liveRoundPackageId else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return try await drive(existing)
        }
        let authority = try await staticAuthority.loadVerified(accountId: request.accountId, deviceId: request.deviceId, credentialId:request.credentialId, profileId: request.profileId, snapshotId: request.snapshotId, installManifestId: request.installManifestId)
        let effectiveNow = try await trustedTime.effectiveNow(wallTime: Date(), uptime: ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime, bootSessionId: String(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970 - ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime)))
        let control = try authority.requireStartAllowed(effectiveNow: effectiveNow)
        guard authority.installRecord.courseLayoutIdentityId == request.courseLayoutIdentityId,
              authority.installRecord.layoutRevisionId == request.layoutRevisionId,
              authority.installRecord.teeSelectionId == request.teeSelectionId,
              authority.installRecord.liveRoundPackageIds.contains(request.liveRoundPackageId) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let incarnation = newIncarnation()
        let semantic = JSONValue.object([
            "snapshotId": .string(request.snapshotId),
            "courseLayoutIdentityId": .string(request.courseLayoutIdentityId),
            "layoutRevisionId": .string(request.layoutRevisionId),
            "teeSelectionId": .string(request.teeSelectionId),
            "liveRoundPackageId": .string(request.liveRoundPackageId),
        ])
        let semanticHash = try TypedID.make(domain: "RoundSemanticBinding/v1", value: semantic)
        let startVerifiedAt = TrustedTimeStore.timestamp(effectiveNow)
        let event = try CanonicalRoundStartedEvent.make(request: request, roundIncarnationId: incarnation, semanticBindingHash: semanticHash, installAckId: authority.installAckId, installInstanceId: authority.installInstanceId, verifiedAt: startVerifiedAt)
        let candidate = RoundStartIntentRecord(installDomain: authority.installDomain, accountId: request.accountId, subjectPlayerId:request.subjectPlayerId, actorId:request.actorId, deviceId: request.deviceId, credentialId:request.credentialId, profileId: request.profileId, roundId: request.roundId, roundIntentId: request.roundIntentId, roundIncarnationId: incarnation, eventId:request.eventId, originEpoch:request.originEpoch, clientSequence:request.clientSequence, snapshotId: request.snapshotId, installManifestId: request.installManifestId, installAckId: authority.installAckId, staticAuthorityHash: authority.staticAuthorityHash, courseLayoutIdentityId: request.courseLayoutIdentityId, layoutRevisionId: request.layoutRevisionId, teeSelectionId: request.teeSelectionId, liveRoundPackageId: request.liveRoundPackageId, semanticBindingHash: semanticHash, installInstanceId: authority.installInstanceId, installVerifiedAt: authority.installVerifiedAt, startVerifiedAt: startVerifiedAt, grantGeneration: control.grantGeneration, channelGeneration: control.channelGeneration, safetyGeneration: control.safetyGeneration, purgeGeneration: control.purgeGeneration, trustedTimeGeneration: control.trustedTimeGeneration, trustedTimePayloadId: control.trustedTimePayloadId, effectiveControlHash: control.effectiveControlHash, eventIdentity: event.identity, eventHash: event.hash, canonicalEventBytes: event.bytes, expectedInstallRecordGeneration: request.expectedInstallRecordGeneration, committedInstallRecordGeneration: nil, installAuthority: authority.installAttestation, roundPinAuthority: nil, syncReceipt: nil, state: .prepared)
        let prepared = try await journal.prepare(candidate)
        if fault == .afterPrepared { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        return try await drive(prepared)
    }

    func recover(roundIntentId: String) async throws -> RoundStartIntentRecord {
        guard let record = try await journal.load(roundIntentId: roundIntentId) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return try await drive(record)
    }

    func abortPrepared(roundIntentId: String) async throws { try await journal.removePrepared(roundIntentId: roundIntentId) }

    private func drive(_ input: RoundStartIntentRecord) async throws -> RoundStartIntentRecord {
        var value = input
        if value.state == .prepared {
            let localPin = LocalRoundInstallPin(roundId: value.roundId, roundIntentId: value.roundIntentId, roundIncarnationId: value.roundIncarnationId, installManifestId: value.installManifestId, snapshotId: value.snapshotId, semanticBindingHash: value.semanticBindingHash, eventIdentity: value.eventIdentity, eventHash: value.eventHash, canonicalEventBytesSha256: SHA256.hash(data: value.canonicalEventBytes).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined(), startVerifiedAt: value.startVerifiedAt)
            let committed = try await fileStore.pinForRoundStart(domain: value.installDomain, pin: localPin, expectedGeneration: value.expectedInstallRecordGeneration)
            value.committedInstallRecordGeneration = committed.recordGeneration; value.state = .installPinCommitted
            try await journal.advance(value, expected: .prepared)
            if fault == .afterInstallPinCommit { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        }
        if value.state == .installPinCommitted {
            if !((try? await ledger.containsExact(eventIdentity: value.eventIdentity, eventHash: value.eventHash, canonicalBytes: value.canonicalEventBytes)) ?? false) {
                try await ledger.appendExactRoundStarted(value.canonicalEventBytes, eventIdentity: value.eventIdentity, eventHash: value.eventHash)
            }
            value.state = .roundStartedCommitted; try await journal.advance(value, expected: .installPinCommitted)
            if fault == .afterRoundEventCommit { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        }
        guard value.state == .roundStartedCommitted else { return value }
        do {
            if value.installAuthority == nil {
                let acknowledgement = try await fileStore.installAcknowledgement(domain: value.installDomain, manifestId: value.installManifestId)
                let attestation = try await transport.acknowledgeInstall(acknowledgement)
                guard let currentInstall = try await fileStore.installedRecord(domain:value.installDomain,manifestId:value.installManifestId) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
                guard attestation.installAckId == acknowledgement.installAckId,
                      attestation.accountId == value.accountId,
                      attestation.securityDomainId == currentInstall.authoritySecurityDomainId,
                      attestation.deviceId == value.deviceId,
                      attestation.credentialId == value.credentialId,
                      attestation.profileId == value.profileId,
                      attestation.installManifestId == value.installManifestId,
                      attestation.snapshotId == value.snapshotId,
                      attestation.installInstanceId == value.installInstanceId,
                      attestation.staticAuthorityHash == value.staticAuthorityHash,
                      attestation.installGeneration >= 1,
                      attestation.installGeneration <= 9_007_199_254_740_991,
                      attestation.verifiedAt == value.installVerifiedAt,
                      attestation.commitMarkerHash == acknowledgement.commitMarkerHash,
                      attestation.rangeBitmapHash == acknowledgement.rangeBitmapHash,
                      attestation.state == "verified" else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
                let updated = try await fileStore.recordInstallAuthority(domain: value.installDomain, manifestId: value.installManifestId, expectedGeneration: value.committedInstallRecordGeneration!, attestation: attestation)
                value.committedInstallRecordGeneration = updated.recordGeneration
                value.installAuthority = attestation; try await journal.advance(value, expected: .roundStartedCommitted)
            }
            if value.roundPinAuthority == nil {
                let request = RoundDevicePinRequest(
                    roundId:value.roundId, roundIntentId:value.roundIntentId, roundIncarnationId:value.roundIncarnationId,
                    installAckId:value.installAckId, installInstanceId:value.installInstanceId, installManifestId:value.installManifestId,
                    snapshotId:value.snapshotId, profileId:value.profileId, courseLayoutIdentityId:value.courseLayoutIdentityId,
                    layoutRevisionId:value.layoutRevisionId, teeSelectionId:value.teeSelectionId, liveRoundPackageId:value.liveRoundPackageId,
                    semanticBindingHash:value.semanticBindingHash, staticAuthorityHash:value.staticAuthorityHash, verifiedAt:value.startVerifiedAt,
                    eventIdentity:value.eventIdentity, eventHash:value.eventHash,
                    canonicalEventBytesSha256:SHA256.hash(data:value.canonicalEventBytes).map { String(format:"%02x",$0) }.joined(),
                    grantGeneration:value.grantGeneration, channelGeneration:value.channelGeneration,
                    safetyGeneration:value.safetyGeneration, purgeGeneration:value.purgeGeneration,
                    trustedTimeGeneration:value.trustedTimeGeneration, trustedTimePayloadId:value.trustedTimePayloadId,
                    effectiveControlHash:value.effectiveControlHash
                )
                let pin = try await transport.commitRoundPin(request)
                guard pin.pinId.range(of:#"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"#,options:.regularExpression) != nil,
                      pin.roundId == value.roundId, pin.roundIntentId == value.roundIntentId, pin.roundIncarnationId == value.roundIncarnationId,
                      pin.installAckId == value.installAckId, pin.staticAuthorityHash == value.staticAuthorityHash,
                      pin.generation >= 1, pin.generation <= 9_007_199_254_740_991,
                      pin.controlGeneration == max(request.grantGeneration,request.channelGeneration,request.safetyGeneration,request.purgeGeneration,request.trustedTimeGeneration),
                      pin.effectiveControlHash == value.effectiveControlHash, pin.semanticBindingHash == value.semanticBindingHash,
                      pin.eventIdentity == value.eventIdentity, pin.eventHash == value.eventHash,
                      pin.canonicalEventBytesSha256 == request.canonicalEventBytesSha256,
                      pin.verifiedAt == request.verifiedAt,
                      pin.state == "active" else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
                let updated = try await fileStore.recordRoundPinAuthority(domain:value.installDomain,request:request,expectedGeneration:value.committedInstallRecordGeneration!,attestation:pin)
                value.committedInstallRecordGeneration = updated.recordGeneration
                value.roundPinAuthority = pin; try await journal.advance(value, expected: .roundStartedCommitted)
            }
            let receipt = try await transport.syncRoundStarted(pinId: value.roundPinAuthority!.pinId, canonicalEventBytes: value.canonicalEventBytes)
            guard receipt.eventIdentity == value.eventIdentity,
                  receipt.eventHash == value.eventHash,
                  ["accepted", "duplicate_hash_match"].contains(receipt.status) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
            value.syncReceipt = receipt; value.state = .complete
            try await journal.advance(value, expected: .roundStartedCommitted)
        } catch CourseTransportError.connectivity {
            return value // local round is durable; reconnect recovery ACKs before syncing exact event
        }
        return value
    }
}
```

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/RoundPinReleaseJournal.swift
import Darwin
import Foundation

public enum RoundPinReleaseState: String, Codable, Sendable { case prepared, authorityCommitted, localCommitted }

public struct RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let installDomain: InstallSecurityDomain
    public let installManifestId: String
    public let expectedInstallRecordGeneration: Int
    public let request: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest
    public var attestation: RoundPinReleaseAttestation?
    public var committedInstallRecordGeneration: Int?
    public var state: RoundPinReleaseState
}

public actor RoundPinReleaseJournal {
    private let root: URL
    private let encoder = JSONEncoder()
    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()
    public init(root: URL) { self.root = root }

    private func url(_ releaseIntentId: String) throws -> URL {
        guard releaseIntentId.range(of:#"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$"#,options:.regularExpression) != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return root.appending(path:"\(releaseIntentId).json")
    }

    public func load(releaseIntentId: String) throws -> RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord? {
        let path = try url(releaseIntentId); guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath:path.path) else { return nil }
        return try decoder.decode(RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord.self,from:Data(contentsOf:path))
    }

    public func prepare(_ candidate: RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord) throws -> RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord {
        if let existing = try load(releaseIntentId:candidate.request.releaseIntentId) {
            guard existing.installDomain == candidate.installDomain,
                  existing.installManifestId == candidate.installManifestId,
                  existing.expectedInstallRecordGeneration == candidate.expectedInstallRecordGeneration,
                  existing.request == candidate.request else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return existing
        }
        try persist(candidate); return candidate
    }

    public func advance(_ replacement: RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord, expected: RoundPinReleaseState) throws {
        guard let current = try load(releaseIntentId:replacement.request.releaseIntentId),
              current.state == expected,
              current.installDomain == replacement.installDomain,
              current.installManifestId == replacement.installManifestId,
              current.expectedInstallRecordGeneration == replacement.expectedInstallRecordGeneration,
              current.request == replacement.request,
              (expected == .prepared && replacement.state == .authorityCommitted && replacement.attestation != nil
               || expected == .authorityCommitted && replacement.state == .localCommitted && replacement.attestation == current.attestation)
        else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
        try persist(replacement)
    }

    private func persist(_ value: RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord) throws {
        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at:root,withIntermediateDirectories:true)
        let path = try url(value.request.releaseIntentId); try encoder.encode(value).write(to:path,options:[.atomic,.completeFileProtection])
        let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo:path); try handle.synchronize(); try handle.close()
        let descriptor=open(root.path,O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY); guard descriptor>=0 else { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
        defer{close(descriptor)}; guard fsync(descriptor)==0 else { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }
    }
}
```
