```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddie/Services/RoundPinReleaseCoordinator.swift
import AICaddieDomain
import Foundation

public struct RoundPinReleaseEvidence: Sendable {
    public let terminalEventIdentity: String; public let terminalEventHash: String
    public let originEpoch: String; public let producedThroughClientSequence: Int
    public let consumerEpoch: String; public let vectorGeneration: Int; public let mergeControlGeneration: Int
    public let throughPosition: String; public let ackCheckpointHash: String
    public let pendingEventIdentities: [String]; public let pendingResolutionCommitIds: [String]
}

public protocol RoundPinReleaseEvidenceProvider: Sendable {
    func verifiedReleaseEvidence(roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseEvidence
}

actor RoundPinReleaseCoordinator {
    private let journal: RoundPinReleaseJournal; private let fileStore: CourseInstallFileStore
    private let transport: RoundStartAuthorityTransport; private let evidence: RoundPinReleaseEvidenceProvider; private let trustedTime: TrustedTimeStore
    init(journal:RoundPinReleaseJournal,fileStore:CourseInstallFileStore,transport:RoundStartAuthorityTransport,evidence:RoundPinReleaseEvidenceProvider,trustedTime:TrustedTimeStore){self.journal=journal;self.fileStore=fileStore;self.transport=transport;self.evidence=evidence;self.trustedTime=trustedTime}

    func release(start: RoundStartIntentRecord, releaseIntentId: String) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord {
        guard start.state == .complete, let pin = start.roundPinAuthority, start.syncReceipt != nil,
              let expectedGeneration = start.committedInstallRecordGeneration else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        if let existing = try await journal.load(releaseIntentId:releaseIntentId) { return try await drive(existing) }
        let proof = try await evidence.verifiedReleaseEvidence(roundId:start.roundId,roundIncarnationId:start.roundIncarnationId)
        guard proof.pendingEventIdentities.isEmpty, proof.pendingResolutionCommitIds.isEmpty else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let emptyOutboxHash = try TypedID.make(domain:"LocalRoundOutboxEmpty/v1",value:.object(["roundId":.string(start.roundId),"pendingEventIdentities":.array([]),"pendingResolutionCommitIds":.array([])]))
        let now = try await trustedTime.effectiveNow(wallTime:Date(),uptime:ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime,bootSessionId:String(Int(Date().timeIntervalSince1970-ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime)))
        let request = CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest(schema:"CourseRoundPinRelease/v1",releaseIntentId:releaseIntentId,pinId:pin.pinId,roundId:start.roundId,roundIntentId:start.roundIntentId,roundIncarnationId:start.roundIncarnationId,installAckId:start.installAckId,expectedPinGeneration:pin.generation,terminalEventIdentity:proof.terminalEventIdentity,terminalEventHash:proof.terminalEventHash,originEpoch:proof.originEpoch,producedThroughClientSequence:proof.producedThroughClientSequence,consumerEpoch:proof.consumerEpoch,vectorGeneration:proof.vectorGeneration,mergeControlGeneration:proof.mergeControlGeneration,throughPosition:proof.throughPosition,ackCheckpointHash:proof.ackCheckpointHash,localOutboxStateHash:emptyOutboxHash,verifiedAt:TrustedTimeStore.timestamp(now))
        let candidate = RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord(installDomain:start.installDomain,installManifestId:start.installManifestId,expectedInstallRecordGeneration:expectedGeneration,request:request,attestation:nil,committedInstallRecordGeneration:nil,state:.prepared)
        return try await drive(journal.prepare(candidate))
    }

    func recover(releaseIntentId: String) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord {
        guard let value = try await journal.load(releaseIntentId:releaseIntentId) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return try await drive(value)
    }

    private func drive(_ input: RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseIntentRecord {
        var value=input
        if value.state == .prepared {
            do {
                let attestation = try await transport.releaseRoundPin(value.request)
                let requestJSON = try JSONDecoder().decode(JSONValue.self,from:CanonicalJSON.encode(value.request))
                let expectedReleaseId = try TypedID.make(domain:"CourseRoundPinRelease/v1",value:requestJSON)
                let expectedWatermark = try TypedID.make(domain:"RoundPinRecoveryWatermark/v1",value:.object([
                    "originEpoch":.string(value.request.originEpoch),"producedThroughClientSequence":.integer(value.request.producedThroughClientSequence),
                    "consumerEpoch":.string(value.request.consumerEpoch),"vectorGeneration":.integer(value.request.vectorGeneration),
                    "mergeControlGeneration":.integer(value.request.mergeControlGeneration),"throughPosition":.string(value.request.throughPosition),
                    "ackCheckpointHash":.string(value.request.ackCheckpointHash),
                ]))
                guard attestation.schema == "CourseRoundPinReleaseAttestation/v1", attestation.releaseId == expectedReleaseId,
                      attestation.releaseIntentId == value.request.releaseIntentId,
                      attestation.pinId == value.request.pinId, attestation.roundId == value.request.roundId,
                      attestation.roundIncarnationId == value.request.roundIncarnationId, attestation.installAckId == value.request.installAckId,
                      attestation.previousGeneration == value.request.expectedPinGeneration, attestation.generation == value.request.expectedPinGeneration + 1,
                      attestation.state == "released", attestation.terminalEventIdentity == value.request.terminalEventIdentity,
                      attestation.terminalEventHash == value.request.terminalEventHash,
                      attestation.recoveryWatermarkHash == expectedWatermark,
                      attestation.localOutboxStateHash == value.request.localOutboxStateHash else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
                value.attestation=attestation;value.state = .authorityCommitted;try await journal.advance(value,expected:.prepared)
            } catch CourseTransportError.connectivity { return value }
        }
        if value.state == .authorityCommitted {
            let record = try await fileStore.releaseRoundPinAfterAuthority(domain:value.installDomain,request:value.request,expectedGeneration:value.expectedInstallRecordGeneration,attestation:value.attestation!)
            value.committedInstallRecordGeneration=record.recordGeneration;value.state = .localCommitted;try await journal.advance(value,expected:.authorityCommitted)
        }
        return value
    }
}
```

`CourseInstallFileStore.pinForRoundStart` 必须以 `roundIntentId` 写 durable pin marker 并 CAS `recordGeneration`；exact retry 返回同 marker，不重复增加 pin。`installVerifiedAt` 在安装 commit 前与 deterministic acknowledgement 一起冻结，任何 ACK retry 都从 file store 重建同一 body；`startVerifiedAt` 是开局时的独立 trusted-time/control evidence，并进入 pin 与 `round_started` binding。`CourseInstallTransport.acknowledgeInstalled` 返回完整 `InstallAuthorityAttestation`，禁止 `Void`/Boolean。prepared 阶段可显式 abort；pin 后不得“回滚删除 event”，只能按 journal recovery 前进。普通 update 不能替换 active round binding；pin 只在 lifecycle complete、replication ACK、outbox empty 和 recovery watermark gates 全满足后释放。Active-round map/Guidance 每次恢复都必须走 `CourseInstallFileAuthorityStore.loadVerifiedActiveRound(...)`，不可缓存并直接重用 `LocalRoundInstallPin`/旧 attestation；该入口联合读取最新 runtime mutation projection、要求 `pinCount > 0`、exact durable active row 且无 release mutation，释放后的 stale 值必须 fail closed。

Release 与 uninstall 是唯一允许跨一代自动 rebase 的本地 mutation 对：二者先在同一 frozen `recordGeneration` 上竞争，输家只有在最新 projection 恰好是 `expectedGeneration + 1`、且该代由同 manifest 上另一方的 immutable `RuntimeMutation` 产生并与当前 record 完全相等时，才可把自己的 mutation 写到下一代。任何 repair、supersede、authority、第二个 release/uninstall 或跨 manifest 变化都必须返回 `staleRecordGeneration`。因此 server 已确认的 release 不会因 uninstall 先赢而永久卡住，uninstall 也不会因 release 先赢而丢失；最终稳定态固定为 `pinCount == 0 && intent == .uninstallPending`，随后 `completeUninstall` 可安全删除安装。

`AICaddieApp.swift` 和 start UI 只读取 `VerifiedCourseStaticAuthority` + verified compatible InstallRecord。Course Service 不可达时，本地 pin 与 exact `round_started` 仍可提交；重连必须先完成 install ACK/authority attestation，再同步同一 canonical event bytes。

- [ ] **Step 6: 用完整 durable store、shared installer 和 fixture harness 替换初始 snippets**

```swift
// mobile/ios/AICaddieDomain/CourseInstallFileStore.swift
import CryptoKit
import Foundation

public struct InstallSecurityDomain: Codable, Hashable, Sendable {
    public let id: String
    public let accountId: String
    public let grantId: String
    public let storageKeyDomain: String
    public let rightsPolicyVersion: String
    public let deviceProfile: String

    public static func fromVerifiedGrant(_ grant: SnapshotGrantPayload, deviceProfile: String) throws -> InstallSecurityDomain {
        guard grant.kind == "private", let grantId = grant.grantId, let storage = grant.storageKeyDomain, grant.allowedProfiles.contains(deviceProfile) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let value = JSONValue.object(["accountId": .string(grant.accountId), "grantId": .string(grantId), "storageKeyDomain": .string(storage), "rightsPolicyVersion": .string(grant.rightsPolicyVersion), "deviceProfile": .string(deviceProfile)])
        return InstallSecurityDomain(id: try TypedID.make(domain: "InstallSecurityDomain/v1", value: value), accountId: grant.accountId, grantId: grantId, storageKeyDomain: storage, rightsPolicyVersion: grant.rightsPolicyVersion, deviceProfile: deviceProfile)
    }
}

public struct InstallRecord: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let installSecurityDomainId: String
    public let authoritySecurityDomainId: String
    public let installedManifestId: String
    public let snapshotId: String
    public let profileId: String
    public let courseLayoutIdentityId: String
    public let layoutRevisionId: String
    public let teeSelectionId: String
    public let liveRoundPackageIds: [String]
    public let staticAuthorityHash: String
    public let installInstanceId: String
    public let installAckId: String
    public let commitMarkerHash: String
    public let rangeBitmapHash: String
    public var installAckGeneration: Int?
    public let installVerifiedAt: String
    public var materialization: Materialization
    public var health: InstallHealth
    public var currency: InstallCurrency
    public var intent: InstallIntent
    public var rights: InstallRights
    public var recordGeneration: Int
    public var pinCount: Int
    public var installedAssetRefs: [String]
    public var missingRequiredAssetRefs: [String]
    public var missingOptionalAssetRefs: [String]
}

public struct InstallTransaction: Sendable { public let domain: InstallSecurityDomain; public let manifestId: String; public let stagingURL: URL }
public struct LocalRoundInstallPin: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let roundId: String; public let roundIntentId: String; public let roundIncarnationId: String
    public let installManifestId: String; public let snapshotId: String; public let semanticBindingHash: String
    public let eventIdentity: String; public let eventHash: String; public let canonicalEventBytesSha256: String
    public let startVerifiedAt: String
}
public struct DurableActiveRoundPin: Sendable {
    public let installRecord: InstallRecord
    public let localPin: LocalRoundInstallPin
    public let pinAuthority: RoundPinAuthorityAttestation?
}
private struct CommitMarker: Codable { let protocolName: String; let record: InstallRecord; let staticAuthorityHash: String }
private enum RuntimeMutationKind: String, Codable { case installAuthority, roundPin, roundPinAuthority, roundPinReleased, uninstallRequested }
private struct RuntimeMutation: Codable, Equatable {
    let mutationId: String
    let kind: RuntimeMutationKind
    let expectedGeneration: Int
    let replacement: InstallRecord
    let pin: LocalRoundInstallPin?
    let attestation: InstallAuthorityAttestation?
    let pinAuthority: RoundPinAuthorityAttestation?
    let releaseRequest: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest?
    let releaseAttestation: RoundPinReleaseAttestation?
}

public protocol CourseInstallFileSystem: Sendable {
    func createDirectory(_ url: URL) throws
    func writeAndSync(_ data: Data, to url: URL) throws
    func writeChunkAndSync(_ data: Data, to url: URL, offset: Int) throws
    func atomicReplace(_ source: URL, _ destination: URL) throws
    func read(_ url: URL) throws -> Data
    func list(_ url: URL) throws -> [URL]
    func remove(_ url: URL) throws
    func exists(_ url: URL) -> Bool
    func freeBytes(at url: URL) throws -> Int
}

public enum CourseInstallError: Error, Equatable { case assetIntegrity, requiredAssetsMissing, chunkIdentity, staleRecordGeneration, startBlocked, roundIntentConflict, incompatibleClient, insufficientSpace, dependencyMissing }

public struct POSIXCourseInstallFileSystem: CourseInstallFileSystem {
    public init() {}
    public func createDirectory(_ url: URL) throws { try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: url, withIntermediateDirectories: true) }
    public func writeAndSync(_ data: Data, to url: URL) throws { try createDirectory(url.deletingLastPathComponent()); try data.write(to: url, options: .atomic); let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: url); try handle.synchronize(); try handle.close(); try syncDirectory(url.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    public func writeChunkAndSync(_ data: Data, to url: URL, offset: Int) throws { try createDirectory(url.deletingLastPathComponent()); if !exists(url) { FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: url.path, contents: nil) }; let handle = try FileHandle(forWritingTo: url); try handle.seek(toOffset: UInt64(offset)); try handle.write(contentsOf: data); try handle.synchronize(); try handle.close() }
    public func atomicReplace(_ source: URL, _ destination: URL) throws { try createDirectory(destination.deletingLastPathComponent()); if exists(destination) { _ = try FileManager.default.replaceItemAt(destination, withItemAt: source) } else { try FileManager.default.moveItem(at: source, to: destination) }; try syncDirectory(destination.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
    public func read(_ url: URL) throws -> Data { try Data(contentsOf: url) }
    public func list(_ url: URL) throws -> [URL] { exists(url) ? try FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(at: url, includingPropertiesForKeys: nil) : [] }
    public func remove(_ url: URL) throws { if exists(url) { try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url); try syncDirectory(url.deletingLastPathComponent()) } }
    public func exists(_ url: URL) -> Bool { FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) }
    public func freeBytes(at url: URL) throws -> Int { let values = try url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsageKey]); return Int(values.volumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsage ?? 0) }
    private func syncDirectory(_ url: URL) throws { let descriptor = open(url.path, O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY); guard descriptor >= 0 else { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) }; defer { close(descriptor) }; guard fsync(descriptor) == 0 else { throw CocoaError(.fileWriteUnknown) } }
}

public actor CourseInstallFileStore {
    private let root: URL
    private let fileSystem: CourseInstallFileSystem
    private let encoder = JSONEncoder()
    private let decoder = JSONDecoder()

    public init(root: URL, fileSystem: CourseInstallFileSystem = POSIXCourseInstallFileSystem()) { self.root = root; self.fileSystem = fileSystem }
    private func safe(_ value: String) throws -> String { guard value.range(of: #"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$"#, options: .regularExpression) != nil, value != ".", value != ".." else { throw CourseInstallError.chunkIdentity }; return value }
    private func domainRoot(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain) throws -> URL { root.appending(path: try safe(domain.id), directoryHint: .isDirectory) }
    private func staging(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try domainRoot(domain).appending(path: "staging/\(safe(manifest)).partial", directoryHint: .isDirectory) }
    private func installed(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try domainRoot(domain).appending(path: "installed/\(safe(manifest))", directoryHint: .isDirectory) }
    private func index(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try domainRoot(domain).appending(path: "installed-index/\(safe(manifest)).json") }
    private func bitmapURL(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, _ hash: String) throws -> URL { transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "ranges/\(safe(hash)).bitmap") }
    private func assetURL(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, _ hash: String) throws -> URL { transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "assets/\(safe(hash))") }
    private func authorityURL(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try installed(domain, manifest).appending(path: "static-authority.json") }
    private func controlsURL(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try installed(domain, manifest).appending(path: "verified-controls.json") }
    private func runtimeRecordURL(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try installed(domain, manifest).appending(path: "runtime-record.json") }
    private func mutationsURL(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String) throws -> URL { try installed(domain, manifest).appending(path: "runtime-mutations", directoryHint: .isDirectory) }
    private func mutationURL(_ domain: InstallSecurityDomain, _ manifest: String, _ mutationId: String) throws -> URL { try mutationsURL(domain, manifest).appending(path: "\(safe(mutationId)).json") }

    public func begin(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> InstallTransaction { let url = try staging(domain, manifestId); try fileSystem.createDirectory(url); return InstallTransaction(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId, stagingURL: url) }
    public func availableBytes(domain: InstallSecurityDomain) throws -> Int { let url = try domainRoot(domain); try fileSystem.createDirectory(url); return try fileSystem.freeBytes(at: url) }
    public func hasStaging(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> Bool { try fileSystem.exists(staging(domain, manifestId)) || (fileSystem.exists(try installed(domain, manifestId)) && !fileSystem.exists(try index(domain, manifestId))) }
    public func installedRecord(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> InstallRecord? { try recover(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId) }

    public func bitmap(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, asset: ManifestAsset) throws -> VerifiedRangeBitmap { let url = try bitmapURL(transaction, asset.hash); return fileSystem.exists(url) ? try VerifiedRangeBitmap(canonicalBytes: fileSystem.read(url)) : try VerifiedRangeBitmap(totalLength: asset.size) }
    public func writeChunk(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, asset: ManifestAsset, offset: Int, bytes: Data) throws {
        var ranges = try bitmap(transaction, asset: asset); guard offset >= 0, offset + bytes.count <= asset.size else { throw CourseInstallError.chunkIdentity }
        let url = try assetURL(transaction, asset.hash)
        if fileSystem.exists(url) {
            let current = try fileSystem.read(url)
            for range in ranges.ranges where max(range.start, offset) < min(range.endExclusive, offset + bytes.count) {
                let overlapStart = max(range.start, offset); let overlapEnd = min(range.endExclusive, offset + bytes.count)
                guard current[overlapStart..<overlapEnd] == bytes[(overlapStart - offset)..<(overlapEnd - offset)] else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
            }
        }
        try fileSystem.writeChunkAndSync(bytes, to: url, offset: offset); try ranges.mark(offset: offset, length: bytes.count); try fileSystem.writeAndSync(ranges.canonicalBytes(), to: bitmapURL(transaction, asset.hash))
    }
    public func finalizeAsset(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, asset: ManifestAsset) throws { let ranges = try bitmap(transaction, asset: asset); guard ranges.isComplete else { throw CourseInstallError.requiredAssetsMissing }; let body = try fileSystem.read(assetURL(transaction, asset.hash)); let digest = SHA256.hash(data: body).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined(); guard body.count == asset.size, digest == asset.hash else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity } }

    public func commit(_ transaction: InstallTransaction, record: InstallRecord, staticAuthority: VerifiedCourseStaticAuthority, controls: PersistedCourseControlBundle) throws {
        guard record.missingRequiredAssetRefs.isEmpty,
              record.installSecurityDomainId == transaction.domain.id,
              record.authoritySecurityDomainId == staticAuthority.payload.securityDomainId,
              record.installedManifestId == transaction.manifestId,
              record.installedManifestId == staticAuthority.payload.installManifestId,
              record.snapshotId == staticAuthority.payload.snapshotId,
              record.profileId == staticAuthority.payload.profileId,
              record.courseLayoutIdentityId == staticAuthority.payload.courseLayoutIdentityId,
              record.layoutRevisionId == staticAuthority.payload.layoutRevisionId,
              record.teeSelectionId == staticAuthority.payload.teeSelectionId,
              record.liveRoundPackageIds == staticAuthority.payload.liveRoundPackageIds,
              record.staticAuthorityHash == staticAuthority.staticAuthorityHash else { throw CourseInstallError.requiredAssetsMissing }
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(staticAuthority), to: transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "static-authority.json"))
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(controls), to: transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "verified-controls.json"))
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(record), to: transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "runtime-record.json"))
        try fileSystem.createDirectory(transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "runtime-mutations", directoryHint: .isDirectory))
        let marker = CommitMarker(protocolName: "course-install-commit/v1", record: record, staticAuthorityHash: staticAuthority.staticAuthorityHash)
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(marker), to: transaction.stagingURL.appending(path: "commit.json"))
        let destination = try installed(transaction.domain, transaction.manifestId); try fileSystem.atomicReplace(transaction.stagingURL, destination)
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(record), to: index(transaction.domain, transaction.manifestId))
    }

    public func recover(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> InstallRecord? {
        let markerURL = try installed(domain, manifestId).appending(path: "commit.json")
        guard fileSystem.exists(markerURL) else { return nil }
        let marker = try decoder.decode(CommitMarker.self, from: fileSystem.read(markerURL))
        guard marker.protocolName == "course-install-commit/v1", marker.record.installSecurityDomainId == domain.id,
              marker.record.installedManifestId == manifestId, fileSystem.exists(try authorityURL(domain, manifestId)),
              fileSystem.exists(try controlsURL(domain, manifestId)) else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
        var record = marker.record
        let mutations = try fileSystem.list(mutationsURL(domain, manifestId))
            .filter { $0.pathExtension == "json" }
            .map { try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read($0)) }
            .sorted { $0.replacement.recordGeneration < $1.replacement.recordGeneration }
        var seen = Set<String>()
        for mutation in mutations {
            guard seen.insert(mutation.mutationId).inserted,
                  mutation.expectedGeneration == record.recordGeneration,
                  mutation.replacement.recordGeneration == mutation.expectedGeneration + 1,
                  mutation.replacement.installSecurityDomainId == domain.id,
                  mutation.replacement.installedManifestId == manifestId else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
            record = mutation.replacement
        }
        try persistRuntime(record, domain: domain)
        return record
    }

    public func installedAuthority(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> VerifiedCourseStaticAuthority { try decoder.decode(VerifiedCourseStaticAuthority.self, from: fileSystem.read(authorityURL(domain, manifestId))) }
    public func installedControls(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> PersistedCourseControlBundle { try decoder.decode(PersistedCourseControlBundle.self, from: fileSystem.read(controlsURL(domain, manifestId))) }
    public func installedAttestation(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation? {
        try fileSystem.list(mutationsURL(domain, manifestId)).compactMap { url -> (Int, InstallAuthorityAttestation)? in
            let mutation = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(url))
            guard mutation.kind == .installAuthority, let attestation = mutation.attestation else { return nil }
            return (mutation.replacement.recordGeneration, attestation)
        }.max(by: { $0.0 < $1.0 })?.1
    }

    public func installAcknowledgement(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> InstallAcknowledgement {
        guard let record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return InstallAcknowledgement(installAckId: record.installAckId, installManifestId: record.installedManifestId, snapshotId: record.snapshotId, profileId: record.profileId, installInstanceId: record.installInstanceId, staticAuthorityHash: record.staticAuthorityHash, verifiedAt: record.installVerifiedAt, commitMarkerHash: record.commitMarkerHash, rangeBitmapHash: record.rangeBitmapHash)
    }

    public func recordInstallAuthority(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, expectedGeneration: Int, attestation: InstallAuthorityAttestation) throws -> InstallRecord {
        let mutationId = "ack-\(attestation.installAckId)"
        let url = try mutationURL(domain, manifestId, mutationId)
        if fileSystem.exists(url) {
            let existing = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(url))
            guard existing.kind == .installAuthority, existing.attestation == attestation else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return existing.replacement
        }
        guard var record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId),
              attestation.accountId == domain.accountId, attestation.securityDomainId == record.authoritySecurityDomainId,
              attestation.installAckId == record.installAckId, attestation.installManifestId == record.installedManifestId,
              attestation.snapshotId == record.snapshotId, attestation.profileId == record.profileId,
              attestation.installInstanceId == record.installInstanceId, attestation.staticAuthorityHash == record.staticAuthorityHash,
              attestation.verifiedAt == record.installVerifiedAt, attestation.commitMarkerHash == record.commitMarkerHash,
              attestation.rangeBitmapHash == record.rangeBitmapHash, attestation.installGeneration >= 1,
              attestation.state == "verified" else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        if let generation = record.installAckGeneration { guard generation == attestation.installGeneration else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }; return record }
        guard record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
        record.installAckGeneration = attestation.installGeneration; record.recordGeneration += 1
        let mutation = RuntimeMutation(mutationId: mutationId, kind: .installAuthority, expectedGeneration: expectedGeneration, replacement: record, pin: nil, attestation: attestation, pinAuthority: nil, releaseRequest: nil, releaseAttestation: nil)
        try commitMutation(mutation, domain: domain); return record
    }

    public func pinForRoundStart(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, pin: LocalRoundInstallPin, expectedGeneration: Int) throws -> InstallRecord {
        guard pin.installManifestId.range(of: #"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$"#, options: .regularExpression) != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.chunkIdentity }
        let digest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(pin.roundIntentId.utf8)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        let mutationId = "pin-\(digest)"; let url = try mutationURL(domain, pin.installManifestId, mutationId)
        if fileSystem.exists(url) {
            let existing = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(url))
            guard existing.kind == .roundPin, existing.pin == pin else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return existing.replacement
        }
        guard var record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: pin.installManifestId),
              record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration, record.snapshotId == pin.snapshotId,
              record.materialization == .installed, record.health == .verified, record.currency == .current,
              record.intent == .none, record.rights == .allowed else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        record.pinCount += 1; record.recordGeneration += 1
        let mutation = RuntimeMutation(mutationId: mutationId, kind: .roundPin, expectedGeneration: expectedGeneration, replacement: record, pin: pin, attestation: nil, pinAuthority: nil, releaseRequest: nil, releaseAttestation: nil)
        try commitMutation(mutation, domain: domain); return record
    }

    public func recordRoundPinAuthority(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, request: RoundDevicePinRequest, expectedGeneration: Int, attestation: RoundPinAuthorityAttestation) throws -> InstallRecord {
        let mutationId = "pin-authority-\(try safe(attestation.pinId))"
        let url = try mutationURL(domain, request.installManifestId, mutationId)
        if fileSystem.exists(url) {
            let existing = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(url))
            guard existing.kind == .roundPinAuthority, existing.pinAuthority == attestation else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            return existing.replacement
        }
        guard attestation.pinId.range(of:#"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"#,options:.regularExpression) != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let intentDigest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(request.roundIntentId.utf8)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        let localMutation = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(mutationURL(domain, request.installManifestId, "pin-\(intentDigest)")))
        guard let local = localMutation.pin,
              localMutation.kind == .roundPin,
              local.roundId == request.roundId,
              local.roundIntentId == request.roundIntentId,
              local.roundIncarnationId == request.roundIncarnationId,
              local.installManifestId == request.installManifestId,
              local.snapshotId == request.snapshotId,
              local.semanticBindingHash == request.semanticBindingHash,
              local.eventIdentity == request.eventIdentity,
              local.eventHash == request.eventHash,
              local.canonicalEventBytesSha256 == request.canonicalEventBytesSha256,
              local.startVerifiedAt == request.verifiedAt,
              attestation.roundId == request.roundId,
              attestation.roundIntentId == request.roundIntentId,
              attestation.roundIncarnationId == request.roundIncarnationId,
              attestation.installAckId == request.installAckId,
              attestation.controlGeneration == max(request.grantGeneration,request.channelGeneration,request.safetyGeneration,request.purgeGeneration,request.trustedTimeGeneration),
              attestation.staticAuthorityHash == request.staticAuthorityHash,
              attestation.effectiveControlHash == request.effectiveControlHash,
              attestation.semanticBindingHash == request.semanticBindingHash,
              attestation.eventIdentity == request.eventIdentity,
              attestation.eventHash == request.eventHash,
              attestation.canonicalEventBytesSha256 == request.canonicalEventBytesSha256,
              attestation.verifiedAt == request.verifiedAt,
              attestation.generation >= 1,
              attestation.state == "active",
              var record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: request.installManifestId),
              record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration,
              record.pinCount > 0 else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        record.recordGeneration += 1
        let mutation = RuntimeMutation(mutationId: mutationId, kind: .roundPinAuthority, expectedGeneration: expectedGeneration, replacement: record, pin: nil, attestation: nil, pinAuthority: attestation, releaseRequest: nil, releaseAttestation: nil)
        try commitMutation(mutation, domain: domain); return record
    }

    public func releaseRoundPinAfterAuthority(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, request: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest, expectedGeneration: Int, attestation: RoundPinReleaseAttestation) throws -> InstallRecord {
        let releaseDigest = SHA256.hash(data: Data(request.releaseIntentId.utf8)).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
        let mutationId = "pin-release-\(releaseDigest)"
        guard let current = try allMutations(domain: domain).first(where: { $0.kind == .roundPinAuthority && $0.pinAuthority?.pinId == request.pinId }),
              let active = current.pinAuthority else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let manifestId = current.replacement.installedManifestId
        let exactURL = try mutationURL(domain, manifestId, mutationId)
        if fileSystem.exists(exactURL) {
            let existing = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(exactURL))
            guard existing.kind == .roundPinReleased, existing.releaseRequest == request, existing.releaseAttestation == attestation else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            guard let latest = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId) else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
            return latest
        }
        let requestValue = try decoder.decode(JSONValue.self, from: encoder.encode(request))
        let expectedReleaseId = try TypedID.make(domain: "CourseRoundPinRelease/v1", value: requestValue)
        let expectedWatermark = try TypedID.make(domain: "RoundPinRecoveryWatermark/v1", value: .object([
            "originEpoch":.string(request.originEpoch),
            "producedThroughClientSequence":.integer(request.producedThroughClientSequence),
            "consumerEpoch":.string(request.consumerEpoch),
            "vectorGeneration":.integer(request.vectorGeneration),
            "mergeControlGeneration":.integer(request.mergeControlGeneration),
            "throughPosition":.string(request.throughPosition),
            "ackCheckpointHash":.string(request.ackCheckpointHash),
        ]))
        guard var record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId) else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let commitGeneration: Int
        if record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration {
            commitGeneration = expectedGeneration
        } else {
            let predecessor = try allMutations(domain: domain).first {
                $0.kind == .uninstallRequested
                    && $0.expectedGeneration == expectedGeneration
                    && $0.replacement == record
                    && $0.replacement.installedManifestId == manifestId
            }
            guard record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration + 1,
                  record.intent == .uninstallPending,
                  predecessor != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
            commitGeneration = record.recordGeneration
        }
        guard request.schema == "CourseRoundPinRelease/v1",
              request.pinId == active.pinId,
              request.roundId == active.roundId,
              request.roundIntentId == active.roundIntentId,
              request.roundIncarnationId == active.roundIncarnationId,
              request.installAckId == active.installAckId,
              request.expectedPinGeneration == active.generation,
              attestation.schema == "CourseRoundPinReleaseAttestation/v1",
              attestation.releaseId == expectedReleaseId,
              attestation.releaseIntentId == request.releaseIntentId,
              attestation.pinId == request.pinId,
              attestation.roundId == request.roundId,
              attestation.roundIncarnationId == request.roundIncarnationId,
              attestation.installAckId == request.installAckId,
              attestation.previousGeneration == request.expectedPinGeneration,
              attestation.generation == request.expectedPinGeneration + 1,
              attestation.state == "released",
              attestation.terminalEventIdentity == request.terminalEventIdentity,
              attestation.terminalEventHash == request.terminalEventHash,
              attestation.recoveryWatermarkHash == expectedWatermark,
              attestation.localOutboxStateHash == request.localOutboxStateHash,
              record.pinCount > 0 else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        record.pinCount -= 1; record.recordGeneration += 1
        let mutation = RuntimeMutation(mutationId: mutationId, kind: .roundPinReleased, expectedGeneration: commitGeneration, replacement: record, pin: nil, attestation: nil, pinAuthority: nil, releaseRequest: request, releaseAttestation: attestation)
        try commitMutation(mutation, domain: domain); return record
    }

    public func pinCount(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String) throws -> Int { try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId)?.pinCount ?? 0 }
    public func activeRoundPin(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, roundId: String, roundIncarnationId: String) throws -> DurableActiveRoundPin {
        guard let record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId),
              record.pinCount > 0 else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let mutations = try allMutations(domain: domain).filter { $0.replacement.installedManifestId == manifestId }
        let locals = mutations.compactMap { $0.kind == .roundPin ? $0.pin : nil }.filter { $0.roundId == roundId && $0.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId }
        guard locals.count == 1 else { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        let local = locals[0]
        let authorities = mutations.compactMap { $0.kind == .roundPinAuthority ? $0.pinAuthority : nil }.filter { $0.roundId == roundId && $0.roundIncarnationId == roundIncarnationId }
        guard authorities.count <= 1 else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
        if let authority = authorities.first, mutations.contains(where: { $0.kind == .roundPinReleased && $0.releaseRequest?.pinId == authority.pinId }) { throw CourseInstallError.startBlocked }
        return DurableActiveRoundPin(installRecord: record, localPin: local, pinAuthority: authorities.first)
    }
    public func requestUninstall(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, expectedGeneration: Int) throws -> InstallRecord {
        let mutationId = "uninstall-\(try safe(manifestId))"; let url = try mutationURL(domain, manifestId, mutationId)
        if fileSystem.exists(url) {
            let existing = try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(url))
            guard existing.kind == .uninstallRequested else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
            guard let latest = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId) else { throw CourseInstallError.assetIntegrity }
            return latest
        }
        guard var record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId) else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
        let commitGeneration: Int
        if record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration {
            commitGeneration = expectedGeneration
        } else {
            let predecessor = try allMutations(domain: domain).first {
                $0.kind == .roundPinReleased
                    && $0.expectedGeneration == expectedGeneration
                    && $0.replacement == record
                    && $0.replacement.installedManifestId == manifestId
            }
            guard record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration + 1,
                  predecessor != nil else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }
            commitGeneration = record.recordGeneration
        }
        record.intent = .uninstallPending; record.recordGeneration += 1
        try commitMutation(RuntimeMutation(mutationId: mutationId, kind: .uninstallRequested, expectedGeneration: commitGeneration, replacement: record, pin: nil, attestation: nil, pinAuthority: nil, releaseRequest: nil, releaseAttestation: nil), domain: domain)
        return record
    }
    public func completeUninstall(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, expectedGeneration: Int) throws { guard let record = try installedRecord(domain: domain, manifestId: manifestId), record.recordGeneration == expectedGeneration, record.intent == .uninstallPending, record.pinCount == 0 else { throw CourseInstallError.staleRecordGeneration }; try fileSystem.remove(installed(domain, manifestId)); try fileSystem.remove(index(domain, manifestId)) }
    public func assetData(domain: InstallSecurityDomain, manifestId: String, hash: String) throws -> Data { try fileSystem.read(installed(domain, manifestId).appending(path: "assets/\(safe(hash))")) }

    private func persistRuntime(_ record: InstallRecord, domain: InstallSecurityDomain) throws {
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(record), to: runtimeRecordURL(domain, record.installedManifestId))
        try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(record), to: index(domain, record.installedManifestId))
    }

    private func commitMutation(_ mutation: RuntimeMutation, domain: InstallSecurityDomain) throws {
        let url = try mutationURL(domain, mutation.replacement.installedManifestId, mutation.mutationId)
        if fileSystem.exists(url) {
            guard try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read(url)) == mutation else { throw CourseInstallError.roundIntentConflict }
        } else {
            try fileSystem.writeAndSync(try encoder.encode(mutation), to: url)
        }
        try persistRuntime(mutation.replacement, domain: domain)
    }

    private func allMutations(domain: InstallSecurityDomain) throws -> [RuntimeMutation] {
        let installedRoot = try domainRoot(domain).appending(path: "installed", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
        return try fileSystem.list(installedRoot).flatMap { manifestURL in
            let mutationRoot = manifestURL.appending(path: "runtime-mutations", directoryHint: .isDirectory)
            return try fileSystem.list(mutationRoot).filter { $0.pathExtension == "json" }.map { try decoder.decode(RuntimeMutation.self, from: fileSystem.read($0)) }
        }
    }
}
```

## Task 15: B15 — 用 Watch-native device credential 统一 direct HTTPS 与 exact phone relay

**Depends on:** B12a SQL credential/enrollment/nonce/static authority/pin composition；Plan 1 `DeviceRequestSigner`、exact HTTP Watch relay、fixed `course-service-v1` audience、`WatchDeviceCredentialStore`、server-signed `PairedDeviceCredentialManifest`、iPhone `PairedWatchCredentialStore` and async `PairedDeviceCredentialVerifier`；B13 shared raw-byte verifier/installer。

**Product law:** Watch 拥有自己的 Ed25519 credential。direct 与 phone relay 发送同一份由 Watch 签名的 method/target/body/proof headers；iPhone 只是 allow-list transport，不能 decode/re-encode、使用 phone credential、刷新 bearer token或接触 Watch private key。Plan 1 owns key storage and paired-manifest trust；B15 only extends its real APIs for Course enrollment/request signing and must not redeclare、overwrite or weaken them。B15 不再创建第二套 access/refresh token schema，也不新增 migration。

- [ ] **Step 2: 实现 owner-approved public-key enrollment而不是 bearer token**

The Watch first generates a CryptoKit Ed25519 key in its protected credential store, then starts enrollment with install UUID, platform, public-key DER/hash and attestation evidence hash. Server returns `deviceCode/userCode/challengeId/challengeB64u/expiresAt`; the owner approval endpoint is authenticated by the normal account session and binds the exact pending tuple. Credential issue requires the Watch to sign:

```json
{
  "schema": "DeviceEnrollmentProof/v1",
  "challengeId": "challenge-id",
  "accountId": "account-id",
  "playerId": "player-id",
  "deviceId": "watch-device-id",
  "installUuid": "watch-install-uuid",
  "platform": "watchos",
  "publicKeySha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "challengeB64u": "base64url"
}
```

On success B12a inserts one `DeviceCredentialRow` and returns exact public metadata:

```json
{
  "schema": "DeviceCredentialEnrollment/v1",
  "credentialId": "credential-id",
  "accountId": "account-id",
  "playerId": "player-id",
  "securityDomainId": "security-domain-id",
  "deviceId": "watch-device-id",
  "platform": "watchos",
  "algorithm": "Ed25519",
  "publicKeySha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "generation": 1,
  "notBefore": "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
  "expiresAt": "2027-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
  "status": "active",
  "pairedCredentialManifest": {
    "schema": "PairedDeviceCredentialManifest/v1",
    "manifestId": "64-lowercase-hex",
    "ownerAccountId": "account-id",
    "deviceId": "watch-device-id",
    "credentialId": "credential-id",
    "credentialGeneration": 1,
    "deviceClass": "watch",
    "state": "active",
    "algorithm": "Ed25519",
    "signingPublicKeyRawB64u": "base64url-32-byte-key",
    "issuedAt": "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
    "notBefore": "2026-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
    "expiresAt": "2027-07-18T00:00:00.000Z",
    "refreshAfter": "2026-07-25T00:00:00.000Z",
    "manifestSequence": 1,
    "previousManifestHash": null,
    "signerKeyId": "paired-credential-signing-2026",
    "signatureB64u": "base64url-ed25519-signature"
  }
}
```

The nested manifest is constructed and signed by Plan 1 `PairedDeviceCredentialManifestBuilder` in the same SQL transaction that activates the credential; all public-key、generation、state、sequence and previous-hash fields are loaded from server authority, never copied back from the Watch request. The response manifest is byte-identical to an immediate owner-bound refresh. There is no `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, bearer scope or token refresh endpoint. Re-enrollment creates a higher credential generation and emits an `active` higher-sequence manifest while the prior generation becomes `retiring/superseded`; explicit revoke emits a higher-sequence `revoked` manifest. Public failures stay the Plan 1 indistinguishable `invalid_device_proof`.

- [ ] **Step 3: 扩展而不重声明 Plan 1 Watch credential authority，并接通 iPhone paired-manifest refresh**

Do not create another `actor WatchDeviceCredentialStore`, key tag, metadata file, credential record or signer. Modify the Plan 1-owned actor only by adding these Course enrollment operations to its existing generation/rotation state machine:

```swift
extension WatchDeviceCredentialStore {
    public func beginCourseEnrollment(
        ownerAccountId: String,
        playerId: String,
        installUUID: String
    ) async throws -> WatchDeviceEnrollmentMaterial

    public func activateCourseEnrollment(
        _ response: DeviceCredentialEnrollment
    ) async throws -> WatchDeviceCredentialSnapshot

    public func courseRequestSigner() async throws -> any DeviceRequestSigner
}
```

`beginCourseEnrollment` returns only the existing store's pending public-key DER/hash and attestation hash. It reuses the current active key for first enrollment and Plan 1's prepared-generation key for rotation; it never exports private bytes. `activateCourseEnrollment` strict-decodes the shared generated response, verifies owner/player/device/install UUID/public-key hash, requires `generation == current+1` for rotation (or `1` for first enrollment), verifies the nested signed paired manifest's credential/generation/public key, then atomically activates the same Plan 1 snapshot. A response mismatch leaves both active and prepared generations unchanged. `courseRequestSigner()` returns Plan 1's existing `Ed25519DeviceRequestSigner` over the active snapshot; retry creates a fresh nonce/signature while retaining the idempotency key and exact body.

The iPhone does not trust credential metadata received over WCSession. `WatchEventBridge` forwards the raw first manifest only as a refresh hint; `PairedWatchCredentialStore.install(rawManifest:trustedServerKeys:now:)` performs Plan 1 verification before activation. On pairing、app foreground、manifest `refreshAfter`, or `PairedDeviceCredentialVerifier.loadVerified(..., at:)` reporting unknown/stale/revoked trust, `paired_device_credentials_api.py` returns the owner-bound latest raw manifest, `PairedWatchCredentialStore` installs it, and verification retries exactly once. A lower sequence、same-sequence/different bytes、broken previous hash、cross-account/device、expired signer or revoked latest generation fails closed and retains the peer/course payload for later authorized refresh.

Tests compile the B15 extension against the Plan 1 actor and assert there is exactly one `WatchDeviceCredentialStore` declaration in the project. They cover first manifest install, restart, prepared rotation with an older signed payload, higher-generation takeover, explicit revocation, refresh failure and one-retry success; no permissive verifier or metadata-only fallback is constructible.

- [ ] **Step 4: 将 Watch Course client 改成 exact signed HTTP**

```swift
actor WatchCourseServiceClient: CourseInstallTransport {
    private let baseURL: URL
    private let session: URLSession
    private let signer: any DeviceRequestSigner

    init(baseURL: URL, session: URLSession = .shared, signer: any DeviceRequestSigner) {
        self.baseURL = baseURL
        self.session = session
        self.signer = signer
    }

    private func signed(
        method: String,
        target: String,
        body: Data = Data(),
        extraHeaders: [String: String] = [:]
    ) async throws -> URLRequest {
        let proof = try signer.sign(
            method: method,
            target: target,
            body: body,
            audience: .courseService
        )
        var request = URLRequest(url: try CanonicalRequestTarget.url(baseURL: baseURL, target: target))
        request.httpMethod = method
        request.httpBody = body.isEmpty ? nil : body
        for (name, value) in proof.values.merging(extraHeaders, uniquingKeysWith: { _, rhs in rhs }) {
            request.setValue(value, forHTTPHeaderField: name)
        }
        return request
    }

    private func checked(_ request: URLRequest, expected: Set<Int>) async throws -> (Data, HTTPURLResponse) {
        let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
        guard let http = response as? HTTPURLResponse, expected.contains(http.statusCode) else { throw URLError(.badServerResponse) }
        return (data, http)
    }

    func manifest(layoutId: String, profileId: String, installInstanceId: String) async throws -> CourseInstallBundle {
        let target = try CanonicalRequestTarget.pathAndSortedQuery(
            path: "/api/v2/course-service/channels/\(layoutId)/manifest",
            query: [("installInstanceId", installInstanceId), ("profileId", profileId)]
        )
        let request = try await signed(method: "GET", target: target)
        return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            CourseInstallBundle.self,
            from: try await checked(request, expected: [200]).0
        )
    }

    func asset(_ asset: ManifestAsset, opaqueAssetId: String, groupId: String, installManifestId: String, snapshotId: String, missingRanges: [VerifiedByteRange]) async throws -> AsyncThrowingStream<InstallChunk, Error> {
        AsyncThrowingStream { continuation in
            Task {
                do {
                    for range in missingRanges {
                        let target = "/api/v2/course-service/assets/private/\(opaqueAssetId)"
                        let request = try await signed(method:"GET",target:target,extraHeaders:["Range":"bytes=\(range.start)-\(range.endExclusive-1)"])
                        let (data,response) = try await checked(request,expected:[206])
                        guard response.value(forHTTPHeaderField:"Content-Range") == "bytes \(range.start)-\(range.endExclusive-1)/\(asset.size)",
                              data.count == range.endExclusive-range.start else { throw CourseInstallError.chunkIdentity }
                        continuation.yield(InstallChunk(snapshotId:snapshotId,installManifestId:installManifestId,assetHash:asset.hash,assetGroup:groupId,ordinal:asset.ordinal,offset:range.start,totalLength:asset.size,bytes:data))
                    }
                    continuation.finish()
                } catch { continuation.finish(throwing:error) }
            }
        }
    }

    func acknowledgeInstalled(_ acknowledgement: InstallAcknowledgement) async throws -> InstallAuthorityAttestation {
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.encode(acknowledgement)
        let request = try await signed(
            method: "POST",
            target: "/api/v2/course-service/installs/ack",
            body: body,
            extraHeaders: ["Content-Type": "application/json"]
        )
        return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(
            InstallAuthorityAttestation.self,
            from: try await checked(request, expected: [201]).0
        )
    }

    func commitRoundPin(_ pin: RoundDevicePinRequest) async throws -> RoundPinAuthorityAttestation {
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.encode(pin)
        let request = try await signed(method:"POST",target:"/api/v2/course-service/round-pins",body:body,extraHeaders:["Content-Type":"application/json"])
        return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(RoundPinAuthorityAttestation.self,from:try await checked(request,expected:[201]).0)
    }

    func releaseRoundPin(_ release: CourseRoundPinReleaseRequest) async throws -> RoundPinReleaseAttestation {
        let body = try CanonicalJSON.encode(release)
        let request = try await signed(method:"POST",target:"/api/v2/course-service/round-pins/\(release.pinId)/release",body:body,extraHeaders:["Content-Type":"application/json"])
        return try StrictJSONDecoder.decode(RoundPinReleaseAttestation.self,from:try await checked(request,expected:[200]).0)
    }
}
```

Asset Range requests use the same signer/target and preserve the exact `Range` header; response `Content-Range`, length and final asset hash remain mandatory. The client decodes/verifies `CourseStaticAuthorityBundle/v1` before any install becomes current.

- [ ] **Step 5: direct-first fallback 必须转发原始 Watch request**

Use one shared relay envelope for course and round traffic:

```swift
public struct WatchRelayHTTPRequest: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let method: String
    public let target: String
    public let body: Data
    public let headers: [String: String]
}
```

Watch first attempts the signed request directly. A timeout、connection reset、DNS/TLS failure or lost response is transport uncertainty: it preserves the exact method/target/body/Range/Idempotency-Key, but the Watch creates a fresh `nonce/issuedAt/signature` before direct retry or WCSession relay. The first request may already have reached the server and consumed its nonce, so a relay must never reuse that proof even while its TTL remains valid. HTTP 429/503 stay on the current transport, honor bounded `Retry-After`/deterministic backoff and retry automatically with a fresh proof; switching to the phone would hit the same server cooldown and is not a bypass. The phone forwards the newly Watch-signed request and can never re-sign it. Identity-sensitive 4xx responses do not trigger fallback. The phone bridge accepts only the exact route/method matrix:

```text
GET  /api/v2/course-service/channels/{layout}/manifest
GET  /api/v2/course-service/assets/private/{opaqueAssetId}
POST /api/v2/course-service/installs/ack
POST /api/v2/course-service/round-pins
POST /api/v2/course-service/round-pins/{pinId}/release
POST /api/v2/round-ledger/{roundId}/events
POST /api/v2/round-ledger/{roundId}/resolutions/{resolutionId}/commit
```

It bounds target/header/body sizes, forwards bytes/headers unchanged with URLSession, and returns exact status/headers/body. It cannot decode manifest/chunks/ACK/events, change `Range`, use phone auth or persist the Watch private key. Identity-sensitive HTTP statuses do not trigger fallback; only connectivity failures do.

`DirectThenRelayCourseInstallTransport` carries a durable verified range bitmap, so a direct partial failure asks relay only for still-missing nonempty ranges; duplicate/out-of-order chunks remain identity/hash checked. ACK、round pin and server-first round-pin release each use their persisted deterministic intent/body even if the transport path switches. A lost release response retries the same signed body with a fresh device nonce；the Watch never decrements local `pinCount` until the exact `released` attestation is verified and journaled.

Replace `WatchHoleImageStore` with a migration-only read API; it exposes no write/save/update method and no new install references it.

A lost direct response test proves the relay retry keeps method/target/body/Range/Idempotency-Key byte-identical while using a different Watch nonce/signature, and still produces one server mutation. It first drives `requestingLocation → loadingNearby → choosingNearbyCourse`, selects one distance-sorted nearby course, then drives front/back/full hole-group choice, Tee choice, build polling, install progress and Start; it asserts one verified install, one durable pin and one exact `round_started` event. - [ ] **Step 2: 复用 explicit discovery-scope API 并冻结 setup-options API，不让 Watch 猜 region/layout/Tee/time**

Reuse B7a's proof-protected `GET /courses/discovery-scope-options` and `CourseDiscoveryScopeOptionsResponse`. A zero-result search may advance only after the owner selects one returned `scopeOptionId`; visible UI shows its `displayName + catalogNamespace + region`. `POST /courses/discovery-requests` sends `discoveryIntentId=bootstrapIntentId`, the selected scope ID, query and `watch-v1`; it does not contain `targetEpochMs`. The response's server-created `targetEpochMs`, resolved nullable configuration binding and exact region/catalog are journaled before polling. An unavailable scope remains selectable only to create the durable evidence request and blocked status; it never redirects to a configured neighbor.

Add signed nearby search as the primary Watch entry:

```python
@router.post("/courses/nearby", response_model=CourseNearbyResponse)
async def nearby_courses(
    request: Request,
    account: AccountContext = Depends(current_course_account_context),
) -> CourseNearbyResponse:
    body, raw_body = await strict_request_model_with_raw(request, CourseNearbyRequest)
    return CourseNearbyResponse(**backend.nearby(
        account,
        body,
        request_body_bytes=raw_body,
    ))
```

The generated `CourseNearbyRequest` has exact keys `nearbyIntentId/latitudeE7/longitudeE7/horizontalAccuracyM/radiusM/profileId`. `strict_request_model_with_raw` applies the same duplicate-key、unknown-key、unsafe-integer and canonical-body checks as every generated Course Service decoder while returning the already-buffered bytes; middleware must not buffer or log this route a second time. `SqlCourseBackend.nearby` reserves the intent, then calls B7a's `SqlCourseProviderCatalogMirror` for a bounded local database geodesic query over every currently configured、rights-allowed provider catalog head; it never invokes Garmin/provider transport and never restricts the result to layouts this account previously searched or installed. It rejects accuracy above 5000 m, clamps neither coordinates nor radius, computes integer `distanceM`, filters `distanceM <= radiusM`, and sorts by `(distanceM, displayName.casefold(), catalogEntryId)`. Exact same intent/body may be retried; same `(accountId, deviceId, nearbyIntentId)` with a different keyed request fingerprint is 409.

The response uses the generated independent `CourseNearbyItem`, not `CourseSearchItem + distanceM`. Each row binds the exact active `catalogEntryId/providerCourseRefId/displayName/holeCount/centroid/distance`. If the entry joins to an account-visible canonical layout/revision, the layout pair、source generation and build states are populated and the row is `ready|buildable`. If no canonical layout exists, those fields are SQL/JSON null and `topLevelState=metadata_only`; the server must not create shell identities or a fake revision. Selecting that row calls B7a `POST /courses/catalog-acquisition-requests`, freezes the exact displayed catalog entry/configuration/source revision and polls until `setup_ready`, then loads the real setup-options. Configuration/rights changes after roster display fail closed with a recoverable refresh or typed unavailable state; they never silently choose another scope/head.

Because Plan 4 owns the next linear migration, B12a's already-frozen `0011_device_course_authority` migration and its ORM parity include the nearby intent owner from the outset. B15a treats that migration as immutable reuse and must produce no migration diff. `course_nearby_intents` has exactly `account_id/device_id/nearby_intent_id/request_fingerprint_hmac/fingerprint_key_version/radius_m/created_at/expires_at`, a composite primary key on account/device/intent, an exact 32-byte HMAC blob、positive-key-version、radius、expiry checks and an expiry index. Neither the migration nor `CourseNearbyIntentRow` has latitude、longitude、horizontal-accuracy、raw SHA-256、request JSON or response-body columns.

`CourseNearbyIntentRepo.reserve_exact(...)` receives the already-verified raw request bytes and derives `HMAC-SHA256(key_vN, "course-nearby-intent/v1\0" || accountId || "\0" || deviceId || "\0" || nearbyIntentId || "\0" || rawBody)`. The key comes from the production secret provider, the row freezes its positive key version, and old versions remain verifiable only until the row's bounded 15-minute TTL expires. The repo locks/inserts before querying centroids, returns normally for the same keyed fingerprint/radius and raises a permanent conflict for any changed fingerprint/radius. It never exposes the fingerprint in logs、metrics、exceptions or the response. A plain SHA-256 is forbidden because a coordinate request has enough known structure to permit offline candidate enumeration. `tests/test_course_data_migration.py` compares this exact 0011 table with ORM metadata and still requires one Alembic head.

`server_v2/course_nearby_fingerprint.py` defines a narrow `CourseNearbyFingerprintKeyRing.current() -> (version, SecretBytes)` / `get(version)` port and `HmacCourseNearbyRequestFingerprinter`; it uses `hmac.digest(..., "sha256")` and `hmac.compare_digest`, never stringifies secret or fingerprint bytes. `course_dependencies.py` loads versioned key material from the deployment secret provider, requires at least 32 random bytes, rejects duplicate/non-positive versions and fails production startup if no current key exists. Tests may inject deterministic keys only through the explicit test composition root. This is distinct from Garmin provider credentials、CAS encryption keys and Course signing keys, so rotation or disclosure in one domain cannot cross-authorize another.

Access logs、metrics、traces and exceptions contain only intent ID、an accuracy bucket (`0-25/26-100/101-1000/1001-5000`)、radius and result count; request-body logging、device-proof `contentSha256` header logging and SQL parameter logging are disabled for this route in production composition. `tests/test_course_nearby_privacy.py` injects unique latitude/longitude/accuracy canaries, captures application/access/SQL logs and inspects every persisted `course_nearby_intents` column/value; the exact coordinate integers、decimal renderings and unkeyed request SHA-256 must be absent while the keyed fingerprint version、radius and intent remain auditable. An offline-attack test gets a DB dump and a dictionary of candidate coordinate bodies but not the server HMAC key and proves none can be recomputed or matched to the stored fingerprint. The suite also proves another account/device cannot collide with or read the intent and that expired rows are deleted without retaining a secondary audit copy.

Coordinates are used only against the local provider-wide mirror plus verified installed-course fallback. A zero result therefore means no verified configured catalog head has an in-radius entry；it transitions to text/dictation, then explicit discovery scope if named search is also empty. Raw location is never forwarded to provider discovery、catalog sync or selected-course acquisition. The Watch journal persists `nearbyIntentId/radiusM/nearbyRequestHash/a coordinate-free presentation roster/selected catalog entry identity`, but not latitude、longitude or horizontal accuracy. Here `nearbyRequestHash` is actually an HMAC-SHA256 made with a random per-installation Keychain secret and domain separator—not an unkeyed hash；the secret remains outside the journal while `nearbyRequestHashKeyVersion` is stored for key lookup. Course catalog centroids returned in the generated DTO are used in memory for response validation and are deliberately omitted from the journal roster. CoreLocation remains in memory only until the signed response is decoded and its intent/radius are verified, then the fix and request object are released. While the app remains alive, a lost response may retry the identical in-memory body with the same intent and a fresh device-proof nonce. A restart before response cannot reconstruct that exact body, so it obtains a fresh fix and creates a new nearby intent; a restart after response resumes from the persisted coordinate-free roster. Permission denied、restricted、accuracy over 5000 m or a fix older than 60 seconds immediately presents recent installed courses plus text/dictation search and never blocks cold start.

- [ ] **Step 3: 定义 Watch DTO 与 durable bootstrap state machine**

```swift
public struct WatchCourseSelection: Codable, Equatable, Sendable {
    public let courseLayoutIdentityId: String
    public let layoutRevisionId: String
    public let holeGroupId: String
    public let orderedHoleNumbers: [Int]
    public let teeSelectionId: String
```
